fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.name: PlugBrain: Screen Time Blocker
fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.summary: Block distracting apps with a quick math challenge. Less scrolling, more focus.
fdroid:app.plugbrain.android.description:
Stuck in the scroll? PlugBrain breaks the doomscrolling habit with a quick math problem.
Pick the apps that steal your time and use your phone as usual. When it's time for a break, a math challenge pops up over the app. Solve it to keep going, or tap Leave App and take your time back. Want to think twice before you even start? Turn on a challenge every time a distracting app opens.
The more you scroll, the harder it gets
Every challenge you solve makes the next one tougher. Step away and it eases off again, down to your starting level: Beginner, Intermediate or Expert. More than 40 kinds of problems, from quick sums to multi-digit multiplication, keep your brain switched on.
Why PlugBrain
- An app blocker that makes you think, not a timer you tap past
- Cut screen time on social media, games, videos or any app you choose
- Difficulty that adapts to your own habits
- Works offline, light and dark theme, 13 languages
Private by design
- No ads, no account, no tracking
- No internet permission: nothing leaves your phone
- Free and open source (GPL-3.0)
Permissions
PlugBrain uses usage access, display over other apps and the Accessibility service to see which app is open and show the challenge on top. During a challenge it also blocks calculators. It only reads the name of the open app, never what is on your screen or what you type.

fdroid:com.autopi.name: AutoPie
fdroid:com.autopi.summary: Turn Linux commands into Android apps.
fdroid:com.autopi.description:
AutoPie is a command automation hub for Android. It gives you a Linux environment where you can create, run, and automate Bash commands or Python scripts without using a terminal.
 Use it to build small Android utilities for file conversion, downloads, monitoring, backups, web requests, AI tooling, device workflows, and any other task you would normally solve with Linux packages or scripts.
 Highlights 
 Embedded Termux environment 
 Run Linux commands directly from AutoPie without the Terminal
 Install extra Termux packages with pkg install package-name .
 Install Python packages with pip install package-name .
 Includes useful tooling such as Python, pip, openssh and other utilities out of the box.
 Command and script automation 
 Create custom applets that lives on your homescreen.
 Create applets from Bash commands and Python scripts.
 Add commands to the Android share sheet for quick file, text, and URL workflows.
 Watch folders and automatically process new files.
 Schedule commands with cron-style automation.
 Use interactive command mode when a script needs a live shell session.
 Custom applet creation forms 
 Add text inputs, switches, selectors, file inputs, and other extras to your commands.
 Turn scripts into simple Android workflows that are easy to reuse.
 Use placeholders for files, URLs, text, filenames, directories, random values, and more.
 Ready for practical phone automation 
 Convert videos, audio, images, screenshots, GIFs, and documents with command-line tools.
 Upload, download, rename, compress, and organize files automatically.
 Run web checks, API calls, health monitors, notifications, and custom background jobs.
 Keep the command output and logs accessible from the app.
 Open source Android app 
 Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Material 3.
 Designed for users who want powerful local automation without ads or clutter.
 Permissions 
 All files access: AutoPie runs terminal commands and scripts against files in shared storage. This permission is required so those commands can read, create, modify, monitor, and organize user files and folders.
 Battery optimization exemption: AutoPie requests permission to run without battery optimizations so long-running terminal commands, scheduled jobs, and folder observers can continue working reliably in the background.

fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.name: drejo player
fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.summary: Tiny ad-free player with reliable next/previous across mp4 + mkv folders
fdroid:com.drejo.androidvideoplayer.fdro.description:
A deliberately tiny, free, ad-free, open-source video player whose only job is
to play videos and reliably jump to the next / previous video in the same
folder, including folders that mix .mp4 and .mkv files.
It is built on Android's modern media stack (AndroidX Media3 / ExoPlayer). Every
video in the chosen folder is added to one playlist, so the next / previous
buttons just work across mixed .mp4 + .mkv content; a broken or unsupported file
is skipped instead of freezing playback.
Features:
* Reliable next / previous across a whole folder, regardless of .mp4 vs .mkv.
* Double-tap the right or left side to seek forward / backward; the step grows
 with consecutive taps and is capped relative to the video length.
* Rotation button that can force landscape, force portrait, or follow the
 sensor even when the system rotation lock is on (like YouTube and VLC).
* Optional all-files access (this F-Droid build) so opening any video from any
 file manager lets next / previous work through the whole folder, including
 hidden folders that the media scanner ignores. If you decline the permission,
 the app falls back to the Storage Access Framework folder picker.
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Plays video only: no audio-player mode, no
image viewer. Released under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.name: Rocinante
fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.summary: Fast, private, and native client for the BookWyrm literary social network.
fdroid:com.ferlagod.rocinante.description:
Rocinante is a native Android client for connecting to any BookWyrm instance, the federated social network for readers. Designed with a focus on privacy and performance, it allows you to manage your reading habits without relying on closed platforms or algorithms.
Key features:
- Timeline interaction (ActivityPub): post updates, reply, and like.
- Library management: organize books in default shelves (To Read, Reading, Read).
- Progress tracking: update read pages synchronized with the server.
- Local reminders: configurable daily notifications from the device, without network usage, to encourage reading habits.
- Community exploration: view reviews, currently reading books, and other users' profiles.
- Free and open-source software: transparent code under GPLv3 license, with no trackers or proprietary dependencies.

fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.name: PaperPhoneLite
fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.summary: Encrypted messaging through self-hosted Tor onion services
fdroid:com.fm619.paperphonelite.description:
PaperPhoneLite is a private messaging client for self-hosted PaperPhoneLite onion services.
It bundles Tor and supports private and group chats, attachments, offline data, disappearing messages, signed messages and group keys, offline-password identity verification, safety numbers, optional text-appearance encryption with startup unlocking, and optional ntfy notifications.
A compatible self-hosted server is required. PaperPhoneLite contains no Google Play services, Firebase, advertising, or analytics.
If Tor has no circuit after 20 seconds, the app connects directly outside Tor to bridges.torproject.org to request WebTunnel bridges with the fixed country code cn. It also includes a recovery WebTunnel bridge at ame.neverfeltsogood.top for replacing a known stale cached bridge.
Version 3.1.0 requires compatible upgrades of both clients and the server. Group sends require verified member identities; changed identity keys require verification again. Message signing does not end-to-end encrypt uploaded attachment bytes.

fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.name: LightPlan - Reminder & Planner
fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.summary: Remind yourself about important tasks. Plan your entire year with a countdown!
fdroid:com.lightplanx.xddk.description:
Light Planner is a FOSS, simple, and intuitive app that will help you with planning events, tasks, or achievements you want to reach!
==============
How does it work?
==============
• Add your tasks in a chosen year quarter
• Write up a title and a description and pick a deadline for it
 That’s it! Upon entering the task area, you will be shown the time you have left to complete it and (optionally) the subtasks you have created in it.
==============
Who is it made for?
==============
 Anyone! No matter the age or height, you can use the app to plan ahead and keep track of the time you have left to complete it at any time.
==============
How is it different from other apps?
==============
 This app was designed to be simple and intuitive, while still looking slick and unintrusive. We also don’t collect any data from users (everything is stored on your device), which means you don’t have to create/link an account and you won’t have to deal with any pesky ads!
Additionally, the project is open-source, so if you feel like changing or adding features, you can do it!
(link to the project repository: https://github.com/XDDK/LightPlan).
I hope you'll find this app useful!

fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.name: Agent
fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.summary: Local AI chat, your models, and practical Android tools
fdroid:com.mobilefork.hermesagent.description:
Agent is an independently maintained Android app for local AI chat and practical device workflows.
Choose a model first: open Settings > Models to import a GGUF, LiteRT-LM (.litertlm), or Android .task file with the system file picker. Local import requires neither an account nor an internet connection. Choose an imported or downloaded model and use the start action; the app selects the matching runtime. Model compatibility and available memory still determine whether a model can run.
Optional online providers and downloads are separate from local files. Response preferences, runtime controls, and advanced GGUF settings are grouped under clearly labelled expandable sections. Six interface languages, Android accessibility labels, and confirmation before removing a model help keep controls understandable.
The Full edition includes Android tools for files, app launch, accessibility-assisted actions, notifications, shortcuts, widgets, and automations. Permissions and remote processing remain opt-in. The Play edition has a more restricted tool set.
Agent is not an official Nous Research product and is not endorsed by Nous Research or Teknium. Open-source credits and licenses are retained. The existing application identifier is kept so installed users retain their upgrade path and app data.
Save a diagnostic report without starting a model: Settings > General > Diagnostics and logs > Export diagnostic log. Android lets you choose the folder and filename. Reports include current memory and the last model-start attempt. Review the redacted file before sharing; nothing is uploaded automatically.

fdroid:com.opennotes.name: Open Notes
fdroid:com.opennotes.summary: A minimalist, secure, and fully offline notes app.
fdroid:com.opennotes.description:
OpenNotes is a privacy-focused, offline note-taking application designed to keep your thoughts organized without compromising your data. It provides a fast, clean interface packed with powerful formatting tools.
All your notes are stored exclusively on your local device. The app does not request internet access and contains no trackers or analytics.
Features:
Native Markdown rendering for rich text formatting, including headers, checklists, code blocks, and quotes.
Seamless image support to embed photos directly alongside your text.
Organization tools that allow you to color-code, pin, and sort your notes.
Home screen widgets for quick access to your most important notes.
Built-in privacy options to lock the app behind biometric authentication and block the Android system from taking screenshots of your data.
Personalize the app with dark and light themes, and choose your favorite color for the home screen icon.
Full offline backups that let you export and import your complete note library as a single ZIP file.
Completely free and open-source with zero invasive permissions.

fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.name: Aalener Optik-Formelrechner
fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.summary: Quick and easy calculate a bunch of optical functions
fdroid:de.HS_Aalen.don.description:
The Aalener Optik-Formelrechner enables a quick and easy option to calculate a bunch of optical functions.
At the moment the following features are implemented:
- Paraxial raytracing
- Exact raytracing for an object on the opitcal axis
- Calculation of oblique crossed cylinders with optional sphere
- Calculation of refraction index.
- Calculation of relative transmission
- Calculation of radii for lenses which are free of spherical aberration or coma
- Calculation and visualization for error of refraction, astigmatism, distortion, volume, weight and dimensions of spherical toric lenses
- Conversion of Back Vertex Distances (eg. glasses to contact lenses)
This application was part of a bachelor thesis for the study program opthalmic optics and audiology at Aalen University. It is meant to check calculations and takes part in the interactive lectures.
Please be advised that the whole application is in german only. If you are an optician it is highly possible that you will understand most of the functions by their formula symbols.

fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.name: Gramophone
fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.summary: Simple offline music player with minimalistic design
fdroid:org.akanework.gramophone.description:
Gramophone is an offline, local music player that can play .mp3, .flac, .ogg, .opus, .m4a, .mka and .wav files.
- Light, stable, and minimalistic
- Up-to-date Material 3 design and theme
- Dynamic player UI Monet color
- Uses MediaStore to quickly access on-device music
- Search and browse for your favourite music
- List and grid views
- Browse songs by folder and filesystem
- Natural sorting and various other sorting options
- Playlist support
- Synced lyrics (LRC, TTML, SRT)
- Supports word/syllable Karaoke lyrics synchronization
- Full support for ReplayGain 2.0
- Support for system/third-party Equalizer apps
If you face any issues, feel free to open an issue at our GitHub page: https://github.com/FoedusProgramme/Gramophone/issues 
If you have any security-related or otherwise confidential comments, please email: nift4dev [@] gmail [.] com
Gramophone is open source and released under the GPLv3.0 or later license. We thank all our contributors and translators! https://github.com/FoedusProgramme/Gramophone 
You can help translate Gramophone to your language: https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/gramophone/ 
Note: Gramophone supports the "enhanced album covers" feature. This feature needs the "Photos and videos" permission. This feature is ENTIRELY OPTIONAL and DISABLED BY DEFAULT. We do NOT upload any data anywhere. Your photos are not used, the permission is ONLY used to DISPLAY album covers. That's it.
Note: Not all audio file formats will work on all devices. For more information, please refer to https://developer.android.com/media/media3/exoplayer/supported-formats#progressive-container and https://developer.android.com/media/platform/supported-formats#audio-formats 
Note: Gramophone is completely offline, thus it does not support downloading or streaming music. It will only play music files on your device. Gramophone cannot bypass any copy protections.
Note: Our privacy policy is available at https://foedusprogramme.github.io/org/privacy.html

fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.name: Middor
fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.summary: Mirror applications for HUD display with horizontal flip.
fdroid:org.nktnet.middor.description:
Middor is a free and open-source Android application for mirroring apps on your device.
With built-in support for horizontal flip and 180° rotation, Middor can be used to:
- Display apps on a HUD
- Project content onto a car windscreen (e.g. Google Maps navigation)
- View mirrored images and videos
Middor only supports devices running Android 14 QPR2 or higher, as it relies on the single app screen sharing feature.
For more details, see Android 14 - App Screen Sharing: https://developer.android.com/about/versions/14/features/app-screen-sharing
 Touch controls 
To tap, swipe, or use multitouch on the mirror, turn on Enable Touch Controls
in Settings and enable Middor Touch in Android Accessibility settings.
Gestures follow flips and rotations and replay when you lift your fingers.
Touch controls are optional for view-only mirroring.
For usage instructions, see https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/discussions/2
 Permissions 
- SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW : to draw a mirror overlay on top of other apps
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE : to run the mirror service continuously while the overlay is active
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION : for capturing the screen content of the underlying app
- BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE : for the optional Middor Touch service
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS : (optional) to display the mirror service notification with additional actions
 Contact 
 Questions/Feature Requests 
Create a Q&A for questions and Ideas for feature requests on GitHub discussions: https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/discussions
 Bugs/Issues 
Report bugs by creating a GitHub issue describing the problem and how it can be reproduced: https://github.com/nktnet1/middor/issues
Please also include your device model, app version and android version.
 Other 
For all other inquiries, please reach out to: support@middor.nktnet.org

fdroid:org.sharkdroid.name: SharkDroid
fdroid:org.sharkdroid.summary: Capture and analyze network packets with Wireshark tools on Android
fdroid:org.sharkdroid.description:
SharkDroid brings Wireshark's dumpcap and tshark tools to Android with a Material 3 interface.
Features:
• Capture packets from Wi-Fi, cellular, VPN, loopback and other available network interfaces.
• Apply BPF capture filters and Wireshark display filters.
• Inspect packet lists, expandable protocol trees and hexadecimal packet bytes.
• Follow TCP/UDP streams and view protocol and conversation statistics.
• Open pcap/pcapng files, save captures, and export or share them.
• Keep captures running in the background with a foreground service.
• Use light or dark themes, dynamic colors, and English or Simplified Chinese.
• Stream captures to desktop Wireshark over an authorized USB adb connection.
Requirements:
Android 10 or later on an arm64-v8a device. Live packet capture requires root access. Opening existing capture files does not require root.
Privacy:
The app has no INTERNET permission, advertisements, analytics or telemetry. Captures stay in app-private storage until you export or share them. tshark uses numeric addresses without reverse DNS lookups.
Limitations:
Wi-Fi monitor mode is not supported. Encrypted TLS/QUIC application content cannot be read without the necessary keys. Some optional desktop Wireshark features are unavailable.
Screenshots show the app interface with demo packet data.
SharkDroid is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Wireshark Foundation. Wireshark and the Wireshark fin logo are trademarks of the Wireshark Foundation.

fdroid:spam.blocker.name: SpamBlocker (Call & SMS)
fdroid:spam.blocker.description:
It blocks unwanted calls & SMS messages without replacing your default call/SMS app.

apple-macos:673567077.description:
Az ArtBook digitális művészeti album Andrássy Kurta János művészetét mutatja be életrajza, Feledy Balázs tanulmánya, valamint több, mint 130 alkotás képeinek közlésével.
The Artbook digital fine art album presents the art of sculptor János Andrássy Kurta through his biography, more than 130 images of his works and a study of Balázs Feledy. 
Andrássy Kurta János szobrászművész (1911 – 2008) a népi ihletésű magyar nemzeti szobrászat egyik legjelesebb képviselője volt. Több, mint 60 szobra áll köztereinken. Életművében a plasztikák és domborművek mellett érmek, festmények, rajzok, grafikák is megtalálhatók.
Sculptor János Andrássy Kurta (1911 – 2008) was one of the most outstanding artists of the Hungarian national folk-inspired sculpture. More than 60 of his sculptures stand in public spaces. His oeuvre consists of a significant number of works of art: besides sculptures and reliefs he created paintings, drawings and graphics as well.
Az ArtBook digitális művészeti album egy digitális könyv: fejezetekből áll, és éppen úgy olvasható, mint a hagyományos könyvek. A digitális könyvet a szokásos gesztusokkal lehet használni. A technológia lehetővé teszi a művek megtekintését különböző nézőpontokból, valamint a képek teljes képenyős megjelenítését. A művek katalógusából felhasználóbarát módon lehet válogatni különböző szempontok szerint, ilyenkor csak a kiválasztott művek képei jelennek meg.
The ArtBook fine art album is a digital book: it consists of chapters and it is as readable as the traditional books. You can turn pages back and forth using the well knows gestures. The technology allows to see the objects from multiple perspectives and to open the images in full screen size. The catalogue of the works can be filtered in a userfriendly way by different criteria, visualizing the images of the selected works only.

 Simple interface

 No API keys, no proprietary services/libraries, no telemetry, no spying, no data collection, does not use network permission

 Intel i7-2670QM (2011)

 AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (2017)
 Steam Deck
 GPU is not required or used.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for YAML front matter.

fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.name: foo2ddst
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.summary: Linux printer driver for DDST protocol
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2ddst.description: foo2ddst is an open source printer driver for printers that use the DDST wire protocol for their print data, such as the Ricoh SP 112, or the Ricoh SP 201Nw. These printers are often erroneously referred to as winprinters or GDI printers. However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. In fact, DDST printers are raster printers which happen to use a very efficient wire protocol. DDST is just one of many wire protocols that are in use today, such as Postscript, PCL, Epson, ZjStream, etc.

fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.name: golang-github-oklog-run-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.summary: Universal mechanism to manage goroutine lifecycles
fedora-packages:golang-github-oklog-run/.description: run.Group is a universal mechanism to manage goroutine lifecycles. Create a zero-value run.Group, and then add actors to it. Actors are defined as a pair of functions: an execute function, which should run synchronously; and an interrupt function, which, when invoked, should cause the execute function to return. Finally, invoke Run, which concurrently runs all of the actors, waits until the first actor exits, invokes the interrupt functions, and finally returns control to the caller only once all actors have returned. This general-purpose API allows callers to model pretty much any runnable task, and achieve well-defined lifecycle semantics for the group. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/oklog/run

firefox-addons:2729178.name: Return YouTube Dislike
firefox-addons:2729178.summary: Returns ability to see dislike statistics on youtube
firefox-addons:2729178.description:
Return YouTube Dislike restores the ability to see dislikes on YouTube.
ABOUT THE NEW DATA COLLECTION PROMPT
Firefox has introduced a way for extensions to declare the data they send, using a fixed list of categories. Since version 4.0.6 declared RYD's data, Firefox asks existing users to approve four of them before updating: "Personally identifying information", "Browsing activity", "Website content" and "Website activity".
RYD hasn't changed how it handles your data. What changed is how Mozilla labels it. The category names are broad, so an extension that only works on YouTube can look like it watches everything you do. Ajay, the author of SponsorBlock and DeArrow, describes the same problem: https://discourse.mozilla.org/t/the-new-data-transmission-permissions-seem-to-be-misleading-to-users/149410 
WHAT EACH LABEL MEANS FOR RYD
- Personally identifying information: a randomly generated user ID, used to count votes. It isn't derived from or linked to your Google or YouTube account.
- Browsing activity: when you open a YouTube video, the extension sends its video ID to fetch the dislike count.
- Website content: things like the visible like count, which helps estimate dislikes.
- Website activity: your Like or Dislike click, which counts as your vote. You can turn vote submission off in the extension's settings.
- Authentication information (optional): used only if you choose to sign in with Patreon or GitHub.
RYD's site permissions cover only YouTube and its own API at returnyoutubedislikeapi.com . It doesn't read other websites, and these site permissions can't be used to access them.
If you decline the prompt, Firefox keeps your current version. Full details are in the privacy policy linked on this page.
Starting December 13th 2021, YouTube removed the ability to see dislikes from their API. This extension aims to restore power to users by using a combination of archived like and dislike data, as well as the likes and dislikes made by extension users to show the most accurate ratings. The more users that use the extension, the more accurate it will be. Unpopular videos uploaded after December 13th, 2021 may have less accurate data shown than more popular videos.
RYD is a Firefox Recommended extension and is open source, so you can see exactly how it works.
Help: https://returnyoutubedislike.com/help 
Source code and issues: https://github.com/Anarios/return-youtube-dislike

bluejetty:00106467:android.name: Homo Machina
bluejetty:00106467:android.summary: Homo Machina is a puzzle game inspired by the work of avant-garde scientist Fritz Kahn. Set off on a crazy journey to solve the surreal puzzles of Homo Machina and learn about the internal working of the human body, represented as a giganti
bluejetty:00106467:android.description:
Homo Machina is a puzzle game inspired by the work of avant-garde scientist Fritz Kahn. Set off on a crazy journey to solve the surreal puzzles of Homo Machina and learn about the internal working of the human body, represented as a gigantic 1920s factory.
In this narrative puzzle, players are plunged into an ingenious system of nerves, vessels and valves. The aim is to help the body function correctly in about thirty steps or so throughout the entire day. Each scene breaks down daily acts, such as opening your eyes, chewing a toast or listening to music, through seamless navigation and intuitive gameplay.
Fritz Kahn, a pioneer of infographics and popular science, came up with easy to understand analogies to enable people to improve their understanding of the human body. By combining old school design with a contemporary influence, Homo Machina delights with its clever dialogue between the absent-minded director a the helm of the body-machine and Josiane, his diligent secretary, encouraging players to put task the armada of workers to get the incredible factory up and running. 
After Californium, Homo Machina is the new video game created by Darjeeling production. It was published and co-produced by ARTE, European culture digital and TV Channel, and Feierabend.

Homo Machina is a puzzle game inspired by the work of avant-garde scientist Fritz Kahn. Set off on a crazy journey to solve the surreal puzzles of Homo Machina and learn about the internal working of the human body, represented as a gigantic 1920s factory.

In this narrative puzzle, players are plunged into an ingenious system of nerves, vessels and valves. The aim is to help the body function correctly in about thirty steps or so throughout the entire day. Each scene breaks down daily acts, such as opening your eyes, chewing a toast or listening to music, through seamless navigation and intuitive gameplay.

Fritz Kahn, a pioneer of infographics and popular science, came up with easy to understand analogies to enable people to improve their understanding of the human body. By combining old school design with a contemporary influence, Homo Machina delights with its clever dialogue between the absent-minded director a the helm of the body-machine and Josiane, his diligent secretary, encouraging players to put task the armada of workers to get the incredible factory up and running. 

After Californium, Homo Machina is the new video game created by Darjeeling production. It was published and co-produced by ARTE, European culture digital and TV Channel, and Feierabend.

bluejetty:00149014:ios.summary:
Now on Apple Arcade, RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic+ is a fresh RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. 
Cr
bluejetty:00149014:ios.description:
Now on Apple Arcade, RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic+ is a fresh RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. 
Create and run amazing parks complete with the most outrageous rides imaginable. RCT Classic+ includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® PC Games, now enhanced for handheld devices.
Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in.
Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon? 
The three expansion packs: Wacky Worlds, Time Twister and Toolkit are all included in this Apple Arcade version!
Key Features:
• The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new app that combines the best elements of both classic titles.
• Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.
• Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.
• Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.
• Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.
• Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.
• Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style characterful isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.
• Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.
Wacky Worlds: 
Find your passport and pack your bags! Wacky Worlds takes players on the ultimate trip around the globe in 17 new park scenarios! Includes exotic rides, profitable concessions and the most famous landmarks known to man including the Eiffel Tower, Big Ben, Statue of Liberty, Great Wall of China and more! Each location is packed with opportunities for success, fun and unique challenges.
Time Twister:
Travel through time with 14 new park scenarios based on historical and fantasy time-themes and build a park that is truly a blast from the past (or future if you like). Play in a Prehistoric amusement park decorated with huge animated T-Rex’s and coasters such as the Raptor Ride, or choose from Mythological times, the Dark Ages, the Rock & Roll crazed ‘50s, the Future or the Roaring Twenties.
Toolkit:
Park Scenario Editor: Design and build your own amazing parks – Make them as easy or as challenging as you want, using your choice of scenery and rides! Includes a number of Six Flags parks to get you started.
Ride Designer: Build, test, fine-tune and theme your own awesome roller coaster designs in the Ride Designer before saving them for use while playing!
Import and Export: Share your saved parks, park scenarios and ride designs with friends, and try out their creations too! (Includes the ability to import most saved parks and scenarios created with the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 PC game).

Hyperspektiv is a photo, video, and AR filter app. Create mind-bending visuals quickly and easily. Featured *Best New App* by the App Store. 
“Your photos and videos have never been trippier” - WALL STREET JOURNAL
With the free version of Hyperspektiv, you get access to the full functionality of the app with the free factory filters. 
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES
• New filters every month
• Hyperspektiv’s complete filter library (50+ filters)
• Save HD photos & videos
• Generate & save unlimited custom filters
FREE FEATURES
• Unlimited use of our factory filters and 24 legacy filters
• Import + export your photos and videos
• AR filters
• Capture photos & videos in real-time
• Turn your photos into videos
• Generate and save up to 3 custom filters
• New free filters every few months
• Mirroring system for creating symmetrical visuals
• Glitch out your Instagram Stories
PRESS
“Hyperspektiv’s filters were designed to be a kind of interactive art piece, one that has the potential to change how you see the world.” -APPLE
“Hyperspektiv lets you change images and video beyond recognition.” -WIRED
“Distort reality with cyberdelic video app Hyperspektiv” -VICE
“turns you into stills and videos that would look fantastic in a music video.” -CULT OF MAC
“Hyperspektiv produces glitchy, psychedelic images.” THE VERGE
“Hyperspektiv gives your photos and videos a dose of weird. -THE NEXT WEB
“Put distorted reality at your fingertips.” -POND5
“The powerful video and photo effects app, Hyperskeptiv, promises much for those wishing to distort reality in a trippy, creative way.” -MAC PRO VIDEO
“Hyperspektiv is an easy-to-use, great-to-have app if you love creating different and unusual photos and videos” -APP ADVICE
We love hearing your ideas and feedback. Let us know how we can support you:
General inquiries us@hyperspektiv.com 
Support support@hyperspektiv.com
DM us on Instagram at @hyperspektiv
Find us on FB facebook.com/hyperspektiv
Join the Hypersquad FB community bit.ly/hyper_squad
Twitter @hyperspektiv
MEMBERSHIP INFORMATION AND TERMS
• Start your Hyperspektiv membership with a free 7-day trial
• Subscribe for unlimited access to Hyperspektiv’s Premium features.
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or yearly at the rate selected.
• Your Hyperspektiv Premium membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Read more about our terms and conditions here — hyperspektiv.com/tos
~ Privacy Policy ~
Phantom Force, LP, also referred to as PF in this Privacy Policy, is the creator of the HYPERSPEKTIV application which we refer to as the App. PF does not require that you reveal any personally identifiable information to use our App. We or our third party service providers, such as Apple, Google, Facebook and Yahoo, may collect information for technical support or other business support reasons such as for use in analytics and to improve the performance, experience and reliability of the App.
HOW WE MANAGE TRUE-DEPTH FACE DATA
Hyperspektiv utilizes Apple's Augmented Reality APIs (specifically ARKit & TrueDepth) in order to provide filters that react intelligently to people's bodies. On newer devices, in selfie mode, this requires that we use ARKit's Face Tracking mode. 
We do not utilize your True Depth face data, nor do we store it anywhere. The only data used is the outline of your body, so we can apply filters to it.
Read more about our privacy policy here — hyperspektiv.com/privacy

bluejetty:00064053:ios.summary:
【Fantasy Tactical RPG games】
Legend has it that the world was once pitch black and all that existed was a giant dragon. The dragon granted humans eternal life, but their freedom was deprived... Those enslaved have finally awakened. In searc
bluejetty:00064053:ios.description:
【Fantasy Tactical RPG games】
Legend has it that the world was once pitch black and all that existed was a giant dragon. The dragon granted humans eternal life, but their freedom was deprived... Those enslaved have finally awakened. In search of hope and destiny, a knight named Vendacti clashed against fate, setting into motion a series of events that would forever change the structure of reality...
【Massive, Epic Storyline】
Sdorica has an enormous worldview and an unprecedented epic story with numerous episodes. Season one takes place in the Kingdom of the Sun, a nation that seems perfect on the outside...but where discord and darkness lurk within. Go on a journey that traverses an amazon-like forest, a magical Rune Academy, the over-taxed and oppressed Slums and more, to face betrayal, truth, and war. Season two opens up the neighboring Desert Kingdom, a country engulfed in the flames of war and a clash between the head of the temple and politicians in power. On which side does evil lie; and will goodness prevail? To add another layer of depth and feeling to the game, well-known Japanese voice actors provide the voices for the memorable characters of this story.
【Collect Magnificent Characters】
Collect all kinds of characters!! There’s Sophie, a character done in the Onmyoji style; Pang, the brawling tiger who hails from the East, Puggi, a flappy-happy, sometimes angry bird that thinks he’s the main character; Aosta, the arrogant, brainy Life Magic scientist who is well aware that he’s a genius. Plus tons more! Explore continent Vendacti with your favorite team and start building your favorite character! Follow the royal princess, Angelia, to protect the kingdom, or follow Leah, the demihuman with rabbit ears and enter the Rune Academy to learn rune magic!
【Variety of Unique Game Modes】
Sdorica is a classic fantasy turn based tactical RPG that uses the classic team combo of support, attacker, and tank. Remove the orbs strategically to cast spells, save the world, and achieve your fantasy. There are also casual game modes where you can breed adorable monsters, explore, and a cooperation system that allows you to fight along with friends and guild members. A fun and fascinating game experience awaits!
※Players can download this Tactical RPG game for free

bluejetty:00094523:android.description:
With the Azteca Digital Wellbeing app you receive your support, quickly and safely. If you are a beneficiary of Social Programs and will receive your support in the Bienestar Azteca Digital application, download the app and register to enjoy the benefits as soon as possible!
Your money will be protected and always available in your account when you need it. Get proof of the operations carried out and have control of the money from your cell phone!
Enjoy the services of the Azteca Digital Wellbeing App:
● Collect support from the app and your money will be credited directly to your Bienestar Azteca Digital account. 📲
● Find your favorite gift cards 🎁: Xbox PlayStation Cards, Nintendo, Uber, Roblox and more. 
● Buy online safely with your digital Wellbeing card 💳 Making online purchases is very easy, just view your digital card and your security code will be active for 5 minutes. Withdraw money at Walmart, Waldos, Neto and Bodega Aurrera 🏪 When making a minimum purchase of $50 pesos in these stores you can withdraw cash from your application up to $4,000 and at Bodega Express up to $1000. You only need to indicate the amount to withdraw and scan the QR code to make the payment. 
● Go to the window of any Banco Azteca branch to withdraw your money or do so at an ATM via QR code. 🏧 Select the Withdraw Money at ATM option and scan the code at the ATM.
● Pay for your purchases at Walmart, Bodega Aurrera, Chedraui, Sam's Club, Tiendas Neto, Soriana and la Comer 🛍️ with your Azteca Digital Wellbeing app.
Check your balance and movements of your operations 📳 in the Bienestar Azteca Digital app and have control of your money at all times.
● With Bienestar Azteca Digital pay your services on time. Avoid surcharges and keep your CFE, Sky, Totalplay, Avon, Natura, Izzi, Jafra payments up to date by entering the reference number, scanning the barcode or QR code.
● Send money nearby to Banco Azteca and baz superapp accounts. View the Banco Azteca accounts near you on the radar, select the person, the amount you want to send and confirm the information.
● Send money through SPEI from the app. 💵 Just enter the recipient's information, choose the amount and confirm your shipment quickly and safely.
How is the registration to receive support from social programs and registration in Bienestar Azteca Digital?
Registration is done directly at the Institution to which your program belongs. 
Once your Institution confirms that you were accepted, download the application and register, accept documents, enter your CURP (which must be previously registered in the registry), confirm your data, and create your password. 
Ready! We will send you your username by email.
Manage your support however you want and enjoy your Bienestar Azteca Digital app! Start using it and receive your social program easily and quickly. Do you have doubts? Contact us at 55-7600-6440 or write to us atencionaclientesbienestarazteca@bancoazteca.com

bluejetty:00080764:ios.description:
The best in fitness + self care, all in one place. Get unlimited access to hundreds of hand-selected instructors and studios through live and on-demand classes, including Pilates, barre, yoga, boxing, sculpt, dance cardio, meditation, sound baths + more.
Membership includes:
• Unlimited access to live + on-demand classes
• 30+ new classes added monthly
• A custom-curated weekly workout + self-care schedule
• Early access to in-person events 
ORRO was created by Elizabeth Endres + Dale Borchiver from Sweats and the City. As experts in the fitness + wellness space, the duo started their blog with the goal of helping others live a healthier, happier lifestyle. ORRO was developed with the same goal in mind: helping our community establish a daily routine (centered around both physical and mental health) to become the best version of themselves.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to ORRO: Workouts + Wellness on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://www.watch.orroapp.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.watch.orroapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00027293:ios.name: i41CX+
bluejetty:00027293:ios.summary: i41CX+ is an advanced programmable and expandable RPN scientific calculator with a virtual thermal printer/plotter and workstation-class CAS capabilities that is far beyond a mere replica of the original. In addition to being functionally
bluejetty:00027293:ios.description:
i41CX+ is an advanced programmable and expandable RPN scientific calculator with a virtual thermal printer/plotter and workstation-class CAS capabilities that is far beyond a mere replica of the original. In addition to being functionally equivalent to the world-renowned HP-41CX and providing access to its entire library of modules and programs, i41CX+ is enhanced with iOS and hardware features, keyboard overlays, rich set of import and export capabilities, traditional and upbeat diverse set of skins, complete color control, iCloud support, and much more.
The i41CX+ CAS is a full implementation of REDUCE. It's like having Mathematica or the computational engine of Wolfram Alpha in your pocket and, best of all, it runs natively so no internet connection is required. The CAS is fully programmable and provides the ability to reuse previous results in computations. Moreover, the CAS has full access to the calculator registers so it is possible to combine RPN programs with CAS programs.
This is the finest and most powerful scientific/engineering/financial calculator for iOS devices bar none.
CALCULATOR FEATURES:
• RPN logic with a 4 element deep memory stack
• 319 main and 600 extended memory registers
• Over 400 built-in functions, including over 100 functions created specifically for i41CX+
• Time, calendar, alarm, and stopwatch functions
• Four module ports provide access to HP-41 expansion pacs
• Rich set of functions and algorithms: numerical, mathematical, statistical, complex, matrix, numerical integration, curve fitting, solutions to equations, and much more
• Powerful, flexible, and programmable Computer Algebra System (CAS) supporting symbolic, arbitrary precision, scalar, vector and matrix algebra calculations, 2D/3D plotting, and much more
• Full-screen text editor with configurable font style and size, color scheme, a user configurable macro keyboard, and a numerical keyboard
• Access to the entire HP-41 library of solutions for science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, business, financial, surveying, medicine, real estate, and many other domains
• Programmable - virtually unlimited number of lines
• User definable keyboard
• Ability to operate the calculator using a Bluetooth keyboard
• Device integration: external display mirroring, copy and paste, in-app mail, system keyboard, GPS, accelerometer, digital compass, time and date synchronization, AirPrint, and much more
• Virtually unlimited data and program storage capacity using the device's flash memory for local storage
• Import/export data, programs, overlays, modules, etc. via the web, email, and iTunes file sharing
• iCloud syncing of files and preference settings
• iOS 8 Notification Center widget
• 43 available keyboard overlays and support for user created overlays
• Sound support including synthetic tones and interface sounds
• Support for calculator skins and optional mini stack display
• Adjustable calculator speed, sound volume, and display colors
• Usage & Examples table with usage tips and examples
• Quick Reference Guide of all built-in functions
• CAS Quick Reference with all built-in functions, operators, switches, and packages
• Beautiful and clean user interface
PRINTER FEATURES:
• Support for printing, plotting, graphics, and special characters
• User configurable and programmable print color
• Export printer output via email, clipboard, or AirPrint
• Ability to save a JPEG image of the paper roll to the device's photo album
***********************************************************
A comprehensive FAQ and Mini-Manual are available at http://alsoftiphone.com/i41CXplus. Please don't hesitate to use the "Contact Us" link there if you cannot find the answers or information that you seek. Thank you.

bluejetty:00153963:ios.name: Slopax: Weight Loss & Strength
bluejetty:00153963:ios.summary:
You're tired of tracking calories. You just can't stop ordering DoorDash at 10 PM. You just want to eat healthy and feel healthy.
Slopax is the weight loss & muscle building app that actually fixes the problem. No calorie counting. No food
bluejetty:00153963:ios.description:
You're tired of tracking calories. You just can't stop ordering DoorDash at 10 PM. You just want to eat healthy and feel healthy.
Slopax is the weight loss & muscle building app that actually fixes the problem. No calorie counting. No food scales. No meal plans you'll quit in a week. Just a smarter system that makes eating well the easy choice.
Snap a photo of your meal. We tell you if it's Green (great choice), Yellow (okay in moderation), or Red (working against your goals). That's it. Two seconds per meal. Stanford research found that people who focus on food quality instead of calorie counting lost up to 70 lbs a year without any special training.
But here's what no other app does: Slopax blocks your delivery apps during the hours you choose. Set your danger zone, and DoorDash, UberEats, and SkipTheDishes are off limits. When you try to open them, we show you your streak, your progress, and what you can cook from what's already in your fridge. The late-night order that ruins your week? Gone.
Eat green for 6 days, earn a guilt-free cheat meal on day 7. No restriction. No shame. Just a simple streak system that makes healthy eating feel like a game instead of a punishment.
HOW IT WORKS
Snap your meals. Take a photo, get an instant Green, Yellow, or Red rating. Your weekly food vault shows every meal at a glance so you can watch the reds disappear and the greens take over.
Block the temptation. Choose which delivery apps to block and when. We handle the rest. No willpower required.
Cook smarter. Tell us what's in your fridge and we'll suggest healthy meals you can make in 15 minutes. No more "I don't know what to cook" turning into another delivery order.
Earn your cheat meals. Keep your streak alive and reward yourself on your terms. The longer your streak, the better it feels.
Plus: full workout programs. Diet is 80% of the battle. We handle the other 20% too with custom training plans that adapt to your goals, schedule, and equipment. Beginner to advanced.
BACKED BY RESEARCH
- Harvard Health says: "Stop counting calories. Focus on choosing unprocessed foods, lean meats, whole grains, and plenty of fruits and vegetables."
- Stanford studied 609 people for a year. Nobody counted calories. They ate whole foods and lost an average of 12 lbs. Our Green/Yellow/Red system is built on that research.
- "People who keep daily food records lose twice as much weight as those who don't" (Kaiser Permanente, 1,700 participants). Slopax makes food tracking take 2 seconds instead of 5 minutes.
WHAT YOU GET
- Trained Food Photo Scanner with instant Green/Yellow/Red ratings
- Delivery app blocker for DoorDash, UberEats, SkipTheDishes, and more
- Streak system with earned cheat meals
- Meal prep assistant based on what's in your fridge
- Weekly food vault showing all your meals visually
- Full custom-made workout programs for any goal and experience level
- Progress tracking for weight, nutrition, and training

bluejetty:00171216:ios.description:
Shop smarter. Sell better. Never overpay.
Keepa® is the world’s most popular Amazon price tracker. Whether you are a savvy shopper waiting for the perfect deal, or a seller analyzing market trends, Keepa provides the transparency and data you need to make the right decision.
Access detailed price history charts for over 7 billion Amazon products directly on your phone. See through fake discounts, spot seasonal trends, and find the lowest historical price in seconds.
KEY FEATURES:
+ Comprehensive Price History Graphs
Instant transparency. View detailed charts showing Price history (New, Used, Warehouse Deals), Sales Rank, Buy Box history, and Offer counts. Zoom in to see daily fluctuations or zoom out to view years of data.
+ Price Drop & Availability Alerts
Don't constantly refresh the page. Simply set your desired price, and Keepa will notify you when the price drops or when a product comes back in stock. Ideal for securing the best deals or monitoring competitor inventory.
+ Global Product Search & Scanner
Find what you need instantly. Search specifically for Amazon products or use the built-in barcode scanner to check online prices while you are in a retail store.
+ Deep Market Insights
Go beyond the price tag. Access advanced data including:
• Sales Rank History: Gauge product popularity over time.
• Buy Box Statistics: See who is winning the sale and at what price.
• Offer Counts: Track how many sellers are competing on a listing.
• Rating & Review History: Monitor product reputation trends.
+ International Amazon Support
Track prices across the globe. Keepa supports Amazon locales in the US, Germany, UK, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Japan, India, Mexico, and Brazil.
Download Keepa today and master the Amazon marketplace.

Tired of the same emojis on your phone? Want to socialize easily? Let’s try Light Emoji. 
Light Emoji is a mobile app that integrates memes（Including memes, emojis, stickers and more）download, custom emojis and wallpaper. It allows you to download all kinds of fun memes, create your own personality emojis, and easily find your favorite wallpaper. Your phone, you call the shots!
Featured functions:
--Memes download and share: 5000+ popular and funny memes, plus exclusive resources for daily updates. Whether it's dynamic or static memes, you can easily get them to make your conversation more interesting. In addition, you can share with one click to convey your happiness in time!
-- Memes editing: You can make edits on the original meme, such as adding text, decorating, changing the size, etc. Make your memes more special!
-- Custom emojis: Say goodbye to the same emojis, using the powerful functions of Light Emoji, you can freely create your own unique emoji.
--Massive wallpaper library: We have HD wallpapers in a variety of styles and themes, including beauty, Christmas, scenery, characters, abstract, cartoons and more.
We will update the resources in the app regularly, and there are more holiday limited themes and materials for you to unlock. 
We are committed to creating a richer and more interesting Light Emoji, and we will develop more new features and exclusive resources in the future, so stay tuned! 
Thank you for using Light Emoji!

bluejetty:00073548:ios.description:
OpenSnow is your trusted source for the most accurate snow forecast, snow report, and ski conditions.
"Weather forecasting for the mountains takes extra focus, analysis, and precision, which is exactly what OpenSnow provides. The app is incredible, even for super weather nerds like myself." – Cody Townsend, Pro Skier
15-Day Snow Forecasts
Finding the location that has the best snow conditions can feel overwhelming. With OpenSnow, deciding where to go is easy. View the latest 15-day snow forecast, snow report, conditions history, and mountain webcams for your favorite locations in just a few seconds.
Local Daily Snow Experts
Instead of spending hours sifting through weather data, get the inside scoop in just a few minutes. Our local experts write a new Daily Snow forecast each day in the winter for regions around the US, Canada, Europe, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. Have one of our expert local forecasters guide you to the best snow conditions.
3D Weather + Snow Maps
We make it easy to track incoming storms with super-res radar and global precipitation, radar, and snow forecast maps. You can also view 3D maps for snow depth, avalanche risk, slope angle, active fires, air quality, wildfire smoke, public and private land ownership, and more. Download high-resolution satellite maps to view offline.
PEAKS + StormNet

bluejetty:00085632:ios.summary:
Travel light with the official Tisséo mobile app! Buy your tickets directly via your smartphone and manage your journeys while saving time.
All the services and information you need to travel on the public transport network in the Toulouse
bluejetty:00085632:ios.description:
Travel light with the official Tisséo mobile app! Buy your tickets directly via your smartphone and manage your journeys while saving time.
All the services and information you need to travel on the public transport network in the Toulouse metropolitan area.
Whether you are a regular or occasional user, the Tisséo app will simplify your journeys thanks to its many different features.
- A practical way to purchase tickets: in just a few moments and wherever you are, purchase your tickets and top up your Pastel card
- Interactive map: navigate directly on your smartphone to find bus, underground and tram stops, Toulouse city bike stations, car-pooling spots and all the main points of interest in the Toulouse metropolitan area.
- Geolocation: save time! By locating your position, you can instantly find stops and points of interest nearby.
- Route map: display the routes of all the lines and stops for a given direction.
- Next departures: wherever you are, get real-time information about the times of the next departures on the lines you are interested in.
- Line timetables: all departure times for a given line and stop, over several days. You can also download the timetables directly onto your smartphone to view them even when you are offline.
- Network information and alerts: new lines, new routes, traffic problems or roadworks; keep informed about the latest news concerning the Tisséo network at all times. You can also receive notifications if there are any major disruptions!
- Journey planner: wondering which is the best route to take? It takes just a few moments to find the fastest and most suitable routes for your journey, either using the map or the form.
- Favourites: save your favourites to find all the information you need for your journeys in one click from the home page.
- Widget: you no longer need to open the Tisséo app to see the next departures from your favourite stops!
Updates will be available soon, so stay tuned and don't hesitate to send us your comments.
Geolocation works within the area covered by the public transport services of the Toulouse conurbation.
This app requires an internet connection.
Official public transport app of the Toulouse metropolitan area.

bluejetty:00043944:ios.description:
ChoiceOne Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ChoiceOne Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ChoiceOne Bank app, you must be enrolled as a ChoiceOne Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

 - Ability to mark the start of contractions
 - Pause, early transition to the next phase, +10 seconds ability
Improve stamina breath with us!
We are open to get assist in translating the application into your native language :)
This application is integrated with the HEALTH application. For recording and reading indicators such as Heart Rate and oxygen Saturation.
Disclaimer: Breath holding may have some risks. We recommend seeking medical doctor's advise regarding breath holding before using this app.

bluejetty:00016789:ios.description:
Join Buster Bumblechops in this goopendous adventure to complete the ultimate Moshling collection.
Catch and hatch up to six new Moshlings every day. You can even hatch Ultra Rare Super Moshlings using special Golden Spoons! Along the way you will adopt, name and customize your very own unique pet Moshling, play fun mini-games and solve puzzles as you explore the ever-expanding world of Moshi.
• Find, hatch and collect Moshlings
- Adopt, customise and name your very own unique pet Moshling
- Hatch up to six new Moshlings every day
- Care for your Moshlings, feed them and decorate their home to make them happy
- Find Super Moshlings, ultra rare superheroes in tough-to-crack eggs
• Play together
- Add your friends’ unique Moshlings to your collection
- Send your friends gifts
- Visit your friends’ homes to see who has the best items and rooms
- Browse your friends’ moshling collection
• Solve puzzles, play fun mini-games, collect items
- 19 fun mini-games including: Potion Commotion, Glumpageddon, Flick ‘n’ Mix, Moshi Slide, Math Mash, Monster Maze, Time Tangle, Ice Scream Parlour
- Learn as you earn Rox: memory, maths, spelling, shapes, mazes, geography, telling the time
- Take a spin on the Wheel of Moshiness for daily rewards
- Custom Moshling house with expandable floors, updated decorations and room items
- Moshi Shopping Mall with Snozzle Wobbleson’s Grossery Store & Dewy’s DIY Shop
Moshi Monsters Egg Hunt is free to play with your parent’s permission.
• SAFETY and COPPA compliance
We do NOT automatically collect personal information through this App. To save game data, users are be required to create an account and submit an email and password.
• Customer Service
We create worlds that fire the imagination. If you have any questions or recommendations please get in touch at egghunt@moshimonsters.com.

bluejetty:00027574:ios.description:
Jot it down.
Enjoy checking it off.
Groceries on the way home. A deadline you don't want to miss. A habit you'd like to keep. Do! Spring Pink gives your everyday to-dos a touch of pink: add a task, then double-tap when it's done.
■ A thought, a note, a satisfying checkoff
Catch a task while it's on your mind. Finished? Double-tap to mark it done. Even a small task deserves that little moment of satisfaction.
■ Make it a list you like coming back to
Choose your themes and fonts, with sounds inspired by pen and paper. Like picking a favorite notebook, make your daily list feel like yours.
■ A place for every part of your day
Keep work, study and shopping in their own groups. Add color to tell things apart, and pin the tasks you want to keep in sight.
■ Less to remember, every time around
Set tasks to repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. Add reminders for the things you don't want to miss.
■ A quick look from your home screen
Keep your to-dos close with home screen widgets. Check your list during a busy morning without opening the app.
■ Put your keyboard to work
Use an external keyboard to add tasks and give longer notes room to breathe.
• Add a task: Command(⌘) + N
• Insert a line break: Option(⌥/Alt) + Enter
■ Your list, on your other devices
Use the same app and sign in with the same account to sync your tasks across devices. Pick up your familiar list when you switch devices.
■ App lock and backups
Lock access to the app with a passcode or Face ID on supported devices. Back up your data through Dropbox or email and restore it when needed.
It doesn't have to be a big plan.
Start with one thing you'd like to do today.
■ About ads
This app includes ads. An in-app purchase is available to remove them.
Questions and suggestions: do@simplerion.com

bluejetty:00149268:ios.description:
Можно легко выбрать авторов и лекции по темам. Во время прослушивания можно ещё и читать лекцию, или просто читать, если нет возможности слушать. Можно отложить интересные лекции в папку «Избранное», чтобы послушать потом. В папке «Сохранённое» хранятся все скачанные лекции. 
Ещё можно напомнить себе, какие лекции не были прослушаны до конца, (если пойти в папку История прослушиваний там виден процент). Можно выбрать лекции, которые очень понравились, если кликнуть на звездочку.
Всё свое теперь с собой
Можно пройти регистрацию прямо в приложении, если еще нет аккаунта на сайте «АудиоВеда».
Удобная закачка файлов
- Можно скачивать лекции прямо в память мобильного устройства, и пополнить свою библиотеку через мобильный интернет в метро или сидя в кафе, где есть WiFi. И больше никаких проводов и потерь времени на перетаскивание файлов туда-сюда! +

bluejetty:00145616:ios.description:
A simple alarm clock app that supports a weekly schedule of alarms.
Set your favorite music as your wake-up alarm, and start your day feeling great!
ALARM FUNCTIONS:
- Snooze (3 - 30 minutes)
- Vibration
- Fade in alarm
- Weekly scheduling
OTHER FEATURES:
- Sleep timer (sleep music)
- 12 hour and 24 hour time format
- Vertical and horizontal modes
MORNING:
Use music of your choice or select one of the preset alarms to wake up happy and smiling.
EVENING:
Relax and fall asleep to the sound of your favorite song or one of the preset sleep music.
APP FEATURES:
It has a feature that allows you to listen to sleeping music when you are ready to retire for the night.
Through this feature, users can be smoothly lead off to sleep.
WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:
The planning for this app started when we happened to hear from a nursery school teacher that, "The children always sleep well on rainy days."
Through further investigation, we heard the same thing, not just from other nursery school teachers, but many mothers as well.
But, through what mechanism this was happening by remained unclear. There are various theories, such as an atmospheric pressure theory (it was due to low atmospheric pressure), a light intensity theory (it was due to the sky being dark and cloudy), and a sound theory (it was due to the sound of rain being close to an f/1 tremor).
We decided to focus on the sound theory and added a feature, to a basic alarm clock app that plays sleeping music, such as the sound of rain.

-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TruCommunity Bank app, you must be enrolled as a TruCommunity Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00177111:ios.description:

- Drag and drop similar horses to create new mysterious creatures

- Open ended gameplay: enjoy the freedom!
- No horses were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Is my voice a little horse?

bluejetty:00075007:ios.description:
An updated, handcrafted game about fishing with guns, chainsaws & toasters.
Follow Billy as he tries to find redemption from his uncertain past. Chase your destiny on the high seas and embark on a heroic quest for gills and glory.
An all-new 3D Ridiculous Fishing built from the ground up by the original award-winning team, with new features:
+ Gorgeous 3D art
+ An all new Pro Fishing Tour endgame mode
+ Exclusive new content
+ Leaderboards
+ Total rewrite from the ground up
+ All new guest fish
+ BikBok™
Based on Vlambeer’s popular 2013 original, Ridiculous Fishing was lovingly handcrafted over the course of two years by Vlambeer (Super Crate Box, Nuclear Throne), Zach Gage (SpellTower, Knotwords, Good Sudoku, Really Bad Chess, Card of Darkness) and Greg Wohlwend (Threes, Hundreds, TumbleSeed), and remade in collaboration with KO_OP (GNOG, Winding Worlds).
Winner of the Apple Design Award 2013; Nominated for the 2011 Independent Games Festival Awards; Declared Most Important News Story 2011 by industry magazine Control International; Featured in The New York Times
Praise for the original *Ridiculous Fishing*:
"Ridiculous Fishing is such a complete package that it's an effortless recommendation." ~ Eli Hodapp (TouchArcade) - (5 / 5)
"Every aspect of the game, from the rewarding upgrade system to the unique graphics, displays an intricate craftsmanship we rarely see on the App Store." ~ Chris Reed (Slide2Play) - (4 / 4)
"Vlambeer's game is, as its title suggests, ridiculous. In its simple, gleeful rhythms of play, it's sublime, too." ~ EDGE - (9 / 10)
"One of the most mechanically satisfying experiences you'll ever find, and wrapped in a dazzlingly cool aesthetic." ~ Eli Cymet (Gamezebo) - (5 / 5)
"It makes the mass destruction of innocent sea life absolutely adorable." ~ Andrew Webster (The Verge)
"I've come to think of Ridiculous Fishing as the unofficial game of Wes Anderson's movie The Life Aquatic." ~ Rob Hearn (PocketGamer)
"Ridiculous Fishing is from an alternate iPhone gaming universe where Nintendo is the production quality standard and action is everything." ~ Robert Ashley (A Life Well Wasted)
"A rare pearl amidst the endless sardines of iOS games." ~ Chris Bateman (International Hobo)
"I'm hooked up to an IV and playing Ridiculous Fishing. One is medicine, the other is a painkiller." ~ Ben Kuchera (PA Report)
"Ridiculous Fishing is something very special." ~ exp. Magazine

bluejetty:00026843:ios.description:
A game booster that actually works! Say goodbye to game latency, and reach your real gaming potential! 
GearUP is the ultimate gaming companion, accelerating and safeguarding your network. With our patented technology and specialized servers worldwide, we provide gamers around the world with lightning-fast, stable gaming connections. 
► Maximum Performance 
A game booster that actually reduces game lag! We utilize real, patented server technology to set up a better network environment for your device. 
► Minimal Requirements
Our technology ensures that our game booster does not cause higher data usage, higher battery usage or overheating. Perfect for gaming on the go!
► Boost any Game
You can boost popular MOBA games such as Brawl Stars and Mobile Legends, the most-played shooter games like Free Fire, PUBGM and CODM and many other games! We also support all Roblox minigames!
► Patented Technology 
We provide an exclusive path for you to connect directly to the game server! No need to compete with other gamers for the usual congested route, ensuring lower latency and hence lower ping.
► FPS Stability Optimization
Delivers smoother and more stable visuals. With smart boosting technology, it helps stabilize FPS to keep your gameplay consistently smooth in every battle.
► Guaranteed Results
With years of experience building network tools under our belt, we deliver results . We work closely with network service providers in each country to ensure we provide only the best routes to users around the world.
► Easy to use 
Never used a game accelerator before? Worry not! Select the game you wish to play, and click boost. As easy as just one click!
► Free Trial & Subscription
Try before you buy with a free trial and flexible subscription options.
If you’re enjoying a free trial, you will be charged on the last day of your free trial.
Your subscription will renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the expiration date.
Easily manage your subscription and cancel anytime through your App Store account settings.

You are welcome to read Subscription Terms here: https://mobile.booster.gearupportal.com/happ/statement/subscription

GearUP is the ultimate gaming companion, accelerating and safeguarding your network. With our patented technology and specialized servers worldwide, we provide gamers around the world with lightning-fast, stable gaming connections. 

► Maximum Performance 
A game booster that actually reduces game lag! We utilize real, patented server technology to set up a better network environment for your device. 

► Minimal Requirements
Our technology ensures that our game booster does not cause higher data usage, higher battery usage or overheating. Perfect for gaming on the go!

► Boost any Game
You can boost popular MOBA games such as Brawl Stars and Mobile Legends, the most-played shooter games like Free Fire, PUBGM and CODM and many other games! We also support all Roblox minigames!

► Patented Technology 
We provide an exclusive path for you to connect directly to the game server! No need to compete with other gamers for the usual congested route, ensuring lower latency and hence lower ping.

► FPS Stability Optimization
Delivers smoother and more stable visuals. With smart boosting technology, it helps stabilize FPS to keep your gameplay consistently smooth in every battle.

► Guaranteed Results
With years of experience building network tools under our belt, we deliver results . We work closely with network service providers in each country to ensure we provide only the best routes to users around the world.

► Easy to use 
Never used a game accelerator before? Worry not! Select the game you wish to play, and click boost. As easy as just one click!

► Free Trial & Subscription
Try before you buy with a free trial and flexible subscription options.
If you’re enjoying a free trial, you will be charged on the last day of your free trial.
Your subscription will renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the expiration date.

Purchasing a subscription will result in the forfeiture of any unused portion of a free trial period, if applicable.

bluejetty:00132296:ios.name: Prognosis: Your Diagnosis
bluejetty:00132296:ios.summary: With Prognosis, you can improve your ability to diagnose and immediately manage key clinical presentations associated with a disease, having access to relevant facts and succinct explanations behind the underlying diagnostic and management
bluejetty:00132296:ios.description:
With Prognosis, you can improve your ability to diagnose and immediately manage key clinical presentations associated with a disease, having access to relevant facts and succinct explanations behind the underlying diagnostic and management rationale. 
Prognosis is designed for practicing physicians, medical students, nursing professionals and other healthcare practitioners who love medicine and want to thrive as world-class decision makers. After all, practice makes perfect; and practice can be fun! 
Our catalog offers cases spanning a wide range of medical specialties, all which can be played in minutes. Each case is also accompanied by a concise yet comprehensive discussion of the diagnostic reasoning, as well as and key learning points for you to take home. 
Prognosis cases are based on the actual clinical experiences of more than 200 physicians across 33 specialties. 
New cases are released every week, often in keeping with global endemic and epidemic trends, to help you brush up on the clinical skills that are the need of the hour!
- Best App for Health & Well Being - World Summit Awards, 2012 (https://www.worldsummitawards.org/winner/prognosis-your-diagnosis/).
- 'Dr House for Doctors' - Discover Magazine (https://www.discovermagazine.com/technology/hot-science-18).
- 'One of the five best apps for doctors' - Bulletin of The Royal College of Surgeons of England, Volume: 94 Issue: 1 (https://publishing.rcseng.ac.uk/doi/abs/10.1308/147363512X13189526438558).
IMPORTANT: Prognosis: Your Diagnosis is designed for use by medical professionals and students. It is not intended for use by patients or for self-diagnosis.

bluejetty:00141162:ios.name: Magic World: The Elven Quest
bluejetty:00141162:ios.summary: In "Magic World: The Elven Quest", the once flourishing elven kingdom is close to ruin. Dark forces are taking over, destroying its vitality and turning its lush lands into a barren wasteland. You are the realm's last hope, a strategic geni
bluejetty:00141162:ios.description:
In "Magic World: The Elven Quest", the once flourishing elven kingdom is close to ruin. Dark forces are taking over, destroying its vitality and turning its lush lands into a barren wasteland. You are the realm's last hope, a strategic genius on a vital mission to restore the Wells of Life—ancient energy sources now tainted. Journey through 17 varied maps, each requiring careful decisions that shape the fate of your quest. Engage in strategic battles to defeat enemies and use powerful magic to control the battlefield. Your strategic skills are key to saving the kingdom, requiring sharp thinking and a strong dedication to rescue the elven lands from the ever-present darkness.
DISCOVER THE WORLD THROUGH 17 MAPS
Embark on an epic journey across diverse biomes on horseback in this immersive mobile strategy game. Explore 17 unique maps, each filled with rich resources, formidable foes, and mysteries waiting to be uncovered.
ENGAGE IN TURN-BASED BATTLES
Test your strategic acumen with thrilling turn-based combat. Deploy your units wisely, harness powerful spells, and outmaneuver your enemies to achieve victory in this engaging mobile strategy game.
DUEL IN THE ARENAS
Enter the arenas and duel other players to climb the leaderboards. Show off your tactical prowess and earn your place among the legends.
MASTER THE ART OF MAGIC
Collect and master a variety of spells as you progress. Use magic to heal the land, strengthen your heroes, and turn the tide of battle in your favor.
LEVEL UP YOUR HEROES AND UNITS
As you explore and conquer, your heroes and units gain experience. Level them up to unlock new abilities and enhance their combat effectiveness.
WEEKLY EVENTS AND UNIQUE CHALLENGES
Participate in weekly events offering unique challenges and rewards. Each event brings new content, ensuring that the adventure never gets old.
EXPLORE MYSTERIOUS DUNGEONS
Dare to delve into shadowy dungeons scattered across the land. Overcome dark forces guarding precious loot that can boost your journey.
"Magic World" is a sequel to the popular "Magic War Legends" released in 2018, offering an additional captivating storyline. Join the adventure and be the hero the kingdom needs!
