bluejetty:00077119:ios.name: One Medical
bluejetty:00077119:ios.summary: One Medical is reimagining the doctor’s office. Our app makes it easy to get primary care for your body and mind right from your phone. Need to schedule an appointment with your doctor? Request a prescription renewal? Get answers to a medic
bluejetty:00077119:ios.description:
One Medical is reimagining the doctor’s office. Our app makes it easy to get primary care for your body and mind right from your phone. Need to schedule an appointment with your doctor? Request a prescription renewal? Get answers to a medical question in the middle of the night? With One Medical, your doctor’s office is at your fingertips, 24/7.
Here’s some of what you can do in our app:
• Schedule an in-office or remote visit in a state where we have offices
• Get 24/7 on-demand care nationwide with Treat Me Now and Urgent Video Chat at no extra cost
• Receive reminders for upcoming visits and service recommendations
• Send and receive secure messages with a provider
• Request prescription refills and renewals
• Access your health records and care plans
• Sync your data with Apple Health
• Manage bills, copays, and insurance
• Find offices close to where you live, work, and travel
Only One Medical members can access the app. Download the app and join One Medical today.
About One Medical
We’re a membership-based primary care practice designed around your needs and your life. We accept most major health insurance plans, including Medicare. Our providers take the time to get to know you and work with you on your health goals, so you feel seen, heard, and cared for. We have primary care offices in many U.S. cities and offer 24/7 on-demand virtual care, so exceptional care is always within reach — from preventive care and mental health to illnesses and injuries.
All One Medical patients enjoy:
• Compassionate providers who take time to listen
• Appointments that start on time
• Drop-in lab services at One Medical offices
• Referrals to top specialists when needed
Learn more about membership at onemedical.com or ask your employer if One Medical is one of your employee benefits.

bluejetty:00115991:ios.description:
Discover a helpful tool for skin self-monitoring, designed to support awareness and early attention to skin changes. Try it and start checking your skin today.
With just a quick scan, the app helps users recognize visual patterns that may be associated with common skin conditions, such as moles, rashes, or irritations. You'll receive general information based on visual similarities with reference images and can save your scans to track skin changes over time.
AI Skin Scanner is intended to support early skin awareness and encourage users to seek timely medical advice when needed.
No appointments, no waiting — take a convenient first step in monitoring your skin right from your phone.
Disclaimer:
AI Skin Scanner is a pre-diagnostic self-assessment tool that aims to raise awareness about the visual appearance of skin changes. It is not a medical device for diagnosis or treatment, and it does not replace professional medical evaluation.
Always consult a qualified dermatologist or healthcare provider to interpret any findings, receive a diagnosis, or begin treatment. Using this app is not a substitute for professional care. For any suspicious lesions, unusual changes, or concerns, early consultation with a healthcare professional is essential.

bluejetty:00021183:ios.description:
Had enough of bulky maps and heavy guidebooks? The new free Experience Abu Dhabi mobile app is the easiest and most friendly way to discover the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
Be the first to know about all that the capital has to offer – from attractions and experiences to culture and heritage, from hotel bookings and restaurants to shopping malls, spas, and nail salons. Booking your stay in Abu Dhabi has never been easier. Find fast and easy-to-navigate information on getting to and around the emirate. Want to watch a movie? Find out where you can book a show, or discover fascinating events happening in the emirate through the Abu Dhabi events calendar. Cool off with our water-sports & cruising experiences, be inspired by our architectural wonders, tee-off at one of our great golf courses or have a once-in-a lifetime desert escape.
Everything you need to know about the emirate – searchable, portable and sent straight to your phone.
Why is the Experience Abu Dhabi mobile app the best way to plan your trip to Abu Dhabi?
• Support for 7 languages: English, Arabic, Chinese, German, Italian, French, Russian
• Extensive, up-to-date information on all there is to see & do in Abu Dhabi
• Make the most of your visit to Abu Dhabi and plan the trip of a lifetime with customized itineraries
• Explore events happening in Abu Dhabi through the Abu Dhabi events section.
• Available with a ‘Near Me’ functionality showing you everything within easy reach
• 'Take me there' icon to help you with navigating to locations no matter where you are on your trip
• Comprehensive, easy-to-navigate map
• Full listings of hotels, restaurants, spas and nail salons with filters to find what’s best for you
• Make your hotel booking straight from the app
• Mark your Favorites and see them in a single page
• Integrated TripAdvisor reviews for all locations, hotels and restaurants
• Inspiring video and photo galleries
• Option to share your trip experience from the app
• Push notifications: Get instant access to all that’s new in Abu Dhabi and make sure you don't miss any destination updates
We want you to have the best experience possible and we take your feedback very seriously. Something not working to your liking? Want to see a new feature? Let us know your comments on
feedback-mobile@visitabudhabi.ae
Please also take the time to rate our application and post a review in the App store.
Enjoy your trip and we hope you have a great time in Abu Dhabi!

bluejetty:00022809:ios.description:
HKBUS - Hong Kong Bus
Check real-time arrival information for major bus operators across Hong Kong, including KMB, Long Win, Citybus, New Lantao Bus, Green Minibus, and MTR Bus.
HKBUS provides a clean, straightforward way to find routes, bus stops, and live arrival times for daily commutes and journeys around Hong Kong.
Key Features
• Major Operator Coverage: KMB, Long Win, Citybus, New Lantao Bus, Green Minibus, and MTR Bus
• Route Overview: Browse route numbers, directions, operators, service times, and complete stop sequences
• Trip Planning: Find direct and one-transfer bus journeys with fares, walking distances, and transfer details
• Filter and Sort: Compare journeys by fare or walking distance and filter for same-stop transfers
• Nearby Stops: Find bus stops and routes near your current location
• Route Maps: View complete routes and stop locations on a map
• Favorites and Groups: Save frequently used stops and journey combinations in custom groups
• Browsing History: Quickly revisit previously viewed routes
• Live Arrivals: Refresh arrival information and view upcoming buses
• Widgets: Check saved arrival times from your Home Screen
• Custom Themes: Personalize the app with a selection of themes
• Flexible Keyboard: Use the HKBUS quick keyboard or the system keyboard
• Bilingual Interface: Traditional Chinese and English
Contact Us
For questions, feedback, or suggestions, email:
hkbus.contacts@gmail.com
Data Sources
Arrival and route information is provided by Hong Kong government open-data services and relevant transport operators. Actual services and arrival times may change due to traffic and operating conditions.
Privacy Policy: https://barneysbro.github.io/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://barneysbro.github.io/terms.html

CoinCheck is your ultimate tool, designed to satisfy your curiosity and enhance your coin collection experience. Discover the true potential of each coin in your collection and unlock a world of numismatic knowledge with just a snap!
How i
bluejetty:00170364:ios.description:
CoinCheck is your ultimate tool, designed to satisfy your curiosity and enhance your coin collection experience. Discover the true potential of each coin in your collection and unlock a world of numismatic knowledge with just a snap!
How it works:
1. Snap or Upload: Begin by taking a photo of the coin with your phone camera or uploading an existing image from your gallery.
2. AI Analysis: Our AI technology quickly analyzes the image, comparing it against a comprehensive database to accurately identify the coin.
3. Instant Results: Within moments, receive detailed information about the coin, including its name, origin, year of issue, and other unique characteristics.
4. Valuation: The AI goes a step further to provide an estimated market value, helping you understand the worth of your coin in real-time.
This process is designed to be both intuitive and efficient, making it easy for anyone, from casual enthusiasts to serious collectors, to uncover the rich stories and values of their coins with minimal effort.
Key features:
• Fast and accurate coin recognition
• Know the price and value of your coins
• Identify rare coins
• Extensive information about coins from all over the globe
• Categorize and track your collection
• Up-to-date reference prices
• Easy-to-use interface
CoinCheck is your gateway to the fascinating world of numismatics, suitable for collectors at all levels of expertise. Download now and start discovering the unique stories and values of each coin in your collection.

bluejetty:00121998:ios.description:
ServusTV On – Jederzeit. Überall. Kostenlos.
ServusTV On ist deine Plattform für Streaming. Hier siehst du die FIFA Fussball-Weltmeisterschaft 2026, Formel 1, MotoGP, WSBK, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Conference League, DTM und Tennis kostenlos und von überall. Dokumentationen, Filme und Talkshows runden das Angebot der frei verfügbaren Inhalte ab. Nachrichten, Reportagen und das tägliche Wetter informieren dich über die Geschehnisse in Österreich und der Welt.*
FUSSBALL: FIFA FUSSBALL-WELTMEISTERSCHAFT 2026 und UEFA-Bewerbe im Livestream
Die FIFA Fussball-Weltmeisterschaft 2026 gibt es bei ServusTV On im Livestream. Mit insgesamt 52 Live-Spielen aus den USA, Kanada und Mexiko steht ein heißer Fußball-Sommer auf dem Programm! Außerdem bringen wir dir die UEFA Europa League und UEFA Conference League live. Nach den Livestreams stehen dir die Highlights der UEL und UECL noch auf Abruf zur Verfügung. Interviews, Berichte und Reportagen runden das Angebot beim Fußball ab.
SPORT: MotoGP, Formel 1 und Tennis im Livestream
Der beste Sport an einem Ort: Mit über 30 verschiedenen Sportarten ist ServusTV On deine Heimat für Sport-Streaming. Motorsport (F1, MotoGP, WSBK, WRC, DTM), Tennis und vieles mehr erwarten dich – immer kostenlos und mit den besten Features. Einfaches zurückspulen während Live-Events? Kein Problem. Nach den Livestreams stehen dir die Highlights der MotoGP, Formel 1 und weiteren Sportereignissen auf Abruf zur Verfügung.
NEWS UND WISSEN: Talks, Nachrichten, Wetter und Meinungen
Neben einem breiten Sportprogramm erwarten dich die bewegendsten Nachrichten, Bilder und Meinungen aus Österreich und der Welt. Wir beleuchten verschiedene Blickwinkel, lassen Experten zu Wort kommen und regen mit spannenden Talkshows zum Nachdenken an. Mit dem Format „Fahndung Österreich“ tauchst du in die Welt des True Crime ein und über den Wissen-Kanal kannst du dich außerdem 24/7 weiterbilden.
NATUR UND KULTUR: Dokus, Filme und Lebensräume
Tauche von Zuhause oder unterwegs in faszinierende Lebensräume ein und entdecke die abgelegensten Winkel unserer Erde. ServusTV On liefert eine einzigartige Welt mit Dokumentationen und Filmen, die dich zum Abenteurer machen. Die Erfolgskonzepte Terra Mater und Bergwelten, atemberaubende Alpinisten Dokus und bewegende Berggeschichten in eigenen Themenkanälen – das ist Streaming.
ÖSTERREICH: Brauchtum, Kulinarik und Handwerk
Mit ServusTV On hast du Österreich und den Alpenraum stets im Blick. Wir rücken Regionen mit ihren Bräuchen und ihrer Lebensart in den Fokus und nehmen dich auf eine spannende Reise durch unser Land mit.
LIVE-TV: Fernsehen von überall
Dank ServusTV On kannst du das lineare Signal rund um die Uhr in der App empfangen und ServusTV immer und überall streamen.
LOGIN: Deine Tür zu weiteren Features
Einloggen zahlt sich aus: Mit einem Login ist es möglich, Sendungen zu folgen und sie auf dem Homescreen der App abzulegen. Außerdem kannst du, bei bereits begonnen Videos, jederzeit weitersehen – und zwar unabhängig von deinem Gerät.
* Der genaue Umfang der Rechte kann von Land zu Land variieren.

bluejetty:00178551:ios.description:
Tiny Calendar is an intuitive smart calendar works with all your calendars. It inherits the simple and clean look of calendars but makes it more accessible, powerful and reliable on your iPhone and iPad. With Tiny Calendar, you can access and manipulate your google calendar events and google tasks more easily, anyway you want.
SMART ENOUGH TO CREATE
Tiny Calendar has features like nature language input, drag and drop, gestures and other smart methods to predict your intention and help you create and edit your events more easily.
SYNC & MANAGE GOOGLE TASKS
You don’t need to download another app to manage Google tasks. 
MULTIPLE WAYS TO VIEW 
Tiny Calendar supports 9 standard views - Forecast, day, week, month, 4-days, year, mini-month, week agenda and agenda. You can instantly switch views to discover events or find a time you're looking for.
REAL-TIME SYNC 
Tiny Calendar syncs directly with all your google calendars and also works with iOS local calendars to supports events on iCloud, Exchange and other calendars.
WORKS OFFLINE 
You can still create, edit and delete events when you don't have an Internet connection. Tiny Calendar will cache your changes and sync back to your calendar account next time you're online. 
ADVANCED REMINDER SYSTEM 
Never forget about a meeting! Tiny Calendar allows you to set reminders via push notification, or email for all events. 
ACCESS FROM EVERYWHERE 
Tiny Calendar works with your iPhone, iPad and iPod touch. You don't need to pay extra money to download multiple copies.
Privacy Policy: https://apps.fengge.io/TinyCalendar/HomePage

bluejetty:00157849:ios.description:
NEW & IMPROVED FOR SPRING 2026! FishingBC is the official app for tidal (saltwater) fishing in British Columbia, created by the Sport Fishing Institute of BC with support from Fisheries and Oceans Canada, and the Pacific Salmon Foundation.
Features:
• Now the FishingBC app replaces the need to carry a paper licence! After linking it with your BC Tidal Waters Sport Fishing Licence, the FishingBC app allows you to permanently record, store, and display mandatory catch information including for Chinook salmon, halibut, and lingcod, as well as provide proof of your current, valid licence.
• Up-to-date, easy-to-view official regulations including closures and contamination areas.
• Updated catch log and species ID to identify and record your catch and access your historical catch data.
• Certified Tidal Angling Guides (CTAG) can now easily complete DFO catch log requirements.
• UBC Enhanced Catch Log provides additional Chinook and Coho catch log information to University of British Columbia researchers.
• Current, location-based weather forecasts including marine synopsis.

bluejetty:00092082:ios.summary:
Send money, easy and reliable
Send money 24/7, it was never easy and simple to do it, with the InterCambio Express APP you get an excellent exchange rate.
Download the InterCambio Express app and start sending money to your family members
bluejetty:00092082:ios.description:
Send money, easy and reliable
Send money 24/7, it was never easy and simple to do it, with the InterCambio Express APP you get an excellent exchange rate.
Download the InterCambio Express app and start sending money to your family members now, from and wherever you want. Choose the exchange rate that suits you best, using SuperSend®.
Send money to more than 19 countries through our website, app, and agent locations, get started now by creating an account, downloading the app, or visiting web page.
FIVE EASY STEPS TO TRANSFER MONEY ACROSS THE GLOBE
Create an Account.
Register an account to send money with us. We’ll need your first and last name and a few other details to get you on your way to sending money in the states and around the globe at the push of a button.
Prepare Your Transfer.
Decide the amount of money you want to send, where you want it to go, and how you want to send it (debit, cash). With our SuperSend® option, you can increase the exchange rate and send more money to your beneficiaries.
Choose a Delivery Option.
Select how your money will be delivered. You have a variety of useful options: you can send money directly to your recipient’s bank account; they can pick up their cash from an ATM (in select countries); they can pick up cash from one of our payer locations; or a courier can deliver cash to your beneficiary (in select countries).
Enter Your Recipient’s Information.
To send money to your recipient, you’ll need their first and last name as displayed on their government-issued ID, as well as their email address and phone number. If you are sending money to the same person, you can use our Resend feature. Simply select their name and hit “Resend.”
Review and send!
Confirm your order details and the money is on the way!
Get text update to help never worry about the status of your transactions with text updates.
LEGAL
Limits and fees on transactions vary based on type of transaction including transaction history, payout location, payment instruments, and delivery method

bluejetty:00145818:ios.description:
Who Are We?
This is Rich Froning and the Mayhem Athlete team from CrossFit Mayhem, the winningest gym in fitness history. We are people just like you who enjoy working out with other people and getting a little better each day. We have just done it for a long time and want to share what we have learned.
Why YOU should Join
Decide today that you can become better than you were yesterday!
We want to welcome you into the Mayhem Family no matter your age or fitness level, whether you have no equipment or a gym full of it. Our Mayhem Family has mom’s, dad’s, time-crunched professionals, competitor’s alike, and many more walks of life!
What We Offer?
Mayhem Athlete offers programming created by the greatest ever for the masses. We offer a number of unique finely tuned programs by the Fittest Man in History and the Mayhem Athlete Team.
We are about developing you as an athlete to reach 100% of the potential you were created for.
We believe in squeezing every ounce out of every workout and every session so you can get the most enjoyment and success in your fitness.
Each program offers a specific plan for athletes across all spectrums of fitness levels so no matter where you are in your experience, you can find value and benefit from one of our plans.
What We Believe?
Our core values are Faith, Family, Fitness, and Service.
Join us as we learn to better live into this way of life and enjoy the gift of fitness each day.
Please let us know as soon as possible so we can proceed forward. Do not hesitate if you have any questions!

bluejetty:00061040:ios.description:
Covve is the personal CRM for people whose relationships drive their life and career. Every week it shows you who to get in touch with, remembers the details that matter, and keeps them private. No deals, no pipelines: just the people who matter to you.
▶ Know who to reach out to this week ◀
• One short weekly list of people to get in touch with, so you always know your next step without a flood of notifications.
• Set your own rhythm for each person: every few weeks, months or quarters.
▶ Remember what matters about everyone ◀
• Private notes on every contact: where you met, what you talked about, their family and milestones.
• Add a note in seconds, right after a meeting or a call.
▶ Less data entry ◀
• Offload data entry: email your Covve assistant and it does the typing for you, 24/7.
• Start with the contacts already on your phone.
▶ Private by design. Only you hold the key ◀
• Everything you note about people is encrypted on your device, and only you hold the key.
• It reaches our servers already encrypted, so not even Covve can read it.
• No ads, and we never sell your data. Your network is yours.
▶ Organize your network your way ◀
• Tags for clients, investors, mentors, friends and family: however you think about your network.
• Weekly and monthly stats and streaks that help you make staying in touch a habit.
▶ Also included ◀
• Draft a personal catch-up email in seconds, then edit and send.
• Scan business cards straight into your contacts.
• Create and share your own digital business card, even from a widget.
Recognized by:
• "A simple yet state-of-the-art app that will revolutionize your business relationships like you've never seen" – Inc.
• "Best contacts app" – Tom's Guide (2023)
Questions? support@covve.com

bluejetty:00128908:ios.name: Dungeon of the Endless: Apogee
bluejetty:00128908:ios.summary: Dungeon of the Endless: Apogee is the award-winning Rogue-Like Dungeon-Defense game, in which you and your team of heroes must protect the generator of your crashed ship while exploring an ever-expanding dungeon, all while facing waves of m
bluejetty:00128908:ios.description:
Dungeon of the Endless: Apogee is the award-winning Rogue-Like Dungeon-Defense game, in which you and your team of heroes must protect the generator of your crashed ship while exploring an ever-expanding dungeon, all while facing waves of monsters and special events as you try to find your way out. The Apogee Edition of Dungeon Of The Endless includes the full game and five DLCs.
WHAT’S BEHIND THE DOOR?
A few hundred condemned criminals were being shipped to the Auriga system on board the prison hulk “Success”. While this was presented as a chance to earn back their place in society by working hard for the common good, they understood that in fact they would be slave labour, sent to colonize an unexplored planet. All they knew about Auriga Prime was what the probes told them: it had water, temperate zones, plant life, and plenty of metals in the crust.
In fact, the planet Auriga once hosted a major settlement of the galaxy-travelling ancestors known as the Endless. In addition, the planet was still orbited by a functioning (and well cloaked) defensive system, which sprang eagerly to life upon the arrival of the Success. Within a few minutes, the ship was nothing but a few large chunks of metal falling toward the planet.
Luckily, every set of holding cells also functioned as an escape pod, so the ship let itself disintegrate and the surviving prisoners fell bruised but (temporarily) alive and (momentarily) safe to the planet below. Safe, that is, until they realized that they had crashed through some sort of Endless facility, all the way down to a sub-basement so deep and ancient it might as well be called a dungeon…
Gather A Team
• Form a team of heroes, each with their own strengths (and psychoses)
• Equip them, deploy them, and earn powerful abilities
• Manage the balance between ex-prison inmates and guards
Build Your Defenses
• Use the Dust you gather to power the rooms
• Use scarce resources to help your team survive
• Build minor and major modules to hold off waves of monsters
• Decode Endless ruins to discover life-saving technologies
Open the Door
• Each door is a danger; prepare yourself and your team for anything
• Explore and discover an infinity of levels and layouts
• Carry your crystal through waves of monsters to the exit of each level
• Fight your way to the surface to discover the truth about Auriga
The Apogee Edition includes the following add-ons
• DEEP FREEZE: New ship, New game mode and New character
• DEATH GAMBLE: New merchant
• RESCUE TEAM: Three new characters, New monsters, New major module
• ORGANIC MATTERS: New ship, New game mode, New character, New minor modules, New monsters
• BOOKWORM: New ship, New character
Carefully Redesigned for Mobile
• Revamped interface
• Cloud Save 
• Pay once to get the full Dungeon of the Endless: Apogee game and 5 DLCs! No ads, no in-app purchases!
If you experience any issue with Dungeon of the Endless: Apogee, please contact our customer support at hello@playdigious.com and give us as much as possible information on your problem.

bluejetty:00120280:ios.description:
Learn Spanish is an easy to use mobile Spanish phrasebook that will give visitors to Spain and those who are interested in learning Spanish a good start in the language. Learn Spanish is recorded using a native speaker and we have tried our best to be authentic in the pronunciation whilst ensuring it is easy to understand. Recommended app for tourists and business people visiting Spain. 
FEATURES 
• Universal app works on iPhone, iPod Touch, & iPad 
• Carefully translated list of essential phrases 
• 200+ common words and phrases included for FREE
• Upgrade and unlock all 800 phrases in 18 categories
• Audio recorded by native speakers
• Option to playback audio at slower speed
• No internet connection required
• Highlight important words with tips
• Store frequently used phrases in favourites
• Search by words inside the app
• No adverts or annoying popups 
HAPPY CUSTOMERS 
"This app does a really good job of getting one up to speed on SURVIVING while traveling in Spanish speaking countries. I knew very little Spanish before leaving for Madrid but I was able to fake my way through Spain with a few compliments along the way. Well worth the price of the upgrade."
- LMCL-Boo
Estupendo 
"I am 11 and I learned in 2 days" - Ariel Nicole l.
CATEGORIES 
FREE Categories: 
* Greetings 
* General conversation 
* Numbers 
* Directions and places 
* Transportation 
* Eating out 
* Emergency
PRO Categories: 
* Accommodation 
* Time and date 
* Shopping 
* Colours 
* Towns and provinces 
* Countries 
* Tourist attractions 
* Family 
* Dating 
* Feeling sick 
* Tongue twisters 
• HOW TO RESTORE PURCHASES? 
Purchases are one-time and carry over between devices. To restore your purchases on a new device, tap on PRO badge on one of the locked categories, tap on the Restore Purchase button. Even if you forget to do this step and try to buy the app again, it will be restored for free. 
• WE READ EVERY E-MAIL. 
We're a small company, but we reply to every support request. Let us try to help at support@codegent.com and we will do our best to help in any way! 
THANKS FOR ALL THE SUPPORT IF YOU LIKE THE APP PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW :-)

bluejetty:00148656:ios.description:
StoReel – Discover Stories Beyond the Ordinary
StoReel brings you original short dramas that go beyond everyday viewing. Discover engaging series and diverse storytelling voices — all delivered in bite-sized episodes designed for modern life.
Why StoReel?
Original Short Dramas:
Explore exclusive StoReel originals crafted by emerging creators and global storytellers. Our series spotlight diverse characters, fresh perspectives, and genres that break away from traditional formats.
Short and Sweet:
Each 1–2 minute episode delivers suspense, romance, emotion, and unexpected twists — perfect for quick sessions or back-to-back viewing.
Diverse Stories, Global Voices:
From romance to suspense, StoReel celebrates stories across cultures, backgrounds, and experiences — expanding what short-form drama can be.
Fan Community & Discussion:
Share reactions, debate plot twists, and connect with viewers who love the same stories.
Character Interaction:
Engage with characters from StoReel originals through interactive in-app features designed to enhance your viewing experience.
Flexible Viewing Options:
Unlock episodes individually or access selected content through ads — choose how you want to watch.
Download StoReel and explore short-form storytelling.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the selected plan price. You can manage and cancel subscriptions anytime in your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00174999:ios.name: Hello Weather
bluejetty:00174999:ios.summary: Hello Weather gives you beautiful, trustworthy forecasts powered by the best weather data on Earth. With hyperlocal real-time info and a joyful design that’s easy to read at a glance, you’ll always be prepared for whatever’s coming your way
bluejetty:00174999:ios.description:
Hello Weather gives you beautiful, trustworthy forecasts powered by the best weather data on Earth. With hyperlocal real-time info and a joyful design that’s easy to read at a glance, you’ll always be prepared for whatever’s coming your way.
APP OF THE DAY 2026 + featured globally since 2018
"One of my very favorites in recent years. It’s attractive, original, and highly useful."
— Daring Fireball
Five reasons why you’ll love planning your day with Hello Weather...
1. All the info you need is right in your face.
Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, minute-by-minute rain, and weather alerts, all in a design you can read in seconds. Everything you need, nothing you don’t.
2. Simple on the surface. Details one tap away.
Sometimes you need to dig deeper. Is it going to be windy enough to fly a kite today? When’s the best time to go? Just tap the wind card (or any other stat) for a super friendly chart showing what’s up.
3. Forecasts so advanced, they might be fivecasts.
Switch from Apple Weather to ultra-detailed forecasts from the world’s best data providers, like The Weather Channel, AccuWeather, and Foreca. Pick the source that works best for your area, or switch back and forth to compare.
4. You don’t need to be a weather expert.
What does barometric pressure mean? Is the dewpoint good or bad? We translated those esoteric stats into human words, so you’ll know how it really feels outside.
5. It’ll make you smile.
We filled the app with tons of thoughtful little touches to brighten your day. You’ll love the beautiful color themes, automatic night mode, and sweet secret extras.
And that’s not all…
• Hello Weather works everywhere, from your phone to your wrist.
Great on iPhone and iPad, with widgets, notifications, and a full Apple Watch app to keep you updated on the go. It speaks 27 languages, too.
• Radar’s built right in.
When there’s a storm front ahead, we’ve got your back. Our powerful radar tab shows you exactly what’s headed your way.
• You can have it your way.
Tune your app’s layout and appearance to your heart’s content. Pick custom icon sets, themes, charts, data points, or tweak fiddly details if you want.
• Made with care by a tiny indie company.
We pour a lot of love into our app, and we take great care of our customers. We’re always just an email away, and we’ll get back to you quickly.
Here’s what the experts say:
"It’s so great-looking, and so easy to use, that it’s been my go-to weather app since I discovered it."
— Cult of Mac
"Hello Weather strips it down to the essence."
— Macworld
---
Hello Weather’s free to use, but it’s way better if you upgrade for the Pro stuff.
Free features:
• No ads or gimmicks.
• Easy to read forecasts, powered by Apple Weather.
• Minute-by-minute rain estimates.
• Basic radar.
• Automatic color themes and dark mode.
• Weather units customization, including simultaneous Fahrenheit & Celsius mode.
Upgrade to Pro and get:
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Notifications for rain, severe weather alerts, and future forecasts.
• Apple Watch app and complications.
• More data sources, including The Weather Channel, AccuWeather, Foreca, and others.
• Radar animation and layers.
• Air quality and pollen info (with certain data sources).
• Weather icon sets, themes, and loads of additional customization options.
• Custom app icons.
• Some secret stuff too!
One more thing—a note about privacy:
We’re proud to have the strongest and most transparent privacy policy we can muster. We’ll never track you, sell ads, collect data, or do anything like that.
• Privacy Policy: https://helloweather.com/privacy
• Terms of Use: https://helloweather.com/privacy#terms
Thanks so much for trying Hello Weather! We hope you like it.

bluejetty:00161407:ios.developer: Eonevolve Yazilim Sanayi Ticaret Limited Sirketi
bluejetty:00161407:ios.summary:
Pick, upgrade and ride. Motorcycle Sim: Multi is a realistic motorcycle simulator: split endless highway traffic, ride the city with other riders online and pull wheelies in the stunt map.
RIDE IN COCKPIT VIEW
Feel every gear from the firs
bluejetty:00161407:ios.description:
Pick, upgrade and ride. Motorcycle Sim: Multi is a realistic motorcycle simulator: split endless highway traffic, ride the city with other riders online and pull wheelies in the stunt map.
RIDE IN COCKPIT VIEW
Feel every gear from the first-person camera, with a working speedometer and rev counter on the dash. Switch to the third-person view any time and watch your motorbike lean through traffic.
SPLIT THE TRAFFIC
Weave through cars and jeeps on an endless highway, through tunnels and over bridges. Every car you pass adds to your score.
OUTRUN THE POLICE
A police helicopter is on your tail from the start. Keep the throttle open and do not let it catch you.
RIDE ONLINE
Join a multiplayer room and ride with motorcycle riders from around the world.
WHEELIES, DRIFTS AND STUNTS
Pull wheelies and drift slides, then take your bike to the stunt map. Missions for wheelies, drifts, distance and overtakes keep every ride going.
COLLECT 15 BIKES
Sport bikes, naked bikes, classics, a cruiser, a tourer, a scooter and a dirt bike. Every motorbike has its own top speed, power and brakes, and new bikes unlock as you level up.
UPGRADE YOUR BIKE
Upgrade speed, power, acceleration and brakes, and climb the bike classes from C all the way to S.
YOUR GARAGE
Step into the new 3D garage with a podium and spotlight, change your rim colour and make your bike yours. Start small and work your way up to the fastest sport bikes in the game.
THREE MAPS
City: busy streets, open riding and online riders.
Highway: endless traffic, long straights, tunnels and bridges.
Stunt: ramps and a park made for tricks.
REAL ENGINE SOUND
The engine climbs through every gear and the traffic roars past, so you hear the speed before you see it.
REWARDS EVERY DAY
Daily rewards, chests after your runs and new bikes as you level up keep every session worth it.
Contains optional in-app purchases and ads.
Your reviews shape every update: tell us what you want to ride next.

bluejetty:00157630:ios.description:
Magic trading card game database is the premier iOS application for everything Magic. With its advanced grid view you can browse cards quicker than any other application. Now updated for iOS 26 with the new Liquid Glass design, dark mode, and improved performance throughout.
MTG card database allows for editing and saving multiple searches, saving you from having to re-enter them each time you launch the app.
FREE FEATURES:
 - Advanced search & browse options.
 - Life counter with player customization, textured backgrounds, undo/redo history, and multiplayer support.
 - Searchable by name, description, expansion, rarity, colors, artist & others.
 - Sort by name, price, rarity, collector number, and more.
 - Browse keyword abilities with quick-jump section index.
 - Small app size & image caching for improved performance.
 - Offline mode by pre-caching images.
 - Large grid for multiple card viewing.
 - Details laid out in an easy access view with all printings available.
 - Full-screen image viewer with pinch zoom and swipe-to-dismiss.
 - Bulk import — paste a card list to quickly build a deck.
 - Deck collections with 2-column card grid, mana curve stats, average CMC, and land counts.
 - Accessibility support with VoiceOver labels and hints.
 - Light and dark mode support.
 PREMIUM FEATURES (Requires IAP):
 - Access to the latest five sets.
 - Price guide that is updated often with stale cache detection.
 - Automatic updating card database with version tracking.
 - Unlimited deck collections.
 - Monthly and yearly subscription options.
All prices are courtesy of TCGplayer.com

bluejetty:00069861:ios.description:
Collide is the game of sliding and blending colors. The unique gameplay will challenge your problem-solving skills and encourage creativity.
Each level consists of colored tiles placed on an 8x8 grid. Navigate tiles around the board to fill their corresponding targets. Some tiles blend into new colors, while others can assist each other to their targets.
The puzzles range from relaxing to mind-bending; play through puzzle packs in whichever order suits you! How many puzzles can you solve?
~~~~~~~~~~
Features:
- 160 FREE puzzles
- REPLAY puzzles to find perfect solutions
- ZERO ads
- NO time limits or lives
How to play:
- Swipe in any of the four directions (up, down, left, right) to slide tiles
- Walls and targets do not slide
- Use up all of the tiles and fill all of the targets
- Primary colors combine into secondary colors
- Secondary colors only combine with the same color
- Play the Tutorial Turquoise pack for more details!

bluejetty:00027769:ios.name: beurer HealthManager Pro
bluejetty:00027769:ios.summary: Smart health management for you every day. With beurer HealthManager Pro you always have an overview of your health data - simple, secure and clear. Track your values, identify trends and take your health management to the next level – all
bluejetty:00027769:ios.description:
Smart health management for you every day. With beurer HealthManager Pro you always have an overview of your health data - simple, secure and clear. Track your values, identify trends and take your health management to the next level – all from the comfort of your app.
Supports over 40 Bluetooth-/WIFI-enabled devices and more than 85 Scan & Save devices 
More than 4 stars with 25,000+ reviews
1 million+ satisfied users 
More than 25 languages
ALL-IN-ONE SOLUTION
COMPATIBLE WITH MORE THAN 125 BEURER PRODUCTS
Connect your app with products for tracking blood pressure, blood glucose, ECG, weight, pulse oximetry and temperature.
ALL MEASURED DATA IN ONE PLACE
Keep track of all your health data - whether on the go or at home.
Sort your measured values based on reference values, track your trends in clear, easy-to-understand graphs and set your own goals. Add short comments if needed to better clarify specific details.
SCAN & SAVE: TRANSFER DATA QUICKLY AND EASILY
Simply scan your measured values for blood pressure, blood glucose and temperature with the smartphone camera and the results are saved in the app - without Bluetooth®.
MANAGE AND KEEP TRACK OF MEDICATIONS VIA APP
Save your medications in the “medication cabinet” and simply add it to your measurements - so you never forget whether and when you took your tablets and can interpret your measured values correctly.
PERFECTLY PREPARED: SHARE MEASURED VALUES WITH YOUR DOCTOR
Collect your values and send them by email to your doctor or healthcare professional, for example. Export your data clearly and selectively as a PDF or CSV file, if you want to evaluate the data yourself.
YOUR HEALTH DATA DIRECTLY IN APPLE HEALTH
Use the beurer HealthManager Pro in combination with the health app of your choice and transfer data such as weight, blood pressure, activity, sleep, pulse, temperature and pulse oximeter values.
OPTIMAL SUPPORT FOR A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE (ADDITIONAL SERVICE SUBJECT TO A CHARGE)
Start a healthier everyday routine with “beurer MyHeart”. Access 30 days of our suggestions, healthy recipes, exciting information and daily inspiration, and integrate more wellbeing into your life little by little.
EASILY ANALYSE ECG MEASUREMENTS AT HOME (ADDITIONAL SERVICE SUBJECT TO A CHARGE)
Use “beurer MyCardio Pro” to enable immediate professional evaluation of your ECG measurements at home. Get an instant detailed analysis and report that you can easily share with your doctor.
TRANSFER APP DATA
Conveniently move your data from “beurer HealthManager” to “beurer HealthManager Pro”. Take everything with you, keep your complete history and benefit from a fast, clear and even smarter app.
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
The app establishes connections with external medical devices (e.g., blood pressure monitors). The app does not use the smartphone’s sensors for measurements.
Compatible medical hardware may require regulatory clearance for use:
Regulatory clearance is available for medical devices for EU/EEA, CH, UK, US, CA, AR, BO, CR, CO, MX, PE, DZ, IN, IL, SA, AE, AU, ID, MY, SG, KR, TW, TH.
In the following regions, no connected medical device is available and only the non-medical hardware in the app is permitted: TN, EG, AL, AM, AZ, BH, BY, BA, BW, CL, CN, SV, FJ, GE, HN, HK, IS, IQ, JO, KZ, QA, KG, KW, LB, MO, MU, MN, NA, NZ, NG, NO, OM, PK, PA, RU, RS, ZW, ZA, TT, TR, UA, UY, BR, PH, LK.
Please verify the local regulatory requirements for clearance before use.
The app is intended to support health monitoring and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Users should consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.

bluejetty:00182476:ios.summary:
Save on your next trip with the Booking.com app! Find great hotel or apartment deals and book in just a few minutes. You can also book flights, rental cars, and more through the app.
- Book your whole trip in one app (accommodations, fligh
bluejetty:00182476:ios.description:
Save on your next trip with the Booking.com app! Find great hotel or apartment deals and book in just a few minutes. You can also book flights, rental cars, and more through the app.
- Book your whole trip in one app (accommodations, flights, car rentals, taxis and attractions)
- Stay flexible with free cancellation (available at most properties)
- 24/7 customer service in more than 40 languages
- No booking or credit card fees
- Chat directly with your property in the app
- Enjoy mobile-only discounts by booking in the app
- Use filters to easily find the perfect place out of millions of available accommodations 
- Get paperless confirmation of your reservation 
- Manage your bookings on the go, making changes whenever and wherever you want
- Discover local attractions and make the most of your trip
- Share your experience and get local advice on our Travel Communities forums
Access millions of accommodations
From cozy country homes to funky city apartments, find the perfect place out of millions of available accommodations. Our app offers hotels, apartments, bed and breakfasts and more.
Quickly find the perfect place to stay
Filter hotels by price, review score, WiFi quality, and other things important to you. Search cheap hotels by city, attraction, landmark, or hotel name. Special requests? Pet-friendly hotels? We have filters for everything. You can also compare your favorite accommodation options side by side to ensure you get the best price and quality.
Deals for any budget
Discover daily accommodation deals and save on your next hotel, apartment, or villa booking.
Get exclusive mobile-only discounts of 10% or more on select properties when you book in the app. Find your ideal accommodation at an ideal price.
Stay flexible with free cancellation
Change of plans? Not a problem. You can cancel for free at most hotels, apartments and other properties on Booking.com. And the app makes things even easier — it only takes a few taps to cancel, and you’re free to find a place that better suits your needs.
Last-minute travel
Heading somewhere in a hurry? With the app, you can quickly book hotels at the last minute (as well as far in advance). Finding a place in short order has never been easier. Our app allows you to search for properties nearby, fill in a few details, and secure your reservation. You can also change, cancel, or make additional reservations on the go.
Jet off with the perfect flight
Book domestic or international flights on the go with ease. The app allows you to search thousands of airfare deals per day. Plane tickets available for all major airlines and destinations.
Hit the road with car rentals
Car hire has recently been added to the app. Whether you just need a ride to explore your destination, or you’re going on an epic road trip, the Booking.com app can help. Rent a car from all the major companies and hit the road!
Reserve taxis with ease
Book in advance for a seamless connection from the airport to your destination. You can also book taxis to and from other pick-up points, such as hotels and local attractions.
Find and book a great experience
Whether you’re looking for attraction or museum tickets, boat tours and walking tours, you can book experiences online in minutes, with free cancellation on many options. 
Get and share tips with other travelers
Connect with fellow travelers, share your experiences, and get local advice on the best accommodations, attractions, and more. Discover new experiences and plan your trip with our app.

bluejetty:00148378:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Catholic devotion with the Catholic Rosary app. This powerful tool brings together the essential elements of faith: prayers, rosary audios, daily readings, reflections, novenas, the Saint of the Day, and a vibrant community to support your spiritual journey.
Key Features:
- Rosary Prayers & Audios – Experience the beauty of the Rosary with guided audio, allowing you to meditate on the mysteries anytime, anywhere.
- Catholic Daily Readings & Reflections – Stay spiritually nourished with daily Scripture readings and thoughtful reflections, helping you connect God's Word with your everyday life.
- Guided Novenas – Follow 9-day novenas with daily reminders and progress tracking, so you never lose the thread of your prayer intention.
- Saint of the Day – Discover a new Catholic saint each day, with their biography, feast day, and patronage to inspire your own walk of faith.
- Prayer Audios – Access a curated library of Catholic prayers for every intention, ensuring you always have the perfect words for your devotions.
- Community Connection – Join a like-minded community sharing reflections on the Rosary, daily readings, and prayers.
- General Prayers – Discover prayers for various occasions, helping you draw closer to God throughout your daily life.
- Liturgical Calendar – Follow the Church's liturgical seasons and celebrations, enriching your spiritual journey.
- Daily Devotions – Receive inspirational quotes, reflections, Stations of the Cross, and daily intentions to deepen your relationship with God.
- Multi-language Support – Access prayers and content in multiple languages, fostering inclusivity and universality in faith.
- Flexible Plans – Choose the plan that fits your journey: Monthly, Yearly, or a one-time Lifetime purchase for complete access.
- Simple & Intuitive – Easy navigation ensures a seamless and enriching experience for users of all ages.
Download now to embrace the power of prayer, discover a new saint each day, follow a novena, connect with a loving community, and deepen your Catholic faith through daily readings, reflections, and communion with God.

Unleash your imagination with ArtQ, the ultimate AI-powered studio at your fingertips. Whether you want to generate original artwork, edit your photos with magical precision, or explore inspirations, ArtQ makes creativity effortless and fun.
Download the app now and turn your imagination into stunning visuals!
Key Features:
→ AI Art Generator: Type your idea, choose a style, and watch ArtQ bring your imagination to life as stunning artwork or photos. From fantasy to realism, every vision becomes possible.
→ AI Photo Editor: Upload your photo and tell ArtQ what to change, enhance details, or create wild transformations. Keep refining your image through a natural back-and-forth conversation.

→ Inspiration Library: Browse a curated gallery of AI-generated artworks. Copy prompts, remix styles, and recreate your favorites to spark your own creativity.
→ Instant Save or Share: Download your creations in high quality or share them instantly with friends, family, or your creative community.
→ History of Creations: Never lose track of your creativity. Access your past prompts, edits, and artworks anytime to revisit, refine, or share.
Why ArtQ?
ArtQ isn’t just an app, it’s your personal AI art companion. Whether you’re experimenting with fantasy worlds, enhancing portraits, or just having fun with creative edits, ArtQ empowers you to turn ideas into images effortlessly.
Download ArtQ now and let your imagination dream without limits!

The free version offers limited access. A ArtQ Pro subscription is required to unlock all features and full content.

bluejetty:00026780:ios.summary:

iFIT’s global fitness pla
bluejetty:00026780:ios.description:
Experience immersive cardio & strength workouts you can do anywhere. Whether you’re on a treadmill, bike, elliptical, rower, or just an exercise mat—iFIT has amazing workouts to help you unlock your personal best.
iFIT’s global fitness platform features over 10,000 on-demand workouts, filmed in stunning outdoor locations across all 7 continents. Explore high-intensity cardio, full-body strength, cycling, yoga, Pilates, HIIT, barre, marathon training plans, stretching, walking, and mindfulness, all led by expert trainers.
Millions of people around the world use iFIT to reach their health goals. Whether you’re looking to build strength, improve endurance, boost mobility, or simply move more, iFIT gives you the tools and motivation to chase every fitness goal.
iFIT workouts can be streamed on compatible devices and paired to your machine via Bluetooth®. If you own iFIT-enabled equipment from NordicTrack, ProForm, or Freemotion, your workouts are even more immersive. SmartAdjust™ tech automatically adapts your machine's speed, incline, or resistance to suit your fitness level. iFIT will base future workouts on your recent performance, making incremental changes to keep you progressing.
No equipment? No problem. Many workouts require nothing more than your own bodyweight. Get daily workouts that are personalized based on your fitness level, goals, and progress, so you always know what to do next.
KEY FEATURES
10,000 Workouts (and counting!): Tap into the one of the world’s largest outdoor workout libraries, with progressive series led by expert trainers who guide you to results.
Top Trainers: Unlock your best performance with iFIT’s 180 elite trainers, pro athletes, and world champions who lead you through every workout. Explore workouts led by the cast of Trainer Games!
Stunning Locations: Exercise all around the world, from Everest basecamp to the salt flats of Bolivia, from the redwoods of California to the peaks of the Pyrenees. 
Options for Every Modality: Whether you use free weights, a NordicTrack or ProForm treadmill, bike, elliptical, rower or no equipment at all, iFIT has workouts for every type of training.
Personalized Fitness: Get AI-powered workout recommendations tailored to your fitness goals and schedule, along with accountability and motivation.
Progressive Plans & Programs: Take the guesswork out of your goals with multi-week trainer-led programs, such as running a 5K, working toward a full marathon, or improving overall strength.
Real-Time Responsive: Feel your machine’s incline, resistance, and speed match your on-screen trainer and the terrain of your workout, dropping you deeper into the experience.
Progress Tracking: Visualize your personal workout stats, track your data, and unlock insights in the app or on your iFIT-enabled machine.
Train Anywhere: No equipment needed for iFIT’s bodyweight, yoga, meditation, and cross-training workouts.
Up to 5 Users with iFIT Pro: Share your plan with your family, each with their own personalized experience and workout tracking.
Subscription Options¹
Choose the iFIT plan that fits your fitness needs:
iFIT Train: $14.99/month or $143.99/year with access for 1 user
iFIT Pro: $39.99/month or $394.99/year with access for up to 5 users
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the billing period. Manage your subscription in your account settings.
Paid iFIT Pro membership required with equipment purchase and to access content and features. Membership auto-renews unless cancelled in advance. Free iFIT account, agreement to terms, and wi-fi required to operate equipment.
AI Coach provided via in-app messaging (see here for regional availability). Existing users who enrolled prior to September 2025 and users who opt-in after that date may continue using AI Coach via a text-based service (US only); msg & data rates may apply.
Terms of Use: https://www.ifit.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.ifit.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00167113:ios.name: Reeder.
bluejetty:00167113:ios.summary:
Reeder is your all-in-one inbox for reading, watching and listening to content from various sources.
From Unread Counts to Timeline Syncing
Say goodbye to unread counts! With Reeder, your timeline position is synced across all your devices
bluejetty:00167113:ios.description:
Reeder is your all-in-one inbox for reading, watching and listening to content from various sources.
From Unread Counts to Timeline Syncing
Say goodbye to unread counts! With Reeder, your timeline position is synced across all your devices, letting you pick up right where you left off.
Shared Feeds
Turn any tag into a public, auto-updating feed that can be viewed in any browser or added to any RSS reader that supports JSON feeds, making it simple to share your curated content.
Unified Timeline
Reeder supports more than just RSS feeds. It integrates videos, podcasts and social media posts into a single, streamlined view. While it’s not meant to replace full-featured clients, Reeder offers a centralized way to keep track of everything you follow, with the option to open content in other apps (if supported) when you want to dive deeper.
Filters
Create custom timelines with filters based on keywords, media types or feed types.
Save and Organize Links
Easily save links from Safari or any other app to Reeder using its share extension, keeping everything organized and easy to find.
iCloud Sync
Reeder only syncs what’s important — your subscriptions, timeline position and tagged items (including Links, Favorites, Bookmarks and Later) — across all your devices using iCloud, making syncing faster and more efficient, with changes pushed to your other devices within seconds. Content is fetched directly from the sources, ensuring you always have the latest updates.
Terms of Use: https://reeder.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://reeder.app/privacy

bluejetty:00131729:ios.description:
Exercise is for everybody. Scratch that, exercise is for any body.
The JRNY membership offers personalized cardio, strength, and whole-body workouts that evolve as you do. It gets to know you by assessing your fitness level and recommending workouts based on your abilities, available time, how you're feeling, and more.
With streaming entertainment, an ever-growing library of whole-body workout content, and real-time coaching, experience the feeling of truly personal training seamlessly from home with compatible equipment or your mobile device.
Take advantage of our current free trial offer and get started today. That's why the JRNY® adaptive fitness membership is designed for all of us, no matter how we're feeling each day. Whether you're running short on time or feel like you've got a little extra to push just a bit further, the JRNY platform always shows up for you and your individual needs.
At the end of the free trial, your Apple account will be charged at the selected membership rate unless you cancel the membership at least 48 hours before the free trial ends.
Cancelation: You may cancel your membership at any time and enjoy the use of your membership through the remainder of your current free trial or membership period, as applicable. See below for additional details.
By using the JRNY® app, you are certifying that you are at least 18 years old and that you understand and agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Read our full Terms of Use & EULA at (https://www.bowflex.com/global-assets/legal/terms-of-use.html) and our Privacy Policy at (https://www.bowflex.com/global-assets/legal/privacy-policy.html).
• Always new, just for you: Every day, a custom set of workouts to liven up your routine and keep things fun.
• Roam if you want to: Hundreds of Explore the World scenic routes let you train in your dream destination.
• Follow your favorite trainers: Find an instructor for every mood, every fitness level.
• Watch and workout: Follow your workout and stream your favorite shows at the same time, including Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and Disney+.
• Keep leveling up: Your real-time virtual coach continually adapts as you build strength and endurance.
• Visualize your success: JRNY keeps track of your personal bests and milestones.
• Mix in some whole-body movement: Yoga, Pilates and strength training give you options when you want a change of pace.
• Find your epic workout song: An ever-fresh line up of playlists means you can always get your groove on.
Start a JRNY you'll never want to end.

The Indiana Ball app is your all-encompassing guide for sporting events, meticulously crafted to cater to the needs of team and college coaches, media, players, parents, and fans. Designed to bring every essential aspect of the event to your fingertips, this platform ensures you stay connected and well-informed.
Key Features:
• Quick team search and user-friendly shortcuts.
• Up-to-the-minute schedules to keep you on track.
• Live standings and brackets for real-time updates.
• Immediate game notifications so you never miss a beat.

• Essential event documents, messages, and contact details for complete guidance.
• Information on event sponsors for additional insights.
With the app, every detail of the event is conveniently at your fingertips, ensuring an immersive and comprehensive experience for everyone involved.

bluejetty:00115536:ios.description:
Welcome to Free Brain Training Games app: fun, challenging, and free brain games, puzzles, mind tests for all ages! Train your brain anytime, anywhere.
With science-backed fun free games, daily personalized workouts, and mental tests, we help you sharp your mind, boost your logic, memory, focus, math, language, problem solving, emotion regulation and more!
This brain training collection features 40+ unique games, puzzles, IQ tests, mental health tests and more. Whether you're aiming to boost your brainpower, love classic games or puzzles, or need a bit of stress and anxiety relief, there's something here for everyone. Each game adapts to your performance, so you're always growing, engaged, and having fun.
———————
Key Features
*Brain Training Games
Enjoy fun, science-backed games that sharpen your logic, memory, math, focus, attention, and more. Brain training has never been this entertaining.
*Mental Tests
Explore your mind with quick and insightful cognitive tests. Uncover your strengths, mental wellness, and personality traits to better understand yourself.
*Daily Personalized Workouts
Strengthen your brain with daily workouts designed just for you. Each session includes games tailored to your habits, preferences, and skill-building needs.
*Progress Tracker
Stay motivated by tracking your improvement with easy-to-read stats. See how your skills grow over time and get personalized tips to help you advance even further.
*Leaderboard
Compete with friends or challenge players from around the world. Climb the ranks and see how your brainpower compares on the global stage.
———————
What You’ll Find in Free Brain Training Games App
*Free Puzzle Games
Challenge your brain with our clever draw One Line puzzles. We challenge you to connect all the dots using a single stroke, no lifting your finger, no going back. It’s a deceptively simple concept that quickly turns into a brain-teasing workout. Think you’ve got what it takes? Let’s draw the line!
Loved color sort games with water or balls? It’s time to try Fruit Sort! We’ve added a juicy twist to your favorite sorting challenge: just tap to move and organize fruits by color. It’s a fresh, fun way to boost your focus, logic, and visual thinking. Ready to sort things out? Let’s go!
We’ve turned simple dots into a satisfying flow puzzle: Color Connect. Link matching colors by drawing paths to connect the dots. Pair each set of two dots without crossing lines. A relaxing yet brain-teasing flow puzzle. Ready to make every connection count?
*Free Word Games
We bring you the best of both worlds: classic Crossword and addictive Word Search puzzles! Whether you're a fan of scrabble-style challenges or just looking to level up your vocabulary, these timeless word games have you covered. They’re fun, easy to pick up, and perfect for all ages. Let the word-hunting begin!
*Mental Math Games
Packed into fun, bite-sized challenges, our mental math games help you sharpen your skills in just minutes a day. Practice daily and watch yourself turn into a math guru. Perfect for all ages to stay sharp and confident with numbers.
*Memory Games, Focus Games
Give your brain a boost with fun and engaging memory games. Designed for both kids and adults, these challenges help improve focus, enhance recall, and keep your mind active every day. We’ve made it simple, effective, and enjoyable for all ages!
*Mental Test
Visual IQ Test
ADHD Self-Check
Anxiety Self-Check
Stress Self-Check
Trauma Self-Check
Personality Test
Feel smarter every day with Free Brain Training Games. Play, train, and boost your brain with games that actually make a difference. Download now and start your mental upgrade!
———————

Privacy Policy: https://braintraining.app/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00186390:ios.description:
*** Pay once & Play forever + receive FREE updates! No ads and no IAP ***
Don’t have all your gifts for the holiday season? No need to worry, the My Town : Shopping Mall is now open! Grab your tote bags and visit any one of the many stores for everyone on your list, but don’t forget to also get your photos taken with Santa! Have you been dreaming about a new phone or tablet? Stop by the mobile store! There are clothing stores where you can try on the latest trends, stores for the new babies in your life, and music stores where you can live out your rock star dreams! Have you seen an eye doctor recently? Stop by the glasses store to pick up some fresh new frames! We know all this shopping will make you hungry, so come pick up your favorite meals in our large food court!
No matter which store you choose to explore, there are HOURS of fun ahead with THREE floors stocked with stores!!
Game Features:
- This game is connected to all our latest My Town games
- Santa is visiting the Mall, Come say Hello!
- 3 Floors of Mall Fun with ton's of stores to play with such as Cake store, Baby store, Mobile store, pets store, Music store and more...
- New characters you can take to our other connected games.
- Food and Arcade are waiting for you on the top floor!
- Connected to all our latest games
- A multitouch feature, Kids can play together on the same tablet!
- Kids safe - No Ads or 3rd party tracking 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
You can easily contact us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00100798:ios.description:
Whether you’re a music student or teacher, the Kjos Interactive Practice Studio App provides a whole new way for you to experience your favorite Kjos Music publications. Whether you want to supplement a hard-copy book you own or experience a publication completely online, the IPS makes it all possible.
With the Interactive Practice Studio you have access to:
• eBook versions of your favorite Kjos publications—leave your print books at home!
• Teacher Edition access to eBook versions of every student book in a series.
• Play-along accompaniment and demonstration recordings with tempo, looping, and mix controls.
• Video lessons that provide instruction of both basic and more advanced concepts and techniques.
• A personal recording studio with tools for easily mixing, storing, and sharing your recordings with teachers, family, and friends.
• Cultural and historical enrichments to cultivate development of total musicianship and meet the requirements of a standards-based education.
• Interactive glossaries to assist in the understanding of important terms and phrases.
• Flashcards that make learning the language of music fun. 
• Practice journals and self-evaluation/reflection forms to help students document progress.
• Instant access to Kjos.com for information on more publications to enhance learning and teaching.
The Interactive Practice Studio gives students and teachers the tools they need to get the most of their learning and instruction.

bluejetty:00077093:ios.description:
Our app automatically adjusts your photo, enabling you to convert selfies into biometric passport-size photos that comply with all official requirements for passports, IDs, visas, Green Cards, Student cards, and driver's licenses. It also supports baby passport photos, including infant and newborn passport photo requirements.
WHY PHOTOAID TO CREATE PASSPORT PHOTOS?
• Every photo is carefully verified by our photo experts in real time,
• All photos checked and approved by our experts are guaranteed to comply with all rigorous standards,
• Our verification process eliminates the risk of photo rejection due to common errors,
• If any issues are detected, we provide detailed feedback for quick and easy corrections within 5 minutes,
• With PhotoAiD, your privacy is well protected so that you can use our app with confidence,
• Easy-to-use & intuitive interface designed for all people regardless of their tech skills,
• No need to find a white wall; our app can automatically remove or adjust the background to fit official standards,
• Our app automatically ensures your face is properly centered and your photo meets size specifications,
• Photos instantly to your mailbox or with free delivery right to your hands,
• Over 35M+ accepted photos made with PhotoAiD.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Take a selfie at any place or select a preferred image from your gallery. Our system meticulously modifies it to align with stringent official guidelines.
2. Your image undergoes a rigorous two-tiered verification process. AI will prepare and preliminarily check your image, then a human photo expert will double-check the conformity of your pictures.
3. Post-verification, your photograph is primed for immediate printing. You will get digital photos that can be used for online applications, or you can order high-quality printouts with free delivery. 
HOW TO TAKE PASSPORT-SIZE PHOTOS CORRECTLY?
• Maintain the right distance - ideal camera positioning for optimal photo capture,
• Posture matters - keep your head & body straight for the perfect shot,
• Optimal lighting is key - avoid shadows for clear, compliant photos.
WHAT TO WEAR TO TAKE PERFECT PASSPORT-SIZE PHOTOS?
• Avoid wearing clothes in light colors, which might cause you to blend in with the background.
• Keep in mind that any head coverings are prohibited.
• You can wear glasses only if they are prescription glasses. However, if your glasses frames cover too much of your face, you need to take them off. Sunglasses or glasses with tinted lenses are forbidden.
• It is fine to have a beard in your photo.
COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID:
• A wide smile - You must avoid showing any facial expression. Keep a neutral face.
• Photo older than six months - If your look has changed significantly, you should take a new picture. 
• Low quality of the photo - The picture must not be pixelated, blurred, or damaged in any other way.
• Portrait style photo - If your photo does not qualify for biometric standards, it will be rejected, so make sure the photo is taken face on, you are looking straight into the lens, with your mouth closed and eyes open.
We value your feedback! We'd love to hear from you if you have suggestions or feedback to improve our application. Don't hesitate to contact us at help@photoaid.com.

bluejetty:00071207:ios.description:
Do you receive Corel® WordPerfect® documents (.wpd, .wpt, .wp, .wp4, .wp5, .wp6) as email attachments on you iPhone and iPad? Are you having plenty of WordPerfect files that no decent viewer available to open on your iPhone and iPad? The easiest way to circumvent these problems is WPD Reader.
“WPD Reader” allows you to open and read WordPerfect (version 1-11) documents on iOS device. It offers you fantastic reading experience using document outlines, page thumbnails and text search features.
In addition, “WPD Reader” allows you to export WordPerfect document into Microsoft Word(.docx, .doc) and RTF to make it available for editing in other Word processing software.
Converts the text, text characteristics, paragraphs, text frames linking, text frame columns, tables, graphics and other document objects and properties to the matching Microsoft Word format objects and properties by preserving layout.
- It also allows to convert WordPerfect document into PDF.
- Standard document interaction interface to share, send and save exported documents.
READING FEATURES:
- Fully selectable and searchable text contents. Select and copy text to clipboard for further use.
- Pinch out and Pinch in to ZoomIn and ZoomOut view.
- Navigate through topics by document outlines, if exist.
- Search text feature to find a character, word or sentence any where in a document.
- Scroll through your document by Page Thumbnails or Go to page feature.
DOCUMENT MANAGEMENT
- The inbuilt document browse view automatically gives you the option to share documents using the Share button or a drag-and-drop action. It also provides a standard interface for browsing and managing documents.
- Automatically handles access to iCloud for you within the app. It also provides access to documents managed by third-party storage service extensions installed on your device.
- Browse, find and sort documents to help you locate the document you want. Tap the file that you want to open.
- You can move, delete, duplicate and rename a document with document manager in browser view.
- In the document manager, you can group related documents into folders so they’re easy to find.
- Support to open and convert Corel WordPerfect (version 1-11) format files.
Note: “WPD Reader” is standalone application running natively to open and convert WordPerfect document securely right on your iOS device.
You can refer User Manual for any assistance Or Contact Support.

bluejetty:00083649:ios.description:
Math Games transforms math practice into an engaging and interactive experience. This app provides the tools you need to master arithmetic skills with a focus on customization, challenge, and fun. Designed for students, parents, and teachers, it offers a versatile way to learn and improve math proficiency.
Explore five game modes: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and mixed operations. Each mode offers a unique way to practice essential math concepts, keeping learning fresh and challenging.
Customize your learning experience by selecting the number of questions, adjusting the range of numbers, and choosing how many answer options are presented. Whether you prefer quick, focused drills or longer, comprehensive sessions, the flexibility allows you to set the right challenge level for any skill set.
Enhance your speed and accuracy with the timer feature, where you can set a time limit for each question or turn the timer off for a more relaxed pace. This feature adds excitement for those who enjoy working under pressure.
The app’s custom flashcard feature lets you create your own math problems. Add personalized content to focus on specific areas of improvement or reinforce classroom lessons. This makes it a valuable tool for both individualized learning and teaching.
Track your progress effortlessly with the scorecard system. Each session is logged with detailed results, making it easy to monitor growth and identify areas for improvement over time.
With an intuitive, easy-to-navigate interface and bright, engaging visuals, Math Games makes math learning accessible and enjoyable for all ages. Whether you are preparing for a test, helping your child with homework, or looking for an educational tool for your classroom, this app provides everything you need to practice math effectively.
Download Math Games today and take your math skills to the next level!

bluejetty:00045936:ios.description:
QSRSoft’s full suite of solutions and integrations make it is easy to run great restaurants by providing you with the right tools and insights required to ensure that your restaurants are at their peak performance every day of the week. Download the QSRSoft mobile application to access all of QSRSoft’s restaurant optimization products and services from any device at any time.
QSRSoft Products and Features:
Inventory
QSRSoft’s Inventory Management solution gives you real-time data on your food cost and inventory and includes features like smart ordering, waste entry, validated transfers, app enabled inventory counts, gain/loss, and opportunity reporting.
Workforce Management
Easily manage all aspects of your workforce, using QSRSoft’s Workforce Management solution to maintain HR records, forecast labor needs, automatically schedule shifts, manage time punches, and export payrolls.
Reports & Analytics
Use QSRSoft’s Reports & Analytics to aggregate all of your data into one place and leverage actionable insights to help identify opportunity and drive performance.
TV
Engage, motivate, and retain your employees with QSRSoft TV. Gamification, recognition, communication, shift reminders and so much more using any internet connected display in your restaurant.
Forms
QSRSoft Forms increases visibility and accountability by digitizing manual, time-consuming processes including food safety, employee performance reviews and task completion lists for increased visibility and accountability.
Equipment
Use QSRSoft Equipment to manage planned maintenance, asset life and the repair process – all seamlessly from your QSRSoft dashboard.
Messaging
QSRSoft is your one-stop communication hub for organization wide messaging, custom chat groups and person-to-person communication. Communicating with your staff has never been so easy.
Organization Calendar
Stay organized and never miss a beat by keeping all of your key tasks and events organized and on track with QSRSoft’s integrated Organization Calendar. 
Shared Files and Links
When you run an organization, keeping track of your files and shared documents can be near to impossible, but with QSRSoft, it’s never been so easy. Use our shared files and links feature to keep important information organized and just one click away, saving you time and energy.
Roles, Permissions and Hierarchy
Providing just the right level of access and structure for all of your users is critical to running a successfully optimized restaurant. Use QSRSoft’s graphical hierarchy tool to ensure that all of your employees are granted with just the right level of data and access so that they are armed with everything they need to successful perform the job you hired them to do.

bluejetty:00037275:ios.description:
Thread Fever is the original color sort thread puzzle that turns colorful threads into a calm yet clever challenge.
Unravel tangled threads, sort colors into the right boxes, and complete beautifully stitched designs as you progress through a relaxing but brain-engaging puzzle experience.
Test your focus and strategy as you rotate objects, plan ahead, and make every move count. Collect threads, complete unique canvases, and grow your collection as you progress. Easy to start, deeply satisfying to master.
How to Play:
• Tap to collect threads from knitted objects and match them with boxes of the same color
• Use slots as temporary space for threads you need later
• Drag to rotate and pinch to zoom for a better view of details
• Complete levels to collect threads and finish beautifully stitched canvases
• Complete canvases to expand your collection and track your progress
• Climb the leaderboard and compete with players worldwide
Features:
• Canvas collection system with unique designs to complete
• Boosters: Shuffle, Magnet, Broom
• Pre-Level Boosters: Extra Box, Rainbow Box, Magic Box
• Weekly new level updates
• Options to add extra boxes and slots
• Improved visuals and smoother animations
• Hundreds of colorful thread-sorting puzzles
• Global leaderboard system
Why You’ll Love It:
• A perfect balance of relaxation and brain-teasing challenge
• Satisfying thread-sorting and stitching mechanics
• Build your collection by completing new canvases
• Easy to learn, harder as you progress
• Great for quick sessions or long play times
• A rewarding sense of progress through levels, collections, and leaderboard results
Dive into the vibrant world of threads, conquer hundreds of levels, complete your canvas collection, and turn chaos into perfect order!
