bluejetty:00137804:ios.description:
Scroll through your schedule like it’s a timeline — fast, fluid, and always in context. Calendar+ is built for people who want a clean overview, quick edits, and better-looking calendars without fighting the default app.
Why Calendar+?
• Seamless scrolling through days, weeks, and months
• Day / Week / Month views with great overview
• Add, edit, and delete events quickly
• Syncs with your existing calendars (iCloud, Google, Outlook/Exchange, CalDAV, ICS subscriptions, and more)
• Jump to any date instantly
• Week numbers
• Built-in holidays and flag days for 2021–2032: Australia (all states and territories), Austria, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Russia, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, and United States
• Built-in name days: Austria, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Ukraine, United Kingdom, and United States
• Calendar selection & filtering – show only what you want
• Dedicated “Scroll to Today” button
• Portrait + landscape support
Personalize Everything (Pro)
• Calendar groups – put your calendars in groups like Work or Family and switch focus with one tap
• Custom views – build your own views with their own layout, theme and calendar group, then reorder or hide views to suit you
• Make calendars stand out with unique colors and fonts across all views
• App theme colors
• All widgets
• Moon phases for the full year
• Birthday + name day countdowns
• Support an indie developer (me)
Settings You’ll Actually Use
• Text size control (month/week independently)
• Toggle holidays + name days on/off
• App icon badge options (day in month, day in year, or week number)
• Default event settings (reminders, calendar, etc.)
• Fine-grained event display options (dots, times, titles, weekend shading, contrast, truncation behavior)
Gestures
• Swipe left/right to switch views
• Pinch to zoom between month and week
• Tap & hold on a day to create an event
• Swipe to delete in day view
Support & Feedback
I’d genuinely love to hear from you.
• In Calendar+ → Ideas (submit and vote)
• In Calendar+ → Support/Feedback
• Email: support@alientoes.se
• Website: https://www.alientoes.se/en/support
Terms: https://www.alientoes.se/en/terms
Privacy: https://www.alientoes.se/en/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00171711:ios.name: Pixicade - Game Creator
bluejetty:00171711:ios.summary:
BUILD your game from scratch with no coding needed. Browse a library with tons of pre-made assets, or snap a picture and turn your drawings into playable video games!
PLAY the games you make, or get inspiration playing games from other crea
bluejetty:00171711:ios.description:
BUILD your game from scratch with no coding needed. Browse a library with tons of pre-made assets, or snap a picture and turn your drawings into playable video games!
PLAY the games you make, or get inspiration playing games from other creators in the Pixicade Arcade!
SHARE your games with friends and other creators and build an audience of your own!
Pixicade lets you channel your inner game developer.
PIXICADE - FEATURES
--------------------------------
• Create your very own games with no coding needed!
• Browse a library filled with pre-made, full color assets!
• Kid safe & COPPA compliant
• Snap a picture and add your own drawings into your games!
• Add exciting cosmetics like game borders, backgrounds, music, and more!
• Level-up your creations by adding Powerups!
• Share your game with friends or the community of over half-a-million game creators!
• Follow your favorite creators & build an audience of your own!
• Track your progress as a top creator & player on the leaderboards!
• Play tons of games made by other creators - get inspired!
• Race against other players to compete for the fastest times and earn awesome rewards!
• Explore epic multi-level Quests full of interesting characters, stories, and bosses!
• Add friends to see when they’re online & playing!
• Chat with friends, or in group chats!
• Vote for and receive your favorite assets from others in weekly asset making challenges!
• Refer friends to earn special rewards!
BUILD
Creating games in Pixicade is easy. Just choose the type of game you want to make, and start creating!
Pick from a variety of game types like platformers, slingshot games, brickbreakers, mazes and more. 
Add walls, obstacles, hazards, powerups & objectives to your games as well as cosmetics like borders, backgrounds and music. Browse a huge library of full color premade assets, or draw your own and upload them with your camera!
PLAY
Play the games you create, or browse the arcade to see what other creators have made. See what types of games are popular, and get inspiration for your next masterpiece!
Compete against other players in races for the fastest times to win rewards. Or, try quest mode to progress through multiple levels filled with interesting characters, stories, and bosses!
SHARE
Once you’re done making your games, share them with friends and the rest of the community! 
Follow your favorite creators, and build an audience of your own! You can even track your score as both a player and a creator and get recognized on the leaderboards.
Want to try making your own games? Give Pixicade a try for free!
* This application is free to download and play games. An optional subscription is available to enhance your experience.
* Internet connectivity required to play. Data charges may apply.
* Children under 13 may require parent permission to play.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177933:ios.description:
ICE SCREAM 3: SCARY HORROR
The eerie sound of the ice cream truck is back, and this time Rod has kidnapped your best friend Mike.
Enter a first-person horror and puzzle adventure where you must explore creepy locations, uncover mysteries and solve challenging puzzles to save your friend. Sneak into Rod’s van, hide from him and find a way to escape before he catches you.
STORIES
Ice Scream 3 now features multiple stories that expand the Ice Scream universe.
- NEW Logan’s Misadventures: Play as Logan in a new canonical story and discover how Rod’s toy horses ended up scattered across Spokane. Explore new areas, escape from Rod and uncover new pieces of Ice Scream lore.
- The Missing Guard, Part 3: After a long investigation, J. arrives at the mall with all the evidence he needs. Uncover the kidnapper’s identity in the final chapter of a what-if story spanning Ice Scream 1, 2 and 3.
- Mike’s Kidnapping: Play the original Ice Scream 3 story. Follow Rod, explore eerie locations and solve puzzles to rescue Mike before it’s too late.
More canonical stories, what-if scenarios and surprises are coming to the Keplerians Universe.
KEPLERIANS NETWORK: PLAY. CONNECT. PROGRESS.
Keplerians Network connects your Ice Scream experience and gives you new ways to play, progress and interact with other players.
- Friends: add other players, manage friend requests and follow their activity.
- Leaderboards: see how you rank globally, locally and among your friends.
- Player Profiles: build your profile, track your stats and discover your friends’ progress.
- Connected Progress: play across connected Ice Scream games and unlock rewards.
- Stories: access the different adventures available in each game.
- Events: take part in limited-time events, complete special challenges and earn rewards across KNetwork games.
- Skin Shop: unlock and equip skins to customize Rod and the kids.
- Rewards & Customization: earn Kepler Coins, unlock profile cosmetics, use boosters and personalize your experience.
GO PREMIUM
Take your Ice Scream experience even further with Premium:
- No ads: play without interruptions.
- Free boosters across your games.
- Double Kepler Coins while playing.
- Monthly exclusive gifts including Horror Coins, cosmetics, booster reloads and more.
- Access new stories and exclusive content before anyone else.
Play with headphones for the best experience.
We regularly update Ice Scream with new stories, features and improvements. Thanks for playing!
Have questions? Visit our FAQ:
https://keplerians.com/keplerians-network/
Are you a parent of a young Keplerians player? Find everything you need to keep their adventure safe and fun:
https://keplerians.com/parents-guide/
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014765:ios.description:
Whether you’re just getting started or you’re a seasoned veteran, the StarNow app is the perfect resource for finding and applying to casting calls from all over the world - anytime, from anywhere!
Browse thousands of curated casting calls from TV shows, movies, independent productions, music videos, voiceover gigs, modeling jobs, and more right at your fingertips. With unlimited applications and media uploads, the StarNow app makes finding your next audition easier and better than ever. Create saved searches tailored to your specifications to be the first to know about (and apply to!) the kinds of jobs you want most.
The StarNow app is free to download, allowing all users to search and browse available casting calls. Upgrade to a subscription to unlock unlimited applications and build a professional talent profile that will wow casting directors. Happy auditioning!
If you choose to purchase a subscription to StarNow, your payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month or year 24-hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off. Auto-renew may be turned off at any time from your Apple account settings. Prices for subscriptions are in U.S. dollars, and may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase a StarNow subscription, you can continue to use the StarNow app for free. This app includes subscription options, including via optional in-app purchases. If you don’t choose to purchase a StarNow subscription, you can continue to use the StarNow app for free to manage your profile and view job listings, messages, and other resources; however, a subscription is required to utilize some aspects of the service.
Terms of Service:
https://www.starnow.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy:
https://www.starnow.com/privacy-policy/

Of course you can also contact us via the app for questions, suggestions and criticism.
We hope you enjoy the new app and recommend a data flat rate for intensive use. The app itself is of course free of charge.

Stylebook® is the longest-running closet organization app for a reason - with over 9
bluejetty:00174858:ios.description:
Get the most out of your closet - for less than the price of a latte, you could change your relationship with clothes and find your unique personal style!
Stylebook® is the longest-running closet organization app for a reason - with over 90 features to help you curate your closet! This time-tested app is an expert wardrobe management and closet organization tool, and has been loved by customers for 15+ years.
Import your actual clothes in seconds with a variety of import tools, including AI image generation. Use your real clothes to collage magazine-style outfits so you can wear an outfit you love every day. If you’re out of ideas, the app can even make outfits for you. Plus, plan what to wear on the outfit calendar, create packing lists that automatically tell you which clothes to pack, and learn more about your wardrobe with stats like cost per wear - all in this customizable app!
Stylebook is the ultimate tool to mix and match your wardrobe and get more wears out of your clothes without feeling bored. If you want to break out of the micro-trend cycle and gain true personal style - it’s for you.
OUR STORY:
Stylebook’s features were inspired by the co-founder's real-life experience organizing clothes in the Vogue fashion closet and her journey to find her personal style while working with a nonexistent budget. As the app evolved over the years, it's become a way for anyone to fall in love with their wardrobe, helping them to save time and money, get more wears out of their clothes, and make their wardrobes more sustainable. We’re a small family-owned and operated business. 
REVIEWS:
FEATURED BY: Vogue, WSJ, Harper's Bazaar UK, New York Magazine, Articles of Interest, Confidently Insecure, Sustainable Fashion for Dummies, the Conscious Style Podcast, & more!
"Easily see what is working and what isn’t" - Vogue.com
"Closet-organization apps allow you to catalog your wardrobe and play stylist...I find Stylebook to be the most intuitive." - NYTimes
"Our new wardrobe secret weapon is the @StylebookApp" - The Outnet
10 Must-Have iPhone Apps for Fashion Week - Vogue Paris
"The Clueless virtual closet exists in real life, OMG" - Cosmopolitan UK
Condé Nast Traveler's "Best Travel Apps for Packing"
FEATURES:
• CLOSET INVENTORY: quickly add images of your clothes with no need to take photos unless you choose to
• FAST IMPORT: generate clothing images from text with AI*, drag & drop photos, multiple import, & clip from your favorite store websites
• AI BACKGROUND REMOVAL: automatically cut out your clothes, virtually instantly
• LAY OUT OUTFITS: layer & resize clothing on a free-form canvas 
• OUTFIT GENERATOR: shuffle your closet like a deck of cards to reveal new outfit ideas hiding in your closet! 
• CALENDAR: plan what to wear in advance
• PACKING LISTS: add whole outfits, plan how you'll pack ahead of time, generate checklists & infographics
• STYLE STATS: insights into your wardrobe, including what you wear the most & least and which items have the best value
• COST PER WEAR: automatically track CPW for your entire wardrobe
• BROWSE YOUR CLOSET: see everything you own in one place, organized by brand, fabric, color, size, etc.
• INSPIRATION LIBRARY: save all your style inspirations outside the influence of algorithms
• CUSTOM CATEGORIES: add, edit, or delete any category in your closet, looks & inspiration library
• SYNC: automatic sync shows the same data on both your iPhone & iPad
• SHARE: share outfits & clothes via e-mail & social media
• NO LIMITS: add unlimited clothing, accessories, & inspirations
• ICLOUD BACKUP: protect your data with iCloud
• SEARCH: search your closet for keywords or properties like fabric, season, color, etc.
• SHOP: try items with your clothes before buying & bookmark your fave stores!
• E-MAIL SUPPORT: contact support and a real person will help you
Visit stylebookapp.com for the full feature list - plus demo videos of the app!
(*) AI image generation requires Apple Intelligence

bluejetty:00118838:ios.description:
Bublup makes it easy to create private spaces for a wide range of uses. Businesses build online communities and collaborative teams at scale. Personal plans keep families and individuals organized and productive.
Bublup uses a unique visual approach to manage content and conversations. The app is extremely easy to learn. Access anything from anywhere, using all popular devices and browsers. Keep data secure and private.
For businesses, Bublup makes it quick and easy to set up internal communities for collaboration, as well as external communities for engagement. It excels at supporting both resources (any type of content) and discussion forums. Organize people into teams. Use the teams to selectively communicate and control access. Use AI to automatically curate and summarize content. Even, create webpages with a single click to extend your company website.
For individuals, families, and solopreneurs, Bublup provides the most intuitive way to organize and share any content in one place, including documents, videos, photos, links, and notes. No matter what it is, you’ll have a go-to place for saving it. The visual approach to organizing data makes it much more enjoyable to stay on top of your digital world! Compare to traditional file-based systems, or keeping your information scattered in emails, notes, and screenshots. Take the stress out of finding things when you need them!
Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
For specific questions, email us at support@bublup.com.

ANALYSE
- Analyse each game and get feedback reports after playing

- Club admins can host online tournaments within the club
LEARNING TOOLS
- Computer players
- Opening trees
- Position search engine
- Game database
- Master database
- Mini-games for beginners
OTHER TOOLS
- Notebook
- Clocks
- Local database
- Themes
AND MORE TO EXPLORE!

bluejetty:00123930:ios.description:
A Dark Fantasy, Collectible RPG
Darkness has overtaken the realm, and the world is in chaos. The only hope to restore light and order lies with you, an Heir of Light. Embark on a crusade to renew a hope that has been lost for generations. Ready your weapon and journey to restore the light of the world!
Features
■ Be A Light in the Darkness
- Shine light upon a world shrouded in darkness. The war will only end when light shines upon every inch of the land.
- Expand the territory in any direction you desire!
- Mobs are no longer in your way, Exclusive Boss Battles Only!
■ Collect Powerful Servants
- Summon powerful Servants to fight at your side.
- Form your Crusade from among over 350 Servants.
- Enhance, Evolve, and Awaken to unlock their true potential.
- Diverse Roles for each Servant: Attack, Defense, Support, Healer.
■ Devise and Strategize
- Your Servants are the key of your Crusade, customize their Skills for every battle.
- Customize your Gear Combination to gain unique Set Effects.
- Couple the various different Skills and Elements to assemble the most strategic Crusade. 
■ Heed the Savage Battlefield
- Pulverize your opponents in PvP mode to prove your power.
- Preserve your Towers! Defense is the first step in strategic combat.
- Challenge yourself to various dungeons and earn rare rewards. Godspeed!
■ An Eerie and Mysterious World
- Not just another RPG! Immerse yourself in a magical and mysterious fantasy world.
- Cute yet bizarre, uncanny yet charming! Servants are ready to accompany you on your journey.
Subscription - Daily Karat Pack (Monthly)
- Karats & Valor sent daily!
- 10% Bonus Gold
- $8.99 monthly (Price may vary by location)
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- Terms of Use: http://terms.withhive.com/terms/policy/view/M5
- Privacy Policy: http://terms.withhive.com/terms/policy/view/M5/T3
* Moot community : https://moot.us/lounges/178/
** This game is available in 한국어, English, 日本語, 中文简体, 中文繁體, Deutsch, Français, Español, Vietnam, ไทย.
** There may be additional costs when trying to obtain certain items.
* Access authorization notice for gameplay
CAMERA: HIVE requires access to your camera to take profile images.
CONTACTS: HIVE requires access to your contacts to find friends.
PHOTOS: HIVE requires access to your photos to change profile images or save/load the game screen.
* Com2uS Holdings Official Website : https://www.withhive.com
* Com2uS Holdings Customer Support : https://m.withhive.com/customer/inquire

bluejetty:00123142:ios.description:
Welcome to SC Mobile Ghana. With SC Mobile, you are about to start an amazing banking experience. From the comfort of your mobile, you can open an account, transfer funds or access and complete most of the service needs that would typically require you to visit a branch. Say goodbye to long queues and do your banking anywhere and everywhere.
Open an account
With SC Mobile, you have the power of banking in your palm. It only takes up to 15 minutes to open a Current, Savings Plus or Fixed Deposit account. SC Mobile offers you all the benefits of owning these account types which are available in multiple currencies. Do not worry if you are unable to complete your application in one go. You can Save and Resume your application at any time.
Get a complete view of your accounts and transact with ease.
SC Mobile allows you to see, move and manage your finances anytime, anywhere. You can transfer funds to accounts within Standard Chartered Bank and to other local and international destination accounts. What’s more, you can use your SC Mobile for other daily transactions such as airtime and data bundle purchases, mobile money transfers and other utility payments including DSTV subscriptions, ECG and Ghana Water bills.
Access our Wealth Management proposition
ü You will also be able to BUY, SELL and TRACK YOUR PORTFOLIO anytime, anywhere with our online fixed income and mutual fund platform. Invest in GHS, USD and other major currencies
ü Get access to our latest market insights and take advantage of the market opportunities available
ü Get global diversification (both local and offshore investments) with best in class fund managers
Services at your fingertips
SC Mobile enables you to execute and track progress of a majority of services available in our banking halls. Avoid the queues and enjoy the convenience of banking everywhere. SC Mobile certainly gives you more time to do the things you love and not to worry about banking.

bluejetty:00068324:ios.description:
Talview provides a convenient way for job seekers to attend job interviews or tests anytime from anywhere on the Talview Candidate app. If the prospective employer has invited you to attend an interview or a test, or if you have the QR code of a job from an advertisement by the employer, you can download the app and enter/scan the QR code to complete your interview or test.
Talview candidate app app supports the following types of tests:
1. Asynchronous or automated video interviews
2. Online Live interviews
2. Video proctored assessments (Multiple choice questions, Essay, Typing, Coding, etc.)
Tests on Talview Candidate app are proctored using the Talview Proview Proctoring, the only remote proctoring solution available across all iOS devices. You can now attend assessments and interviews sitting in the comfort of your homes! No more last-minute hassles of reaching the venue or covering long miles to come to a test center.
For any queries regarding the application or for technical support, please contact us at support@talview.com.

Did you know that much of what you choose, do and believe runs on autopilot?
Ever wonder why some people seem to move toward success with ease, while others keep struggling?
"I can't... It's not for me... I'll never have enough..."
These thoughts are not the truth - they're patterns, often formed early in life. They can create a state of lack, fear, and frustration that holds you back from the life you want.
Magnet Mind is a self-hypnosis program designed to help you release limiting beliefs, reshape your inner patterns, and align your inner world with your desire for success, prosperity, and fulfillment - including a more confident, open mindset around money.
This isn't your typical personal development program - it's a transformation journey for anyone wishing to embrace abundance and unlock their true potential.
Magnet Mind is a guided audio practice that combines a hypnotic voice, affirmations and soothing sound to support motivation and a more positive mindset.
This program combines:
- A powerful script of repetitive and specific positive affirmations, going far beyond the short ones we're used to
- A background sound designed for deep relaxation (4-7 Hz)
- Binaural mode (headphones recommended)
- A hypnotic voice for 15 minutes of calm, focused listening
Listen for just 15 minutes a day, at bedtime or when awake, and begin to shift from limitation to expansion, from fear to trust, from lack to abundance.
What you repeat with feeling, you begin to believe.
Terms of Use: https://magnetmind.app/mm/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://magnetmind.app/mm/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00088356:ios.description:
Build Your Supermarket Empire and Dominate the Retail World!
Step into the fast-paced world of supermarket management and experience the thrill of running your own grocery empire. In Supermarket Tycoon 3D, you’ll take charge of every aspect of your store, from stocking products to managing staff, ensuring happy customers, and expanding your business to new heights.
Manage, Optimize, and Grow
Take full control of your store’s daily operations. Keep the shelves stocked with fresh groceries, optimize pricing strategies, and provide top-notch customer service. Smart decision-making will determine your success—plan promotions, monitor inventory, and hire the right employees to keep your business running smoothly.
Overcome Retail Challenges
The road to success isn’t easy! Compete with other supermarkets, tackle supply chain challenges, and adapt to market demands. Keep customers satisfied while balancing costs and profits to stay ahead in the competitive world of retail.
Expand and Upgrade Your Business
Use your earnings to upgrade your store, unlock new product lines, and open additional locations. Invest wisely in store improvements and marketing campaigns to attract more customers and build a supermarket empire that dominates the city.
Experience Realistic Supermarket Management
Immerse yourself in a dynamic 3D world where every decision matters. From the bustling aisles of your store to the lively city streets, Supermarket Tycoon 3D brings the excitement of retail management to life with stunning visuals and interactive gameplay.
Game Features:
 Realistic management gameplay – Oversee your store’s daily operations and make key business decisions.
Strategy-driven challenges – Balance supply, demand, and customer satisfaction to grow your profits.
 Business expansion – Unlock new products, upgrade facilities, and open multiple store locations.
Immersive 3D graphics – Enjoy a visually rich and interactive supermarket environment.
Customizable gameplay – Experiment with different strategies to maximize success.
Become the Ultimate Retail Tycoon!
Are you ready to turn your supermarket into a thriving business? Test your entrepreneurial skills and build a retail empire that stands the test of time. Jump into Supermarket Tycoon 3D and start your journey to success today!

bluejetty:00162068:ios.description:
O TAXI.RIO é um aplicativo de mobilidade urbana da Prefeitura que assegura qualidade e segurança para os usuários do serviço de táxi do Rio de Janeiro.
Com o TAXI.RIO, hoje você consegue solicitar corridas para uma frota selecionada por estar 100% em dia com suas obrigações cadastrais, tendo certificados e vistorias atualizados e ficha limpa nos órgãos do judiciário.
Você pode usar o serviço em diferentes opções de desconto e disponibilidade, de acordo com a sua conveniência. E o valor a pagar é demonstrado com clareza, sem taxas escondidas.
Tudo isso usando as tecnologias que você já conhece, com a segurança que só o TAXI.RIO pode oferecer como órgão fiscalizador.
O que vem por aí?
O TAXI.RIO tem um planejamento de evolução contínua, como ocorre com a maioria dos serviços digitais.
Em linhas gerais, seguem alguns dos principais desenvolvimentos que já estão previstos para que o TAXI.RIO possa se tornar um serviço completo para atender as necessidades do cidadão:
- Agendamento de corrida
- Captura de corrida na rua (sem pedido pelo aplicativo)
- Substituição automática de taxista em caso de desistência de taxista confirmado
- Recursos de acessibilidade conforme normas internacionais
- Suporte multi-idiomas

[Merge and Combin
bluejetty:00173160:ios.description:
Merge Camp offers a variety of merge puzzles, mini-games, and events waiting for you. Decorate the island with your cute animal neighbors, accept their requests, merge items, and grow as you embark on exciting adventures.
[Merge and Combination Puzzle Game]
Merge hundreds of items to create new ones! If you are a fan of merge games or merge-like games, you will find special joy on this animal island as well. Merge two items to obtain higher-level items and create what your island friends desire. Your creativity is the key to completing the island!
[Evolution of Merge Game]
Combining elements of merge games and puzzle games, this game offers the fun of combination puzzles along with the experience of interacting with animal friends. Build houses on Beach Island, Jungle Island, and Santa Island, meet your friends' needs, and earn their trust. Additionally, solve the cute animal friends' requests, increase affection, and enjoy decorating their outfits. Dress them in Santa costumes for winter or fireworks costumes for summer to create a fun atmosphere.
[Game Features]
Merge and upgrade identical items for endless fun and diverse combination game elements.
Decorate the island with new friends and take on various adventures.
A must-play game for fans of merge games and combination puzzle games.
Experience a healing game with adorable friends cheering you on.
Decorate diverse islands such as the cool Summer Beach Island, lush Jungle Island, fragrant Camping Island, warm Hot Spring Island, and Santa Island where Santa Claus lives.
Create and decorate miniature rooms for cute neighbors like Mary, Mandy, Coco, and Momo.
New events await you every day! Participate in daily events like Mary's Bingo Festival, Pelly's Delivery Event, and Captain Peng's Merge Challenge to make your experience with Merge Camp even more enjoyable.
Download Merge Camp now and embark on an adventure in the world of merging! Fans of merge games and combination puzzle games will surely love this game!
[Instagram Fan Page]
Are you enjoying Merge Camp? Find more information on Instagram!
https://www.instagram.com/mergecamp.official/
[Need Help?]
Go to Settings, Customer Support in the game, and we will assist you right away!

Introducing the NoBroker App - the ultimate property app for hassle-free property renting, buying, & services. Whether you are looking for a house/apartment/flat/room for rent, or want to buy/sell a property or need home services, NoBroker has got you covered.

FEATURES 
🏠 Find housing in leading cities: The NoBroker housing app simplifies the process by providing a user-friendly interface, extensive options & special filters for advanced property search. Browse through 1000s of verified listings with accurate property information like property photos, amenities, & location in the cities of Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurgaon, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad. 
🔎 Advanced filters for extensive property search by your requirements, such as property type, budget, area, number of rooms & more. Find a home that suits you, be it a single room, a PG, a full house, or a shared flat. 
💵Buy/Sell your property with ease without having to deal with brokers & middlemen. This property sale & purchase app & property selling app in India makes it easy to buy & sell properties. Make plot buying & selling a process of just a few clicks. Get dedicated property management services. Use our free EMI calculator & avail the best home loan assistance service from NoBroker. Put up your commercial shop for sale & watch it get scooped up in no time! 
📃NoBroker Rental Services provides Instant rental/lease agreements with 1-day delivery & accurate estimate of your property value & property rent with our property rent calculator. Know everything about your commercial shop for rent before you pay the rent. 
💳 Pay rent online with your credit card & get amazing rewards & cashback in return while paying your- Home/Shop/office/commercial property rent School, college or tuition fees Property token amount/security deposit Society maintenance charges 
🛠️NoBroker Home Services like- Painting: Get your home painted in no time from nearby painters in your locality. Cleaning & Sanitization services: Professional home cleaning services near you at the best-quoted price in the market. AC Service & Repair: Get summer-ready with perfectly working ACs Home maintenance: Book Electricians, Carpenters & Plumbers at your convenience. 
🖼️NoBroker Interior Design: Consult the best interior designers in India to renovate your home within your budget. 
💼NoBroker Personal Loans to secure Your Financial Needs. Flexible Repayment Plans: Meet your pressing financial requirements easily. Affordable Interest Rates: No more financial worries – our manageable rates make meeting commitments easy. Quick Approval: Swift processing to meet your urgent financial needs. Minimal Documentation: Streamlined documentation process for a hassle-free application. The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) ranges from 10.99% & 30 %, depending on period of repayment & credit score of loan applicant. Interest Rate (APR): Up to 40% (maximum)
Loan Tenure: 3 to 60 months*

You will be sanctioned ₹98,230 & ₹19,817 is the total interest, which you will have to pay over the principal amount, therefore the entire amount due on the loan is ₹119,817.
NoBroker has partnered with RBI-authorized & regulated NBFCs/Financial Institutions.

Play the opening you like, get puzz
bluejetty:00086995:ios.description:
Most chess apps make you play a machine. Noctie gives you a training partner.
Noctie is a premium chess trainer that plays like a human, adapts to your level, and turns every game into focused practice.
Play the opening you like, get puzzles from your game, have fun.
No weird engine moves, just real games against a realistic opponent, with instant feedback that shows you how to improve on every move. 
TRAIN AGAINST HUMAN-LIKE AI OPPONENTS
Train against a chess AI that adapts to your level and makes natural, human mistakes instead of perfect computer moves. Improve through 25 difficulty levels of humanlike chess bots, from beginner to master.
MASTER YOUR OPENINGS THE RIGHT WAY
Choose among your favorite chess openings or import your own repertoire, and train against an AI that follows the lines humans actually play. You don't just memorize theory; you learn to play it.
GET INSTANT VISUAL FEEDBACK WHILE YOU PLAY
See color-coded move-quality feedback the moment you play. Spot tactical mistakes and brilliant moves in real time, so every game teaches you something.
SOLVE PUZZLES FROM YOUR ACTUAL GAMES
After each game, practice custom chess tactics from the exact positions where you struggled. Your puzzles are saved for spaced-repetition practice, so you never repeat the same mistake twice.
SET UP ANY POSITION, STUDY LESSONS & ENDGAMES
Use the position builder to set up any chess position, or play scenarios from our instructive lessons — covering everything from positional imbalances to theoretical endgames. Drill king-and-pawn endgames until they're second nature.
BUILT FOR PLAYERS SERIOUS ABOUT IMPROVING
Noctie is a focused, premium chess training tool — no ads, no distractions, just deliberate practice that turns into real rating gains. Start with a free trial and train like you mean it.
** Requires internet connection **
SUBSCRIPTION
Noctie is an auto-renewing subscription that starts with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, and renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of use: https://apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://noctie.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00116335:ios.description:
Xplora app – GPS Tracker & Parental Control App for Xplora Watch and Xplora Phone 
The official companion app for Xplora devices – developed to support safe communication, movement tracking, and healthy digital habits for families. 
Whether you're setting up an Xplora watch for a child or managing an Xplora phone for a teen, the Xplora app provides tools to help families stay informed, connected, and engaged. 
Compatible with all current Xplora watches and phones. 
Designed for Family Connection & Oversight 
- Location overview via GPS tracking. 
- Calls and messaging with parent-managed contact lists. 
- School Mode to minimize device distractions during learning hours. 
- Customizable Safe Zones with entry/exit notifications. 
- SOS button and battery status alerts. 
The app helps caregivers manage how and when children and teens use their Xplora devices — offering a balance of independence and supervision. 
Xplora Goplay Activity Service - Encouraging Activity Through Engagement
Xplora Goplay Activity Service is Xplora’s integrated platform designed to promote physical activity in a playful and interactive way. 
- Earn digital coins by reaching step goals. 
- Access optional step challenges and interactive features. 
- Explore age-appropriate mini games and curated content. 
- Discover a content area with educational and creative materials. 
- Availability of features may vary by device or region. 
Simple Family Management Tools 
- Pair and monitor multiple Xplora devices from one place. 
- Set contacts, alarms, permissions, and app settings. 
- Receive activity updates and device notifications. 
- Adjust features and preferences with a few taps. 
Why Families Choose Xplora
- Easy to set up and manage. 
- Options to limit internet or social media access (on supported models). 
- Tools that align with digital wellbeing goals. 
Common Use Cases 
- Families looking for GPS-enabled communication tools. 
- Parents introducing a first phone experience with usage boundaries. 
- Caregivers supporting activity tracking and engagement. 
- Anyone seeking more visibility and control over their child’s device use. 
Download the Xplora app today to begin managing your family’s connected experience – with features developed to support safety, awareness, and healthy habits.

bluejetty:00027174:ios.summary:

Browse the web from your couch, control your music, or give a presentation from across the room. Mobile Mouse combines a wireless mouse, multi-touch t
bluejetty:00027174:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a remote control for your Mac or Windows PC.
Browse the web from your couch, control your music, or give a presentation from across the room. Mobile Mouse combines a wireless mouse, multi-touch trackpad, keyboard, and dedicated media and presentation controls in one app—with no subscription fees.
Use your iPhone or iPad as a trackpad, or control the pointer with the motion of your hand using air mouse mode. On Apple Watch, move the pointer, switch applications, control playback, and navigate presentations right from your wrist.
MOUSE & KEYBOARD
• Multi-touch trackpad with full-screen portrait and landscape modes
• Air mouse control using the motion of your hand
• Remote keyboard with numeric keypad and international keyboard support
• Programmable hotkeys
• A familiar Dock-style application launcher
• Sleep and wake controls for your computer
MUSIC, VIDEO & WEB
• Dedicated media and web remotes
• Playback and volume controls
• Album artwork and track information for Apple Music and Spotify
• Control supported desktop apps and media websites
• Automatically pause or mute media when a call comes in
ACTIONS & CAMERA SCANNING
• Use Actions from apps that support sharing to send photos and text directly to your computer
• Scan text, photos, QR codes, UPC barcodes, and documents with your iPhone camera and insert them into applications on your computer
PRESENTATIONS
• Control Keynote and PowerPoint presentations
• Navigate slides from your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch
• Access advanced presentation controls with the Pro option
FILE ACCESS & CONTENT SHARING
• Browse files on your computer remotely
• Send photos and text from your computer to your iPhone or iPad
• Send phone numbers to your iPhone or open addresses in Maps
APPLE WATCH
• Trackpad with pointer control and scrolling
• Application switcher for running apps
• Basic presentation controls for moving forward and backward through slides
• Media playback and volume controls
• Album artwork and track information for Apple Music and Spotify
CONNECTIVITY & SECURITY
• Connect over Wi-Fi
• Use Bluetooth or USB on Mac
• Encryption support
• Password protection
OPTIONAL CLOUD ADD-ON (subscription)
• Connect to your computer through the cloud. Great for public networks
• Scan a QR code to open the web remote in your browser
REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone or iPad running iOS 12.0 or later
• Mac running macOS 10.14 or later, or PC running Windows 10 or later
• Wi-Fi router for Wi-Fi connections
• Mobile Mouse Server installed on your computer
GET STARTED
Download and install Mobile Mouse Server on your Mac or Windows PC at https://mobilemouse.com, then connect the app to your computer.
NEED HELP?
Visit https://mobilemouse.com for setup instructions, demos, and troubleshooting. If you need assistance, contact us through the website.
Privacy Policy: https://mobilemouse.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://mobilemouse.com/terms

카톡으로 보내어 친구들에게도 이 재미를 알려주세요~
한번 시작하시면.. 멈출수없는 중독을 보여드립니다.
아!! 고급유머를 보실땐 wifi를 권장합니다.
(LTE로 봐도 되염..)

- 구독기간은 한달이고 가격은 $1입니다.
- 앱스토어에 등록된 카드 정보로 결제가 이루어집니다.
- 구독 기간이 만료되면 정기구독이 자동 갱신됩니다. 현재 구독기간이 끝나기 24시간이내에 해제하지 않으면 자동구독 갱신됩니다.
- 구독만료 24시간이전에 해제하지 않으면 가입이 자동으로 갱신되고 새로 갱신하는 비용이 계정에서 결제됩니다.

 - 현재 고급유머앱은 무료 평가판 기간을 제공하고 있지 않습니다.

bluejetty:00124286:ios.description:
The new update: Elemental Power has come out!
==============================================================
Touch Arcade – “A stand-out in RPG genre!”
App Advice – “An intense and fast-paced dungeon crawler!”
148 Apps – “Make this the Year of the Panda!”
Inside X Game*Spark – “Best of Social/Mobile E3 2015”
==Features==
The Journey Begins
Grab your sword and battle hordes of crazy creatures, magical mysteries, and sinister specters on an action-filled journey to become the ultimate legend! Prove you have what it takes in a goofy and thrilling action adventure MMO rendered with PC game quality 3D graphics and full-body motion capture technology.
Slash Through Opponents
True power lies within, unleash your hero and fight through to infinity! Battle through unique levels wielding blades, magic, and fists to bash enemies into oblivion with a fun, fast-paced action combat system. Master the unique skills of 6 distinct heroes to defeat enemies and become the ultimate champion of Avzar!
Discover Powerful Gear
Build up a powerful hero through strength and cunning in an RPG adventure! Collect and upgrade gear, skills, pets and mounts to increase your might and unlock your inner potential. Do you have what it takes to become a Taichi Legend?
Battle Online and Rule the Land
Join in online PvP and co-op with other players! Take on powerful bosses, and become a hero alongside allies in Team Instances. Battle in the arena, join Guilds for online Guild competition and co-op, or enter the fray in 25v25 Battle Royale PvP. Capture territory in Warpath, and rise to the top in team arena PvP League!
==Connect==
Visit our official site to learn more about Taichi Panda: http://panda.snail.com/en
Join the Taichi Panda community and learn more on Facebook and our official Forum 
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/TaichiPandaOfficial
Community Forum: http://pandabbs.snail.com/

Missouri Star Quilt Co - Your Quilting Companion
Welcome to the Missouri Star Quilt Co app, your ultimate companion for all things quilting! Whether you're an experienced quilter or just starting on your quilting journey, our app is designed to make your quilting projects easier, more enjoyable, and incredibly creative.
Key Features:
1. Video Tutorials and Classes: Learn from the best with our video tutorials and quilting classes. Improve your skills, discover new techniques, and unlock your quilting potential.
2. Browse Thousands of Fabrics: Explore our extensive collection of high-quality fabrics, from classic prints to modern designs. Find the perfect fabric for your next quilting project with ease.
3. Quilt Patterns Galore: Discover a treasure trove of quilt patterns suitable for quilters of all skill levels. From traditional blocks to contemporary designs, our app offers step-by-step instructions and video tutorials to help you create stunning quilts.
4. Precut Fabrics and Kits: Browse and purchase precut fabric bundles and quilt kits curated by our experts. Take the guesswork out of fabric selection and start quilting right away.
5. Exclusive Deals and Discounts: Stay updated with our latest promotions, exclusive discounts, and special offers. Save money while stocking up on your quilting essentials.
6. Personalized Wishlist: Create a wishlist of your favorite fabrics and products, making it easy to keep track of your quilting aspirations.
7. Easy Ordering and Fast Shipping: Shop with confidence through our secure and user-friendly ordering process. Experience fast shipping and reliable customer service.
8. Stay Inspired: Get your daily dose of quilting inspiration with our featured quilts, customer projects, and staff picks.
Join the Missouri Star Quilt Co community and transform your quilting dreams into beautiful, tangible creations. Download our app today and embark on a quilting adventure like never before! Your quilting journey begins here.

bluejetty:00026689:ios.summary:

Get the gear:
• Shop instantly. Our app is built from the g
bluejetty:00026689:ios.description:
Browse and shop for lululemon gear from anywhere! Be ready for all your sweaty pursuits with technical athletic clothing and accessories for running, cross-training, and yoga.  
Get the gear:
• Shop instantly. Our app is built from the ground up to feel as snappy as your personal bests.
• You’ll find high-quality photos of products taken from every angle and a zoom-in feature that lets you nerd out hard on every technical detail. 
• Inventory-check your local store and find out right from your phone if your size and color are in stock. 
• Favorites: So many products to love, so little time! Add products to your Favorites list so you can easily come back to them later.
• eGift Cards: Buy electronic gift cards for your family and friends through the app and send them directly to their email. 
• Store Locator: Find store hours and locations right on your phone. 
• Pay with ApplePay
Connect with the community:
• Join our global yoga ambassadors for 20, 45 or 60-minute yoga classes
• Find local events tailored to your favorite sweaty pursuits.
• Get inspired by real and authentic stories posted by our own ambassadors and stores.
• Curious about what goes into our gear? Get an insider look through exclusive behind-the-scenes videos.
Manage your account:
• Use Touch ID or Face ID to make sign-in easy; rest assured, your biometric data is protected and safe. 
• My Account: Update your profile and subscribe to product emails in the improved Account settings.
• Store your preferences and purchase information to make checkout a breeze. And of course, standard shipping is always complimentary. 
Founded in Vancouver British Columbia in 1998, the first lululemon athletica store shared space with a yoga studio. We’ve grown quite a bit since then and our technical athletic apparel for men and women is now available online, in stores, and in showrooms all over the world. 
Have an idea, problem, or feedback? Get in touch at gec@lululemon.com

It’s Red’s birthday but none of his oil-hungry friends showed up! There’s only one solution — hunt for oil using your maths & coding skills! 
Are you ready to build the biggest, most amazing beach party the world has ever seen? Fly your oil-guzzling balloon, drink and collect oil using your maths & coding skills, bring it back to the party and serve your thirsty friends!

bluejetty:00124345:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00124345:ios.description:
Evernote is your second brain — the place to keep everything that matters and find it again the moment you need it.
"…an invaluable tool for organizing a messy digital life." — The New York Times
Capture a thought, a to-do, a photo, or a whole project, then let Evernote help you organize it, make sense of it, transcribe a meeting or tidy up a rough draft, and bring it back exactly when it counts. From the first spark of an idea to the finished plan, it all lives in one calm, searchable place — at work, at home, and everywhere in between.
CAPTURE ANYTHING
Jot a quick note, build a checklist, save a photo, an email or a PDF, or clip an article from the web before it disappears. Type it out, write by hand, snap a picture, or record a voice memo — whatever's fastest in the moment. Your ideas land in one place, ready when you are, so nothing gets lost on a sticky note or buried in your inbox.
STAY ORGANIZED, EFFORTLESSLY
Sort notes into notebooks and add tags, or just start writing and let structure follow. Group related notes together, pin the ones you reach for most, and keep work, school, and life neatly apart — without spending your day tidying up. Evernote keeps things in order so you can stay focused on the thinking.
FIND WHAT YOU NEED, FAST
Search across everything you've saved — including the text inside your images and PDFs. Ask in plain language and Semantic Search surfaces the right note, even when you can't remember the exact words or where you put it. The more you save, the more useful it becomes.
MEET YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Your AI Assistant clears away the busywork so you can stay in the thinking, working quietly alongside you. Record a conversation and Evernote AI transcribes and summarizes it for you; AI Transcription turns audio, images, and video into text; and AI Edit cleans up a rough draft, shortens it, or changes the tone while keeping it in your own voice.
PLAN YOUR DAY
Add due dates, reminders, and to-dos right inside your notes, so the next step is always clear and nothing slips through the cracks. Check things off as you go and keep momentum without switching apps.
WORK EVERYWHERE
Your notes sync automatically across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, and the web — start on one device and pick up right where you left off on another. Evernote works offline too, so you're never locked out of your own ideas, even when you're far from a signal.
FOR WORK, SCHOOL, AND LIFE
- Plan projects, prep meetings, and keep every detail in one place.
- Take lecture notes, organize research, and study smarter for exams.
- Save recipes, plan trips, track goals, and remember the little things that matter.
- Keep a journal, draft your next big idea, and capture inspiration whenever it strikes.
"Its magic lies in its flexibility." — PCMag
However you think, and whatever you're working on, Evernote helps you remember everything and get it done. Capture today's idea — and find it the moment you need it.

bluejetty:00091624:ios.summary: Via2G is a ride-sharing app powered by Via. Via2G is a convenient and easy way to commute between work and home. This intelligent service allows passengers to share their journey with others. Book a ride and Via’s powerful algorithm matches
bluejetty:00091624:ios.description:
Via2G is a ride-sharing app powered by Via. Via2G is a convenient and easy way to commute between work and home. This intelligent service allows passengers to share their journey with others. Book a ride and Via’s powerful algorithm matches you with a vehicle that will pick you up at a convenient spot nearby. 
How does Via2G work?
- Via2G is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the Via2G app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a few streets of your requested destination. Our smart algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel.
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. You can also track your vehicle in real time in the app.
How many passengers will I share a vehicle with?
- The number of passengers you will share a journey with varies based on capacity and your chosen destination! Our comfortable vehicle can easily accommodate up to 5 passengers.
Via2G is guaranteed to change the way that you think about commuting. We look forward to seeing you on your next journey. Just click and go!
Love our app? Please rate us! Questions? Email us at Via2G@google.com.

bluejetty:00074337:ios.description:
Capital Bikeshare is DC, Virginia, and Maryland’s bike share system, and the first large scale bikeshare in the nation. Capital Bikeshare (CaBi) has thousands of bikes at hundreds of stations across Washington DC, Arlington, Alexandria, Tysons, Reston, Silver Spring, Takoma Park, Bethesda and Chevy Chase. Best of all, it’s available 24/7.
CaBi consists of a fleet of specially designed, sturdy and durable bikes that are locked into a network of docking stations throughout the city. The bikes can be unlocked from one station and returned to any other station in the system, making them ideal for one-way trips. People use bike share to commute to work, meet friends for dinner, or simply cruise around and see new sights. After signing up, all trips under 30 minutes are free.
The CaBi App lets you purchase rides, unlock a bike, and ride right away. You can also view all station locations, see available bikes and docks, and get walking directions to them to start your ride.
The Capital Bikeshare app also shows upcoming public transit departures, including WMATA Metrorail, Metrobus, and shuttle lines, DC Circulator buses, Fairfax Connector buses, Montgomery RideOn buses, Alexandria DASH buses, Prince George’s County TheBus buses, Arlington Regional Transit buses, VRE trains, and the Silver Line Express. 
Within the app, you can purchase the following:
Single Ride
Access Pass
Membership
Happy riding!

bluejetty:00126287:ios.summary:
LEVEL YOUR CLASSROOM LIBRARY
QuickScan Book Leveler shows you a book's reading levels. Just scan the barcode with your camera to see AR, Lexile, Guided Reading, and more - and see which of them QuickScan looked up and which it estimated. Q
bluejetty:00126287:ios.description:
LEVEL YOUR CLASSROOM LIBRARY
QuickScan Book Leveler shows you a book's reading levels. Just scan the barcode with your camera to see AR, Lexile, Guided Reading, and more - and see which of them QuickScan looked up and which it estimated. QuickScan is from the makers of BookScanner, used by teachers since 2012.
PERFECT FOR TEACHERS AND PARENTS
- Organize your classroom library by reading level
- Match students with books at their just-right level
- Check reading levels before buying books
- Track books your students have read
5 READING LEVELS, PLUS AR POINTS AND INTEREST LEVEL
No more hunting through multiple websites. QuickScan shows you where every level came from:
- AR (Accelerated Reader) / ATOS levels - looked up, never estimated
- Lexile measures - looked up, never estimated
- Guided Reading Level (GRL) / F&P - looked up from Scholastic when Scholastic has it; otherwise QuickScan estimates it and marks it ≈
- DRA (Developmental Reading Assessment) - marked ≈ when QuickScan estimates it
- Grade level equivalent - marked ≈ when QuickScan estimates it
- Interest level (LG, MG, MG+, UG)
- AR Points and Word Count
Above P, QuickScan doesn't estimate a Guided Reading Level: where Scholastic has no level for a longer chapter book, QuickScan shows none rather than a letter it can't stand behind.
NO BARCODE? FIND IT ANOTHER WAY
When a barcode won't scan, or it isn't the book's ISBN, type the book's title instead. On iPhone and iPad models whose camera can read text, QuickScan can also read the title from the cover or spine for you to check before it searches, or read the ISBN printed on the book.
SAVE YOUR SCAN HISTORY
Never lose track of books you've scanned. QuickScan automatically saves every book with full reading level data. Search, filter, and sort your history to find any book you've scanned.
EXPORT YOUR BOOK LISTS
Create professional book lists for your classroom:
- Export to CSV for spreadsheets
- Export to PDF for printing
- Share individual books or your entire library
- Auto-dated files keep you organized
WORKS ON MAC, TOO
Use QuickScan on your Mac with your webcam. Scan books right at your desk. Your scan history syncs automatically between iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
See your recently scanned books right on your Home Screen. Add the Quick Scan widget for one-tap access to the camera.
BUILT FOR EDUCATORS
- No ads - ever
- No student data collection
- Works offline after initial lookup
- Free to use with a daily scan limit - upgrade in the app for unlimited scanning
Whether you're a teacher leveling a classroom library, a reading specialist matching students with books, or a parent finding appropriate reads - QuickScan Book Leveler makes reading level lookup effortless.
Download now and level your first book.

Fountas & Pinnell, F&P and Guided Reading Level are trademarks of their respective owners. QuickScan is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Renaissance Learning, MetaMetrics or Fountas & Pinnell. DRA and Developmental Reading Assessment are trademarks of their owner.

Care My Way® from Marshfield Clinic provides you with quick resolutions to common health conditions through an online appointment with one of our trusted, experienced nurse practitioners.
Care My Way® is available from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. CST, seven days a week and is only available to people residing in Wisconsin, Michigan and Minnesota. The cost for each visit is $40 and is collected at the time of service. (Major credit cards accepted).
If you need a prescription, one can be sent to the pharmacy of your choice.
Common conditions treated through Care My Way include:
· Athlete's Foot
· Pink eye
· Canker sores
· Cold sores
· Constipation
· Diaper rash
· Eczema
· Head lice
· Heartburn (GERD)
· Impetigo
· Flu (Influenza)
· Jock itch
· Lyme disease preventive treatment
· Mastitis
· Mild thermal burns
· Pertussis (Whooping cough) exposure
· Pinworms
· Poison ivy rash
· Scabies exposure
· Seasonal allergies 
· Sinus infection
· Strep throat - lab required at Marshfield Clinic facility
· Stye
· Sunburn
· Thrush
· Upper respiratory infection
· Urinary tract infection
· Vaginal yeast infection
Some age and gender restrictions apply. Visit www.caremyway.org for specifics.

bluejetty:00148884:ios.description:
Take payments quickly and securely with Elavon Mobile, easy-to-use mobile point of sale solution that lets you run your business on the go. 
Features 
Elavon Mobile is an intuitive point of sale solution that’s perfect for small or larger businesses that have a basic product catalog. With Elavon Mobile, you can accept payments from your business or on the go while having full access to all the tools you need to get your business up and running. Some of the key features and functionality included on the Elavon Mobile app include: 
Accept contactless payments with only an iPhone. No extra terminals or hardware needed. 
With Tap to Pay on iPhone in the Elavon Mobile app, you can accept in-person, contactless payments, right on your iPhone — from physical debit and credit cards, to Apple Pay and other digital wallets — no extra terminals or hardware needed. It’s easy, secure, and private. 
Give your customers flexible payment options 
Elavon Mobile lets you accept all major credit cards, along with digital wallets. 
Get paid faster with Elavon Invoicing 
In just a few clicks, you can create, manage and send invoices right from your Elavon Mobile app. Plus, Elavon Mobile gives your customers flexibility to pay their invoice in person or online. 
Drive store traffic with Elavon Gift 
Encourage repeat visits to your business with physical and digital gift cards included with your Elavon Mobile app. 
Send instant SMS and email receipts to customers 
The digital receipt capabilities on Elavon Mobile make it easier for your customers to keep track of their transactions, and they eliminate the manual process and cost of paper products that come with traditional receipts. 
Stay organized with menu management 
With Elavon Mobile, you can create an in-app catalog or menu with up to 100 items and organize them into unique product categories. 
Simplify your tax support 
The Elavon Mobile app allows you to create add on or inclusive taxes to automatically be applied to each item as you add it to an order, eliminating the need to manually add taxes to your sales total. 
Take control of discounts & service charges 
You decide how you want to add custom discounts and service charges to an order using dollar amounts or percentages. 
Start your day with a daily sales summary 
Track your revenue growth with full reporting of your sales, trends and more on Elavon Mobile’s in-app dashboard. 
Split the bill between multiple customers 
Especially common in the restaurant industry, Elavon Mobile lets you accept multiple payments on a single order.

bluejetty:00041339:ios.description:
Never carry loyalty, membership, or library cards again! Key Ring is the app for loyalty cards and savings while shopping. Plan, save, and organize by carrying your cards and your shopping lists – all in one app.
No more forgetting your reward cards at home or holding up the checkout line while you dig through your wallet. Give your keychain, wallet, or purse a rest and digitally store those loyalty cards.
 • Saving money at the store is effortless when you have your shopper cards handy
 • Easily earn your loyalty rewards by scanning your card from your phone
 • Your cards are safely backed up in the cloud with a free Key Ring account
Say goodbye to switching between multiple accounts to view your membership cards. You can now link those accounts to your Key Ring cards! Here are the retailers you can now link accounts for (with more to come):
Amazon 
Best Buy 
CVS

If you like to plan ahead, you can build shopping lists to plan your next trip to the store.
 • Shopping lists can be shared with family members or friends
 • Add pictures to your shopping list to ensure you get the right item when you’re shopping
 • Real-time syncing between accounts means you always have the most updated list whether you’re planning at home or shopping at the store
Who Recommends Us?
Key Ring has been featured in Real Simple, Martha Stewart Living, Family Circle, and on the Today Show as an “app for all ages.”
Why Should You Use Key Ring?
 • Always carry your loyalty, membership, and library cards without weighing down your keychain, wallet, or purse
 • Discover great savings
 • Easily browse weekly ads and see what’s on sale from your phone
 • Create and share shopping lists so you won’t forget a deal at the store
Features Include:
 • Barcode scanner: Add your loyalty cards by scanning the barcode
 • Loyalty card database: Support for over 2,000 barcode and non-barcode loyalty, membership, and library cards
 • Remote cloud backup: Never worry about losing your loyalty cards again
 • Favorites: Put your favorite reward cards and circulars at your fingertips
 • Shopping Lists: Stay organized and plan your shopping trip before you go to the store
 • Sharing: Share loyalty cards, savings, and shopping lists with family and friends
 • Notifications: Always remember to use your reward card or get reminded of sales with alerts about local savings (Optional- continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life)

bluejetty:00151287:ios.name: Bugko
bluejetty:00151287:ios.summary: Bugko is an unofficial app (fan made) all-in-one companion app designed for Magic: The Gathering (MTG) players and judges. Bugko focused on offering unique core features such as news aggregation, spoiler alert, tournament deck list update,
bluejetty:00151287:ios.description:
Bugko is an unofficial app (fan made) all-in-one companion app designed for Magic: The Gathering (MTG) players and judges. Bugko focused on offering unique core features such as news aggregation, spoiler alert, tournament deck list update, card syntax search and many more. Other familiar features like life counter, wish list, collection tracker, offline card search, random card, comprehensive rule, deck building are also built inside Bugko for a complete experience. Bugko will be the first modern designed MTG app you will truly enjoy.
Bugko is the only app that bring together all favorite MTG, MTGO and Arena news sources into one place. News channel currently available including Channel Fireball, MTG Goldfish, Mythic Spoiler, Star City Games and 40+ news sources. You can scroll through all news and spoilers happening right now once you open the app. With push notification in app, you surely will never miss a single important news update from your favorite news channels. Latest spoiled card? Bugko got you covered.
Bugko is built with a powerful yet offline accessible cards database. You can choose to search through 30,000+ cards using our blazing fast syntax search designed for power users or simply use the search filter available with user friendly interface. With latest card pricing directly from TCGPlayer and Cardmarket, you can check, buy, trade, or track your collection wherever you are.
Are you a Magic judge? Bugko has tools specially designed for judges. Scripted draft timer, Infraction Procedure Guide (IPG) reference, Magic Tournament Rule (MTR) document, offline comprehensive rule with complete search functionality inside etc. Many of the features in Bugko are carefully designed to cater to the needs of judges as well. For example, an offline card database, card text in multiple languages, judge blog or news update and more. Great for judges that travel around the world for events.
Features:
- Latest MTG news and spoiler from 40+ popular news channels with notification alert.
- Life counter support 2-8 players, 15 different counters, counter changes history, mana pool and modern design.
- Offline complete database including all latest cards printed, promo cards, 11+ printed languages, 20+ formats banlist, card rulings, reserved list and etc.
- Powerful card search engine that support syntax search, 25+ card properties filter, random card and etc.
- Latest card pricing including all promo cards, foil cards, different art variety directly from TCGPlayer or Cardmarket.
- Auto currency converter available in 30+ currencies.
- Track your collection, trading and wish list with up-to-date price wherever you go.
- Deck builder with winning decklist from Standard, Modern and Legacy formats.
- Tools for judges like offline searchable comprehensive rule, MTG, IPG, quick reference, scripted draft timer, decklist counter, offline documents and etc.
Disclaimer: Magic: The Gathering (also known as MTG) card design, text, images, expansions, and symbols are trademark and copyright of Wizards of the Coast, Hasbro, LLC. Bugko is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or specifically approved by Wizards of the Coast LLC.

bluejetty:00023932:ios.summary:

The app allows you to do many of the most common tasks you'd otherwise do on the website:
• See your re
bluejetty:00023932:ios.description:
Finale is a fully-featured Last.fm client with lots of advanced features, including support for easily scrobbling the music around you!
The app allows you to do many of the most common tasks you'd otherwise do on the website:
• See your recent scrobbles
• View your top tracks, artists, and albums over a certain period
• View your weekly charts
• Check your friends' stats
• Search for and get details about albums, artists, and songs
The app also includes lots of advanced features:
• Beautiful home screen widgets for your stats and top artists, albums, and tracks
• Scrobbling from Apple Music (including automatic background scrobbling)
• Manual scrobbling
• Edit/delete scrobbles
• Batch album scrobbling
• Shazam-like scrobbling: just tap a button, give the app a few seconds to listen through your phone's microphone, and the song you're listening to will be recognized for you to scrobble!
• Continuous Shazam-like scrobbling: continuously detect and automatically scrobble music playing around you with just one tap - great for listening to the radio or a record!
• Scrobbling from friends
• Generate beautiful collages of your top artists, albums, and tracks over various time periods
• Search and scrobble from Spotify's database and your Apple Music library
• I'm Feeling Lucky: generate random tracks, artists, and albums from a user's library in a certain period
• Sign in with Strava to see what songs you listened to during your workouts
Finale is, has been, and always will be 100% free, ad-free, and open source. You can find a link to the source code on the About screen. If you like the app, consider leaving a review.

bluejetty:00174913:ios.description:
The Psychic Tarot for the Heart Oracle Card app was created to assist and guide you in matters of the heart, especially the different relationships in your life. Relationships of all kinds are really about you! They will often reflect back what you need to see and the lessons you need to learn.
By using this deck and the techniques that psychic medium John Holland imparts, along with the wisdom of the tarot, you’ll begin to understand and look at relationships — past, present, and future — with an intuitive eye. This deck is not just for lovers! These cards will resonate with anyone and add clarity around all types of relationships, including the most important one of all . . . the relationship with your self.
FEATURES:
- Give readings anywhere, anytime
- Choose between different types of readings
- Save your readings to review at any time
- Email readings to friends
- Browse the entire deck of cards
- Flip cards over to read each card's meaning
- Get the most out of your deck with the guidebook
- Set a daily reminder for a reading
About the Author
Internationally renowned psychic medium John Holland has been lecturing, teaching, demonstrating, and reading for private clients for more than 18 years. He believes passionately that once the physical body dies, our spirit lives on. He has dedicated his life to his own spiritual development and teaching, as well as offering peace and comfort during times of loss and bereavement. 
Author of the bestsellers Power of the Soul, Born Knowing, Psychic Navigator, and 101 Ways to Jump-Start Your Intuition, John also hosted his own weekly radio show on Hay House Radio, Spirit Connections. He has become a familiar face on TV on programs such as the A&E special Mediums—We See Dead People, as well as appearing as a psychic authority on the History Channel’s Psychic History. John’s story was originally profiled on CBS’s Unsolved Mysteries.

bluejetty:00124170:ios.description:
Build a legendary squad in this epic dark fantasy RPG! Summon hundreds of Champions from 16 factions, master turn-based tactics, and lead your army to free Teleria from the Dark Lord Siroth.
Collect. Gear up. Conquer. Your Champions, your strategy, your legend. Whether you play for a few minutes or a few hours, there is always a new battle to win, a new Champion to chase, and a new challenge to master.
| Enjoy deep RPG features |
Collect powerful Champions
Summon orcs, knights, elves, demons, undead, and more to defeat your foes. Every Champion has unique skills and a role to play, from fearless attackers to life-saving healers and unbreakable defenders. Mix factions, discover powerful synergies, and build the team only you could create.
Strategic turn-based RPG gameplay
Equip your Champions with amazing Gear, then level them up, rank them up, and unlock Masteries to make their devastating skills even more powerful, from AOE attacks to game-changing magic. Every battle rewards smart team building and sharp tactics, not just raw power. Choose the right Gear sets, plan your turn order, and watch the perfect strategy turn a tough fight into a flawless victory.
Fight epic Boss battles
Vanquish challenging Bosses in dangerous Dungeons for loot, XP, and special drops. Climb the Doom Tower, face the Dragon, the Spider, and the Fire Knight, and push your squad to its limits. Then, in classic turn-based RPG style, come back stronger and fight them again for even greater rewards!
Join forces with a Clan
Team up with fellow players in Clans to take on challenges like the fearsome Clan Boss and Hydra, and conquer the fortresses of enemy Clans in intense Sieges. Share strategies, complete Clan quests together, and earn rewards you could never claim alone. Stronger together, unstoppable as one.
Face multiplayer PvP Arenas
Go head-to-head with players from around the world to unlock special Gear. Rise through the ranks and become an Arena legend in both asynchronous and real-time multiplayer battles. Outsmart your rivals, counter their strategies, and prove you're the greatest tactician in Teleria.
Clear our massive PvE campaign
Experience epic dark fantasy through 12 spectacular RPG locations spread over a sprawling, fully-voiced story campaign. Then test the strength of every faction in Faction Wars, where each faction faces its own trials and unlocks exclusive rewards. Heed your heroic duty and quell the forces of darkness.
Dive into a deep fantasy world
Learn about Teleria's heroes and villains with our growing collection of Champion bios, and check out our animated limited series, RAID: Call of the Arbiter, on YouTube! New Champions, events, and updates arrive regularly, so the adventure keeps growing.
Your Champions are waiting. Download RAID: Shadow Legends now and begin your legend!

listings.name: RAID: Shadow Legends
listings.description:
Build a legendary squad in this epic dark fantasy RPG! Summon hundreds of Champions from 16 factions, master turn-based tactics, and lead your army to free Teleria from the Dark Lord Siroth.

Collect. Gear up. Conquer. Your Champions, your strategy, your legend. Whether you play for a few minutes or a few hours, there is always a new battle to win, a new Champion to chase, and a new challenge to master.

| Enjoy deep RPG features |

Collect powerful Champions
Summon orcs, knights, elves, demons, undead, and more to defeat your foes. Every Champion has unique skills and a role to play, from fearless attackers to life-saving healers and unbreakable defenders. Mix factions, discover powerful synergies, and build the team only you could create.

Strategic turn-based RPG gameplay
Equip your Champions with amazing Gear, then level them up, rank them up, and unlock Masteries to make their devastating skills even more powerful, from AOE attacks to game-changing magic. Every battle rewards smart team building and sharp tactics, not just raw power. Choose the right Gear sets, plan your turn order, and watch the perfect strategy turn a tough fight into a flawless victory.

Fight epic Boss battles
Vanquish challenging Bosses in dangerous Dungeons for loot, XP, and special drops. Climb the Doom Tower, face the Dragon, the Spider, and the Fire Knight, and push your squad to its limits. Then, in classic turn-based RPG style, come back stronger and fight them again for even greater rewards!

Join forces with a Clan
Team up with fellow players in Clans to take on challenges like the fearsome Clan Boss and Hydra, and conquer the fortresses of enemy Clans in intense Sieges. Share strategies, complete Clan quests together, and earn rewards you could never claim alone. Stronger together, unstoppable as one.

Face multiplayer PvP Arenas
Go head-to-head with players from around the world to unlock special Gear. Rise through the ranks and become an Arena legend in both asynchronous and real-time multiplayer battles. Outsmart your rivals, counter their strategies, and prove you're the greatest tactician in Teleria.

Clear our massive PvE campaign
Experience epic dark fantasy through 12 spectacular RPG locations spread over a sprawling, fully-voiced story campaign. Then test the strength of every faction in Faction Wars, where each faction faces its own trials and unlocks exclusive rewards. Heed your heroic duty and quell the forces of darkness.

Dive into a deep fantasy world
Learn about Teleria's heroes and villains with our growing collection of Champion bios, and check out our animated limited series, RAID: Call of the Arbiter, on YouTube! New Champions, events, and updates arrive regularly, so the adventure keeps growing.

Your Champions are waiting. Download RAID: Shadow Legends now and begin your legend!

bluejetty:00083278:ios.description:
Monet is a powerful yet easy to use AI app for removing objects and fixing photos. Its advanced AI allows you to apply any changes to your photo using your text description with high realism.
ADD & REPLACE
Select objects on your photo, type in your description and let the AI do a complex job. For example, select your old shoes on the photo and enter “white sneakers” to get brand new ones, or add “six pack abs” on your beach photo for Tinder. Imagination is the only limit!
ERASE
Just select unwanted objects or people on your photo and tap Erase. Monet is able to remove objects like they never existed on the photo!
EXPAND PHOTO
This feature is useful when you have a nice but badly cropped photo and you want to restore the missing parts, like legs or arms. You may also want to change the aspect ratio of your photo without cropping it to post it in stories, for example. 
UPSCALE
Improve the quality and increase the dimensions of your photo up to 4k. Export your photo in high resolution.
OUTFITS
Have fun with cool filters. Try different styles: business look, a superman, an athlete, wearing a latex catsuit and many more. Just import your photo and try different styles with a single tap.
GENERATE IMAGES
Generate high quality AI art with any aspect ratio and style. Use the Variations feature to generate more images similar to the one you like.
Important Notice: This app does not allow generation of sexual, explicit, or adult content. Such content is strictly prohibited.
