bluejetty:00177255:ios.description:
Join the SimpleFit family! SimpleFit is a meal prep and fitness app by Yovana Mendoza designed to make eating healthy and getting fit in a fun and practical way! Offering over 100 recipes, meal plans, recipe videos, daily inspiration, at home workout routines, yoga and meditation videos. SimpleFit has meal plans for your specific needs and your eating preferences to help you get in the best shape of your life and reach your health goals! 
Features
RECIPES
Over 100 recipes ranging from breakfasts, main meals, snacks, juices, and smoothies. 
Recipes come with nutritional information, step by step instructions, photos, and instructional videos.
Choose the number of servings you want to make of any recipe and the ingredients will be modified. 
Add recipes to your grocery shopping list and have it ready to go when you go out shopping. 
Ability to save your favorite recipes.
MEAL PLANS 
SimpleFit app will design a plan that is right for you and tailored to your needs based on your gender, height, weight, and health goal (lose weight, maintain, or gain). 
You can choose from Plant-Based, Vegetarian, Regular, Keto, Paleo, or Pescatarian meal plans. 
All meal plans come with a description related to the specific diet and lifestyle. 
SUBSCRIPTION 
SimpleFit is free to download and offers three premium subscriptions, monthly, annually, and lifetime. All options include a 7-day trial. SimpleFit Premium provides full access to the app including all meal plans and recipes. 
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account.

bluejetty:00021215:ios.description:
Transform yarn into beautiful handmade creations with personalized knitting lessons designed for every skill level. Whether you're picking up needles for the first time or refining advanced techniques, our comprehensive platform guides you from simple stitches to intricate patterns.
Perfect Your Knitting Skills Step-by-Step
Learning to knit has never been more accessible. Our expertly crafted video tutorials break down complex techniques into simple, manageable steps that anyone can follow. Watch close-up demonstrations of every stitch, pause and replay as needed, and progress at your own comfortable pace. From casting on your first row to mastering cable knits and colorwork, you'll build confidence with each completed project.

bluejetty:00026273:ios.description:
Are you ready to embark on a funny adventure of wit, laughter, and brain-teasing challenges? Welcome to Happy Ending, the ultimate riddle and puzzle game that will put your creativity and problem-solving skills to the test!
Step into the shoes of a master storyteller as you delve into a delightful world of surprises and happy conclusions. Picture yourself as the ingenious judge of fate, equipped with a magical box of characters, objects, and settings waiting to be rearranged like pieces of a jigsaw puzzle. Your mission is to create the most uproarious, heartwarming, and unforgettable scenarios for our charming characters.
As the ultimate brain teaser, Happy Ending dares you to unravel clever riddles that will bend and twist your mind. Each level presents a unique challenge, requiring you to think outside the box and devise ingenious solutions. Can you piece together the perfect sequence of events that lead to a joyous outcome?
The gameplay is both fun and addictive. Your objective is simple: put your creativity to the test and conjure up the most hilarious, surprising, and satisfying endings. With every tap and drag, you become the mastermind behind the happiness of your characters. Witness their delight and excitement as your scenarios come to life before your eyes!
But beware, for every level promises new twists and turns, making each challenge more intricate than the last. Don't be fooled by the simplicity of the graphics; beneath the surface lies a complex web of puzzles, just waiting for the right storyteller to weave their magic.
So, are you up for the challenge? Can you be the champion of happy endings? Join us now and embrace the joy of solving riddles, crafting puzzles, and being the source of endless fun and surprise! Remember, in this world, the only limit is your imagination. Get ready to embark on an adventure filled with laughter, satisfaction, and the warm glow of a Happy Ending!

Plan, book, and manage your hotel and resort stays with ease. With the World of Hyatt app, enjoy the best rate guaranteed when you book direct, making every journey seamless and rewarding. Not a member yet? Join for free to get exclusive rates and earn points towards travel rewards 
MANAGE YOUR STAY WITH CONVENIENT FEATURES 
- Book hotel stays with World of Hyatt points, cash or both

- Save your favorite hotels and resorts for future travel 
- Add your hotel reservations and World of Hyatt membership card to Apple Wallet 
- Bypass the front desk with mobile check-in, digital key, and express checkout 
- See your room charges in real-time 
- View and download folio from previous stays 
MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME 
- Request items to your room, such as extra pillows, towels and toothpaste (where applicable) 
- Order room service (where applicable) 
- Stream your favorite shows on your in-room TV with Google Chromecast (where applicable) 
ACCESS YOUR LOYALTY PROGRAM ACCOUNT 
- Track your progress toward elite status and Milestone Rewards 
- View your current member benefits and explore other elite tier benefits 
- Track your progress towards free nights via our Brand Explorer 
- View and redeem points, and track available for redemption 
- Register for new offers and track your progress towards earning directly in the app 
Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Korean 
About Hyatt Hotels Corporation 
Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of March 31, 2025, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,450 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 79 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the Luxury Portfolio, including Park Hyatt®, Alila®, Miraval®, Impression by Secrets, and The Unbound Collection by Hyatt®; the Lifestyle Portfolio, including Andaz®, Thompson Hotels®, The Standard®, Dream® Hotels, The StandardX, Breathless Resorts & Spas®, JdV by Hyatt®, Bunkhouse® Hotels, and Me and All Hotels; the Inclusive Collection, including Zoëtry® Wellness & Spa Resorts, Hyatt Ziva®, Hyatt Zilara®, Secrets® Resorts & Spas, Dreams® Resorts & Spas, Hyatt Vivid Hotels & Resorts, Sunscape® Resorts & Spas, Alua Hotels & Resorts®, and Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts; the Classics Portfolio, including Grand Hyatt®, Hyatt Regency®, Destination by Hyatt®, Hyatt Centric®, Hyatt Vacation Club®, and Hyatt®; and the Essentials Portfolio, including Caption by Hyatt®, Hyatt Place®, Hyatt House®, Hyatt Studios, Hyatt Select, and UrCove. Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit www.hyatt.com.

bluejetty:00152118:ios.summary:
RapidClear—Your All-in-One iOS Cleanup & Privacy Companion!
RapidClear is a powerful iOS utility app designed to declutter your device, optimize storage, and safeguard your privacy with precision. Combining intelligent cleanup tools for pho
bluejetty:00152118:ios.description:
RapidClear—Your All-in-One iOS Cleanup & Privacy Companion!
RapidClear is a powerful iOS utility app designed to declutter your device, optimize storage, and safeguard your privacy with precision. Combining intelligent cleanup tools for photos, videos, contacts, and calendars with a secure private vault, RapidClear helps users reclaim storage space, streamline digital life, and protect sensitive data—all through an intuitive, user-friendly interface. 
KEY FEATURES
» Photo & Video Cleanup
RapidClear tackles digital clutter head-on. Its advanced algorithms detect and remove duplicate photos, similar shots, and unnecessary screenshots to free up space instantly. For videos, the app identifies near-identical clips, large files hogging storage, and outdated screen recordings, ensuring your gallery stays organized and your device runs smoothly.
» Smart Contacts Manager
Tired of messy contact lists? RapidClear merges duplicate entries automatically and flags incomplete profiles (e.g., missing numbers or emails) for quick deletion. Keep your address book tidy and avoid confusion during calls or messages.
» Calendar Cleanup
Never miss an important event again. RapidClear scans your calendar to detect and remove expired events or outdated reminders, leaving only relevant schedules in a clean, easy-to-navigate interface.
» Private Vault for Ultimate Security
Safeguard sensitive password with RapidClear’s encrypted Private Vault. 
►WHY CHOOSE?
RapidClear isn’t just a cleaner—it’s a holistic solution for iOS users who value efficiency and privacy. Whether you’re battling low storage, managing contacts, or protecting intimate moments,RapidClear empowers you to take control of your digital life effortlessly.
Download RapidClear today and transform your iPhone into a faster, cleaner, and more private space!
►USEFUL TIPS
The system puts all your deleted photos in the “Recently Deleted” folder of your default Photos app. To delete them finally and free your disk space or restore your photos, please, follow these steps:
– Open default Photos app.
– Go to Albums / Recently Deleted.
– Press Select and Delete All (or Restore All).
►UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
– You can subscribe for unlimited access to all the phone cleaner features.
– Subscriptions are available in 1-week and 12-month terms.
– Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
By using RapidClear you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy：http://www.xsparkext.com/website-cfg/policy
Terms of Use：http://www.xsparkext.com/website-cfg/service

bluejetty:00009033:android.description:
Wander the dreamworld full of deadly puzzles, search Hidden Object scenes and defeat Sandman in this point-and-click adventure game.
TRY IT FREE AND THEN BUY THE GAME IF YOU LIKE IT
You were born with the ability to walk other people's dreams. But the blessing turns into a curse, if Sandman, the lord of nightmares, haunts someone dear to you. Years after saving your friend Laura from his evil grasp, you find yourself thrown into another thrilling adventure. Sandman decided to take vengeance, and now Laura’s husband Tim falls into a nightmare. Help him finally wake up in this fascinating Hidden Object game.
GAME FEATURESS
- Quirky dreamworld with changes during walkthrough
- 40+ gaming locations in HD
- More than 30 3D videos and cut-scenes
- 12 logic puzzles and arcade mini-games
- Fascinating Hidden Object scenes
- Collectibles and achievements for experienced players
Be it a dream or a nightmare, this point-and-click adventure is a true eye-candy. With high-quality background artworks and breathtaking 3D videos, it rises above other finding games. It can’t be actually ascribed to seek-and-find games, as it has almost no Hidden Object scenes in their common form. Instead, Mystery Night Adventure sends you on a logic quest to collect clues and solve puzzles through a beautifully crafted world of the dreaming. Be ready to face many challenges and meet weird creatures that dwell in Sandman’s realm. And the devoted fans of finding games can task themselves with spotting all beholders lurking within.
As for the mini-games included, there are both brainteasers and skill games to complement your playing experience. Find your way through the maze or jump on the moving platforms to cross an abyss. Twist your mind with rolling balls and chess puzzles. Decipher hidden messages within cave paintings, entwine the entanglement of threads and prove a brainiac with yet more logic mini-games to pass. Your efforts will be rewarded with achievements for both finding Hidden Objects and puzzle solving. So, prepare to fight your worst fears to wake up your beloved before he falls into darkness once for all. Play this breathtaking Hidden Object adventure game now!
Questions? Contact our tech support at support@absolutist.com

bluejetty:00159922:ios.description:
STOP YOUR SNORING AND CONTROL YOUR PROGRESS! Don't let snoring and sleep talking ruin your rest.
〉 CREATE SLEEP SOUNDSCAPES WITH AI
Request and enjoy soundscapes generated by artificial intelligence to relax and fall asleep easily. You can also create your own custom soundscapes based on personal preferences.
〉 DETECT SNORING, SPEECH, AND SCREAMS WITH AI
Automatically detect and record snoring, talking, and shouting sounds while you sleep using AI.
〉 AI SLEEP APNEA DETECTION
Review AI-recognized potential sleep apnea episodes with detailed interval-based reports, including event counts and estimated probability levels for each time period.
〉 MONITOR YOUR HEALTH
Wake up feeling refreshed with personalized alarms and by tracking your sleep cycles.
〉 TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Receive detailed analytics on your sleep quality and see how it improves over time.
〉 MANAGE YOUR SLEEP QUALITY
Keep a sleep diary and review your cycles to better understand your rest patterns.
〉 RECORD AND LISTEN TO SNORING
Easily record, review, and listen to episodes of snoring, talking, or screaming during sleep.
〉 IMPROVE SLEEP FOR YOUR LOVED ONES
Automatically mask snoring sounds with soothing melodies tailored to your preferences, so you don’t disturb your partner’s sleep.
- = HOW TO USE = -
1. Launch the app.
2. Place your phone with the app open next to your bed for the duration of sleep.
3. The app will automatically mask snoring when it’s detected.
4. Review your morning sleep log for detailed insights, including when and how much you snored, talked, or screamed during the night.
Sleep better and feel rested in the morning!

This app is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat sleep disorders or any other medical condition. Consult your physician before making any decisions or taking any action that may affect your well-being, health, or safety.

bluejetty:00121099:ios.description:
Countdown Star is the best way to countdown to — and count up from — all of your favorite events.
Countdown to birthdays, holidays, an upcoming vacation, a wedding, the New Year, parties, sporting events, concerts and more.
Count up from anniversaries, the day you were born, and other special events in the past.
* How many seconds until your next birthday?
* How many months since you were born?
* How many days until you graduate from college?
* How many hours until your anniversary?
* How much time is left until your vacation starts?
* How many days until Christmas?
* How many minutes until your party begins?
* How much time is left until your baby's due date?
Countdown Star is the countdown app that lets you choose which events to add, then keeps them in sync across all of your devices.
Features:
* iCloud Sync — events and wallpapers sync automatically across all your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch devices
* Celebration Animations — choose Confetti, Fireworks, Balloons, Stars, or Lasers when your countdown reaches zero
* Repeating Events — annual events automatically advance to the next year so you never have to update them
* Home Screen Widgets — Small, Medium, and Large widgets let you glance at your countdowns without opening the app
* Apple Watch — view your events right on your wrist
* Add Your Own Events — add as many events as you like

bluejetty:00131494:ios.name: Bruno - My Squishy Slime Pet
bluejetty:00131494:ios.summary:
Do you love playing with slime and taking care of cute virtual pets? Now you can enjoy both loves in a single game! Meet Bruno the Super Slime Pet, your new cute, adorable friend!
From Dramaton, the creators of the famous DIY, ASMR 3D col
bluejetty:00131494:ios.description:
Do you love playing with slime and taking care of cute virtual pets? Now you can enjoy both loves in a single game! Meet Bruno the Super Slime Pet, your new cute, adorable friend!
From Dramaton, the creators of the famous DIY, ASMR 3D coloring games Super Slime Simulator™, Squishy Magic™, and Go! Dolliz™, comes Bruno - My Super Slime Pet, a first of its kind virtual pet simulation game which combines the fun, relaxing creativity of Super Slime Simulator™ with the joy of virtual pet games. If you like slime DIY and ASMR, making 3D virtual toys, playing simulation games and taking care of virtual pets, you are going to love this new slime pet simulation game! 
Your Super Slime Pet needs lots of love and attention to help it grow up and shine! Take care of your slimy pet friend, play with it, and love it to make it the happiest, most beautiful slime pet in the world! make sure your cute pet is always happy and smiling, but never hungry, sleepy, dirty or bored.
Bruno loves to eat! Feed your hungry slime buddy with tons of delicious snacks and yummies you can buy in the app’s food store: cakes, candy, fruits, pizza, burgers, ice-cream and many more! Discover what your pet likes to eat by its funny reactions! 
Give your pet a slimy bubble bath to keep it shiny and clean!
Enjoy your pet’s funny cute reactions when you pet it, cuddle it, poke it and squish it! So satisfying! 
Put your pet to sleep when it is tired and wake it up in the morning for a new fun day of slime adventures!
Customize your slime friend and give it new cool and cute looks by choosing new slime types for it, coloring it with different slime colors and decorating it with cool, funny slime decorations - just like in a slime DIY game! Each slime boasts a unique texture, sound and behavior, producing a unique ASMR satisfying sensation.
Relieve your stress and discover the relaxing, satisfying ASMR experience of playing with your slime pet: stretch your pet, squish it, knead it, pop it and enjoy your pet’s funny adorable reactions and voices.
Grow your pet! By playing with your pet and taking care of it, your new buddy will advance in levels to unlock new items, food and slime add-ins.
The more you play with your slime pet, cuddle it, pamper it and take care for it, the more coins you earn to unlock new features and items that you can use to treat your pet and give it funny, adorable new looks: new slime types, colors, awesome decorations, and tasty food to feed your pet with. 
Download Bruno - My Super Slime Pet now and discover a world of fun and creative adventures with your virtual pet friend.

Real Guitar is one of the most realistic guitar simulator apps featuring a user-friendly interface and an awesome sound quality. All sounds have been recorded from live guitar. With the help of Real Guitar you can easily strum, pluck, and strike the strings to play the chords of any complexity and figure out your favourite tunes or make up your own. You can learn and master new chords and jingles with Real Guitar, as well.

◉ 12 String Guitar

◉ Left Handed Guitar
◉ Right Handed Guitar
◉ Various Strumming Patterns (pick, fingers)
◉ Solo Note animation (see which notes you play on the go)
◉ Guitar Chords Mode (great way to practice strumming)
◉ Solo Mode
Guitar Chords and Tabs
◉ Guitar Chords Charts Library with Chords Finder
◉ Songbook to help you learn to play guitar songs
Audio 
◉ Amazingly realistic guitar sounds
Whether you only want to learn how to play guitar chords or are a seasoned shredder you will love Real Guitar. It’s very much like the real thing in so many ways...oh, and did we mention there’s no need to change guitar strings?

bluejetty:00027069:ios.description:
Control Sonos from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Apple Watch. No app to open, no unlock required — just tap and play.
Lyd gives you instant widgets and Dynamic Island controls on iPhone, plus the gold-standard Watch remote trusted since 2019.

SCENES — YOUR WHOLE SETUP IN ONE TAP
Save the perfect moment once, recreate it forever. A Scene remembers which speakers play together, how loud each one is, and what music starts — then makes it all happen the instant you tap.
• "Morning Kitchen", "Dinner Party", "Movie Night" — a Scene for every moment
• One tap groups your speakers, sets the volume, and starts your music

• Works on iPhone and Apple Watch, synced across both
• Launch any Scene with Siri, Shortcuts, and automations
INSTANT WIDGET CONTROL
• Home Screen widgets in multiple sizes
• Lock Screen widgets for one-tap access
• Live Activities in Dynamic Island
• Control playback without unlocking your phone
GOLD-STANDARD APPLE WATCH REMOTE
• Full playback control on your wrist
• Rotate the Digital Crown to change volume
• Add complications to any watch face
• Control everything without touching your iPhone
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Works with Sonos S2 and S1 systems
• Volume adjustments with iPhone volume keys
• Group and ungroup speakers
• Play any playlist or radio station
• Send voice messages to any speaker
• Sleep timers for automatic shutoff
• Shortcuts and automation support
• Guest mode for parties
• Multiple Sonos households
ONE-TIME PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.

Welcome to the Enchanted World of "Butterfly Mystic Match"!
Embark on an extraordinary adventure in this captivating, free-to-play mobile game that brings the magic of butterflies to life! Immerse yourself in the wondrous realm of fluttering wings, vibrant colors, and soothing melodies.
Raise, Collect, and Cherish Your Winged Companions
In the heart of a moonlit, mystical forest, you'll encounter moths that rival the splendor of butterflies. Witness their incredible lifecycle, from the charming caterpillar stage to the breathtaking majesty of full-grown butterflies. As you guide them through this enchanting woodland, witness their adorable quirks and playful antics that will warm your heart.
Create Your Own Lush Butterfly Haven
Watch as your sanctuary flourishes and transforms into a haven of natural wonders. Expand and adorn the forest with an exquisite array of plants, each possessing its own magical abilities. Feel the energy of the forest surge with vitality as your additions enhance the ethereal charm of this sanctuary.
Unearth Secrets and Meet Enchanting Forest Inhabitants
Every corner of the forest holds mysteries waiting to be discovered. Encounter fascinating forest dwellers, each with their own intriguing tales and puzzles to unravel. These encounters add depth and enchantment to your journey, ensuring that every step is filled with wonder.
An Educational Odyssey of Discovery
With over 300 real-life moth species to collect, "Butterfly Mystic Match" not only offers a captivating gameplay experience but also an educational one. Delve into the fascinating world of these unique creatures, expanding your knowledge and deepening your appreciation for the natural world.
A Tranquil Oasis Under the Moonlight
Escape into the calming embrace of the forest, where stars twinkle and the moon dances through its lunar cycle. Witness the breathtaking beauty of flowers unfurling, their petals illuminated by the soft glow of fireflies. It's a sanctuary of peace and harmony, inviting you to unwind and let the stresses of the day melt away.
Features That Enchant and Delight
Immersive Gameplay: Engage with intuitive mechanics that connect you with nature, offering a relaxing and enjoyable experience.

GETTR
A Marketplace of Ideas
GETTR, USA, Inc
______________________________________________________________________________
Break away from Big Tech and join an inspiring, uplifting, positive social media platform for all! GETTR wants to bring enjoyment back to your social media experience by supporting freedom of independent thought and rejecting political censorship.
Offering the best in class technology, GETTR offers the voice of freedom to its users, allowing for unfiltered discourse and sharing of information, news, and thoughts with your friends, family, and those around the world!
_______________________________________________________________________________
With GETTR, you have:
The Freedom to Share Independent Thoughts - Share messages, news, photos, videos and more. Stay connected with friends, family and network with people around the world. Join new communities that represent your interests.
The Ability to Speak Your Mind With MORE - post messages up to 777 characters, you have more space to share your thoughts, images, and news. 
Up Your Photo Game - Post higher quality photos and longer videos… up to three minutes long! And with our in-app editor, you can add your personal touch without ever leaving the app.
GTok: Recently released into beta testing, GTok is the newest addition to the platform. Create your own short entertaining vertical videos with our in-app video creator with access to unique filters and up to 100,000 songs to choose from!
Expanding Image Posts: You can now post up to 6 photos per post!
Editing Images: In-app capabilities to edit and add filters to images
Live-Streaming With the Community - Live-streaming is up to 60 minutes long with easy-to-use technology for any GETTR user.
Direct Messages With the Community: Send end-to-end encrypted direct messages to your friends on GETTR!
Get the News: Uncensored - Get the news from all sides and perspectives! As the marketplace of Ideas, GETTR allows YOU to decide how you get and share information. No platform censorship here!
Discover New Favorites - See who and what is trending with top accounts and recommendations just for you.
Experience Superior Technology - Easy to use with exciting features, to provide you with the best possible user experience. Our in-house tech team makes sure GETTR's always at its best. 
Expect New and Exciting Features - With every update come fun and improved features to enhance how and what you share. Keep an eye out for exciting additions to GTok, currently in beta testing, are coming soon!
Know Your Data's Safe with Us – We observe your data privacy preferences. Please see out Privacy Policy here https://gettr.com/privacy.
And Most Importantly…
ESCAPE CANCEL CULTURE - GETTR will never suspend, deplatform, or censor you for your views. Protecting your ability to speak freely and have your voice heard is our top priority!
Privacy Policy: https://gettr.com/privacy-app
Terms of Use: https://gettr.com/terms-app

bluejetty:00079704:ios.name: Slate AI: Video Teleprompter
bluejetty:00079704:ios.summary:
Slate AI is a video teleprompter for iPhone. It writes your script with AI, scrolls it while you record, and can float on top of any other camera app — so you always look straight into the lens and never memorize a word.
WHAT SLATE AI DOES
bluejetty:00079704:ios.description:
Slate AI is a video teleprompter for iPhone. It writes your script with AI, scrolls it while you record, and can float on top of any other camera app — so you always look straight into the lens and never memorize a word.
WHAT SLATE AI DOES 
Slate AI covers the whole process of making a talking-head video on your phone: write the script, set it up for comfortable reading, and record it.
— AI script writing — describe your topic in a sentence and get a ready-to-read script. No blank page, no draft in another app.
— Built-in recording — the script scrolls over the live camera view. Front or back camera, portrait or landscape.
— Floating Mode — keep the teleprompter in a floating window on top of Instagram, TikTok, CapCut, Zoom or the native Camera app, and record wherever you normally record.
— Auto-pause on silence — the text stops when you stop talking and resumes when you speak again. No more racing the scroll or restarting a take.
— Manual scroll while recording — swipe to slow down, speed up, or jump back a line mid-take.
— Full reading control — scrolling speed, font size, line width, and a dyslexia-friendly font.
— Paste or import — bring in a script you already wrote by pasting it or importing a file.
— Watermark-free export with PRO.
WHO USES IT 
Creators recording Reels, Shorts and TikToks. Coaches and course authors. Realtors filming listings. Small business owners recording ads and product videos. Teachers and students recording lessons and presentations. Anyone who films interviews, tutorials, vlogs, podcasts or webinars and doesn't want to memorize lines.
HOW IT WORKS
— Create a project and get your script — write it with AI, paste it, or import a file.
— Set the speed, font size and line width so the text reads comfortably at arm's length.
— Record inside Slate AI, or turn on Floating Mode and record in the app you prefer.
— Review the take, re-record it if you want, then save the video to your Photos library or share it straight away.
WHY PEOPLE SWITCH TO SLATE AI
— It's built for iPhone only, so recording is stable and the audio stays in sync with the video.
— The interface is simple enough to shoot your first video minutes after installing — no manual, no setup screens you don't understand.
— Auto-pause on silence and manual scroll mean you control the text with your voice and your thumb, not a stopwatch.
— Floating Mode lets you keep your existing workflow instead of replacing your camera app.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION 
PRO unlocks AI script generation, Floating Mode and watermark-free video. Choose a monthly plan, a yearly plan with a 3-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
–––– 
Privacy Policy: https://slateteleprompter.com/privacy 
Terms of Use: https://slateteleprompter.com/terms 
–––– 
All trademarks, trade names, or logos mentioned or used are the property of their respective owners.

bluejetty:00061201:ios.summary: Epic is the world’s largest digital library for kids! Our fun, kid-safe, interactive reading app fuels curiosity and reading confidence by letting kids freely explore their interests with instant access to 40,000+ books, audiobooks, learnin
bluejetty:00061201:ios.description:
Epic is the world’s largest digital library for kids! Our fun, kid-safe, interactive reading app fuels curiosity and reading confidence by letting kids freely explore their interests with instant access to 40,000+ books, audiobooks, learning videos and more.
Anytime, anywhere: Access our library from any Apple device. You can even download books to read offline! 
Books that read to them: In addition to our library of more traditional ebooks, we have a huge collection of Read-To-Me books and audiobooks. Featuring talented voice actors, fun music and exciting sound effects that bring stories to life!
Multilingual: The majority of books on Epic are in English, but we also have books in Spanish, French, Chinese and Gaelic to engage readers of different backgrounds and interests.
Fun rewards and learning tools: Reading Buddies, badges and quizzes keep them motivated to read and learn. Spotlight Words and audio-enabled Dictionary Lookup teach vocabulary and pronunciation. 
FOR FAMILIES: EPIC FAMILY 
A paid subscription beginning with a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime. 
• Up to 4 child profiles, so each kid can enjoy a personalized reading experience.
• Parent dashboard lets you see what they’re reading and follow along with their progress. 
• 95% of Epic parents say Epic helped improve their child’s reading skills.
FOR EDUCATORS: EPIC SCHOOL 
Epic School is free for educators and students to use during the school day. 
• ELA Tools: Filter titles by AR, DRA, F&P, grade level and more. 
• Quizzes, Dictionary Lookup and Spotlight Words help build skills.
• Help with Daily 20: Teachers can easily assign and share books, then track daily and weekly reading. 
• Multilingual books and fun reading formats make reading accessible for every student. 
• 9 out of 10 Epic Educators would recommend us to colleagues. 
• Also available: Epic School Plus, a district-funded premium offering that gives educators and students 24/7 access to the full Epic library. 
PRESS AND EXPERT REVIEWS
Epic has been featured on The TODAY Show, CNET and Refinery 29, as well as in The Wall Street Journal, Parents Magazine, USA Today, Forbes, Parenting.com and more.
“Epic strikes the perfect balance between educational and fun, and should allow parents to feel more confident about introducing the iPad into their children’s daily lives as a tool.” –TechCrunch
"Get access to thousands of books on all subject matters" –Parenting.com
"Epic is incredibly valuable because it gives students exposure to books that they wouldn't get from a library or our classroom." –Cindy, Epic Educator Ambassador
Privacy Policy
getepic.com/privacy
Terms of Service
getepic.com/tos

bluejetty:00039382:ios.description:
Order taxis in Poland effortlessly, using the iTaxi app!
How does it work? 
1. Download the app 
2. Sign up (as a private or business user, or with a company voucher code)
3. Select payment type (add a credit card or choose Apple Pay, GPay, PayPal or BLIK) 
4. Order a taxi and... ride!
What's so special about iTaxi?
a) PRICE CONTROL
We have two price options: Choose the fixed fee using iTaxi Ticket to see the total cost of the ride before ordering a cab, or alternatively use the taximeter like a traditional taxi, allowing you to control the route your driver takes. And you can always reach us with any problems. 
b) VERIFIED DRIVERS
For your peace of mind, all our drivers are verified for identity, have passed our internal exam, and are fully insured.
c) MOBILE PAYMENT
Don't worry about carrying cash or cards, just choose mobile payments and the taxi bill will be charged directly to your chosen payment type.
d) ADVANCE BOOKINGS
You can order a future ride by simply choosing your desired date and time, and rest assured your taxi will arrive on time!
e) SPECIAL CAB
Do you need a specific type of vehicle? You can choose the number of seats you require, plus safety partition, large trunk, or pet transport. These are available with just one click. 
f) PREMIUM
Going somewhere fancy? Choose this option if you'd like to ride in style in a luxury car.
g) SHHHHH..!
Do you prefer to travel in silence? Just choose the option Quiet Ride in your profile!
h) SUPPORT A CHARITY
You can support a Foundation by selecting one of our chosen charities and we will donate automatically after each ride when you pay by card.
iTaxi is a company based in Poland with nine years on the market. iTaxi offers applications for private cab rides. Passengers can find a variety of features making taking a cab easy, safe, and may we say, even pleasurable!
Do you own a company? Cashless rides with iTaxi is a terrific solution for your company! Our system is a simple way to manage the costs of rides for your employees and clients, account management, and reports on request. With iTaxi you cut costs, and everything is crystal clear!
... 
If you need more information or our help, just contact us:

bok@itaxi.pl

2. Sign up (as a private or business user, or with a company voucher code)
3. Select payment type (add a credit card or choose Apple Pay, GPay, PayPal or BLIK) 
4. Order a taxi and... ride!

What's so special about iTaxi?

a) PRICE CONTROL

b) VERIFIED DRIVERS
For your peace of mind, all our drivers are verified for identity, have passed our internal exam, and are fully insured.

c) MOBILE PAYMENT
Don't worry about carrying cash or cards, just choose mobile payments and the taxi bill will be charged directly to your chosen payment type.

d) ADVANCE BOOKINGS
You can order a future ride by simply choosing your desired date and time, and rest assured your taxi will arrive on time!

e) SPECIAL CAB
Do you need a specific type of vehicle? You can choose the number of seats you require, plus safety partition, large trunk, or pet transport. These are available with just one click. 

f) PREMIUM
Going somewhere fancy? Choose this option if you'd like to ride in style in a luxury car.

g) SHHHHH..!
Do you prefer to travel in silence? Just choose the option Quiet Ride in your profile!

h) SUPPORT A CHARITY
You can support a Foundation by selecting one of our chosen charities and we will donate automatically after each ride when you pay by card.

iTaxi is a company based in Poland with nine years on the market. iTaxi offers applications for private cab rides. Passengers can find a variety of features making taking a cab easy, safe, and may we say, even pleasurable!

TestMaker is a quiz maker and flashcard app that helps you study for school tests, college entrance exams, professional certifications, and languages.
WHO IT'S FOR

- Busy learners who study during commutes and spare moments
- Classmates and study groups who want to share question sets
- Anyone who prefers a simple, distraction-free study app
CREATE YOUR OWN QUIZZES
Build question sets that match exactly what you need to learn:
- Flashcard-style questions where you type the answer
- Multiple-choice questions, including select-all-that-apply
- Fill-in-the-blank questions
- Questions with images and explanations
Powerful tools make creating questions fast:
- Create questions on your computer with the web version: https://ankimaker.com/
- Import and export CSV files
- AI question generation: scan your textbook or notes and turn them into practice questions automatically

- Retry mode that focuses on the questions you got wrong
- Shuffled questions and answer choices
- Self-grading mode without keyboard input
- Swap terms and definitions
- Read-aloud (text-to-speech) for questions
- Timed answering
SYNC AND SHARE
Your question sets are saved in the cloud:
- Sync across multiple devices
- Move to a new phone without losing your data
- Share question sets with friends and classmates

bluejetty:00131384:ios.description:
Curious about your family history? Add branches to your family tree with FamilySearch Tree, the world’s largest online family tree. FamilySearch Tree makes it easy and convenient to discover and document your own branches of the world’s family tree while preserving family memories, such as photos, written stories, and audio recordings.
Harness the power of a worldwide, crowd-sourced pedigree to discover your family story. As you add information, FamilySearch will start searching for your family members while looking at historical records like birth and death certificates. Share information that others might not know, and add sources to confirm correct information. Update information and records easily so that everyone has accurate information.
Browse your family tree branches, and see portraits of relatives you’ve never seen before. Discover facts, documents, stories, photos, and recordings about your ancestors. Easily add new life details, photos, stories, and audio recordings for your relatives.
Find and share meaningful, heart-turning family stories that will make an impact on your life and the lives of your loved ones.
Genealogy at Your Fingertips
Family history has never been easier to track and build.
Build your family tree by finding or adding family members directly through the app.
Once you add a deceased relative to the family tree, FamilySearch will try to connect you to any information it has about that person in its database.
Discover new family members and descendants in the community tree.
Explore your heritage in maps that show where the key events of your ancestors’ lives took place.
Ancestors, Relatives, and Family
Find your ancestors in the billions of records on FamilySearch.org to learn more details of your family story.
Discover facts, documents, stories, photos, and recordings about your ancestors.
Easily add new life details, photos, stories, and audio recordings for your relatives.
See which ancestors FamilySearch has already found in historical records, and get ideas for what to do next.
Discovering your own family history potentially helps others in their search.
Explore your heritage in maps that show where the key events of your ancestors’ lives took place.
Collaborate with Others
Connect with other family members, and share information that others might not know.
View, add, and edit information about your ancestors. 
Enhance your tree by adding photos, stories, and documents.
Add sources to confirm correct information.
Communicate and collaborate with other FamilySearch users from within the app with in-app messaging.
Connect with family near and far. You may find a relative who has visited the same graves, asked the same questions about—and even learned to love or admire—the same ancestors. 
Watch your family tree grow. Discover family, learn your family history, and help map the family tree for mankind with FamilySearch Tree. 
NOTE: Content you provide for deceased individuals will be publicly available. See our privacy policy for more details.

Coach.me will completely change your life! Read our reviews! 
Start with our world-class goal and habit tracking. Our free tracking tools will change your life. If you get stuck in your goals, get motivated by our community or hire one of our world-class coaches.

Every aspect of our experience has been designed based on the latest research on psychology and behavior design. We are huge fans of Carol Dweck, Daniel Kahneman and BJ Fogg. If you join our community you will develop a growth mindset, learn the power of positive reinforcement, experience the motivational force of external accountability, and harness your improvement efforts in an efficient way according to the tenants of deliberate practice. 
Here are a handful of success stories from our community:

“Without being able to press that 'Send Message' button to my coach every day, I am certain I would not have come as far with my writing. With that momentum I managed to write 500 words nearly every day, started a blog, and am still going. It's been only 3 months, and I feel like a new person.” ~ Alina
“I got a promotion literally two weeks after hiring my business coach. Now I have a much bigger say over product and strategy. I feel like a leader and people treat me accordingly!” ~ Graham
“Dorothy has been so inspirational to me and gives me the reasoning and a solution to any problem I have had on the diet. With her coaching I lost 20 pounds and now have the habits in place to lose the next 20 on my own. I might keep her around however, just for the support and occasional kick in the butt.” ~ Estela
“I get more done before my family wakes up than I used to in an entire day. After countless attempts to do this on my own, hiring George as a coach was the lever I needed to shift my productivity fast forward. I've been successful because George helped me create a morning routine that works specifically for me.” ~ Jim

bluejetty:00100761:ios.name: Novel Effect: Read Aloud Books
bluejetty:00100761:ios.summary: Welcome to Novel Effect — an award-winning app that follows your voice as you read out loud from a children’s story book and responds at just the right moment with interactive music, sound effects, and character voices. Bring the story to l
bluejetty:00100761:ios.description:
Welcome to Novel Effect — an award-winning app that follows your voice as you read out loud from a children’s story book and responds at just the right moment with interactive music, sound effects, and character voices. Bring the story to life, promote literacy, imagination, and fun for kids 12 & under!
In the classroom or at home, see why parents and teachers alike say Novel Effect “…turns reading time into a magical experience." - App Store Review.
There are 3 versions of the Novel Effect service accessible through the app. New books are added weekly.
FREE
Free Novel Effect offers hundreds of soundscapes for a library of children’s books curated for teachers, librarians, kids and families. Enjoy limited access to soundscapes for free when you bring your own copy of the print book or ebook!
PREMIUM
For families and individual educators, Novel Effect Premium offers unlimited access to a library of kid friendly content. Enjoy soundscapes for popular children’s books when you bring your own copy of the book, or read aloud from hundreds of in-app eBooks, including non-fiction and early reader chapter books, as well as exclusive members-only content. 
CLASSROOM
For educators, Novel Effect Premium Classroom offers unlimited access to Premium features and content for one teacher and up to 30 students in a safe and secure environment. Overwhelmingly, educators say reading with Novel Effect is more engaging, creating motivated, confident, and empowered readers. 
HOW IT WORKS
Novel Effect’s service follows along as you read out loud, playing interactive music, sound effects, and character voices in response to your voice. Our library includes a wide variety of high-quality soundscapes for carefully selected family friendly books to engage and promote imagination and learning, updated weekly with new titles! Hundreds of titles are available as in-app eBooks, some titles may require you to read aloud from your own copy.
FIND - Use search or browse our collections to find the book you want to read out loud.
PLAY - Tap the cover and then choose how you’ll be reading — with print or an eBook.
READ - When you hear the chime, start reading aloud!
LISTEN - Hear the music and sounds respond to your voice and change with the story.
Add a little magic to story time with Novel Effect.
PRESS AND EXPERT REVIEWS
Novel Effect was featured on Shark Tank, The TODAY Show, and in Forbes, Variety, Lifehacker, and more.
“I felt like a real audiobook narrator. My five-year-old tried reading a book on her own… and amazingly, the system picked up her little voice and played the effects at all the right moments.” - Michelle Woo, Lifehacker
"Not only did this tool help make poetry come alive for [my student], he asked me if he could try reading... I about fell out of my chair because he never wants to read aloud... and he has asked to go to the library to check out books that he can read along with the app." - Julie Smith, The Techie Teacher®
"I think this is cool as cool can be… I love it, I love it!" - Lori Greiner, entrepreneur and investor on ABC’s Shark Tank
SAFETY, PRIVACY, AND SUPPORT
- Novel Effect requires access to the device's microphone to perform voice-recognition.
- The privacy of kids and their grown-ups is our top priority. Voice-recognition is performed on your device, no voice data is saved without express consent.
- Please go to http://www.noveleffect.com/privacy-policy or www.noveleffect.com/classroom-privacy-policy to learn more.
KEY FEATURES
• Hundreds of books with more added weekly
• Also includes Spanish books
• Online and offline reading
• A reading log tracks books you’ve read with the app
• Access Novel Effect’s digital library and soundscapes on almost any device
Terms of Service
https://www.noveleffect.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00168418:ios.description:
Join over 50 million people who rely on Any.do to organize their life, work and get more done. "IT'S A MUST HAVE APP" (NYTimes, WSJ, USA Today & Lifehacker). It's the perfect combo of a task list, calendar, planner & reminders all-in-one app.
THE #1 TO DO LIST & TASK LIST
SYNCS SEAMLESSLY between your mobile, desktop, web, and tablet. Keeps all your to do list, tasks, reminders, calendar & agenda always in sync so you’ll never forget a thing
GET REMINDERS for a scheduled time, when you reach a particular location or set recurring reminders so you never miss a thing
WORK TOGETHER with shared lists and assigned tasks to collaborate and get more done, with anyone. 
Widget with simple and powerful features to keep your to do list and calendar events always at hand
SIMPLE & POWERFUL CALENDAR OUTLOOK
EASILY VIEW your events and to-do list & Tasks for the day, week & month
SYNC SEAMLESSLY in real-time with your phone’s calendar, google calendar, Facebook events, outlook calendar, or any other calendar so you don’t forget an important event
ALL-IN-ONE APP FOR GETTING THINGS DONE
To easily create reminders we added voice entry so you can just speak your mind and we’ll add it to your to do list. For better task management flow we added a calendar integration to keep your agenda always up to date. To enhance your productivity we added cross-platform support for recurring reminders, location reminders, sub-tasks, notes & file attachments. To keep your to-do list always up to date, we’ve added a one-of-a-kind daily planner.
TO DO LIST, CALENDAR & REMINDERS MADE SIMPLE
Any.do was designed to keep you on top of your to do list and calendar with no hassle. Thanks to the intuitive drag and drop of tasks, swiping to mark to-do's as complete, and shaking your device to remove completed from your to do list - you can keep yourself organized and enjoy every minute of it.
POWERFUL TASK LIST MANAGEMENT
Looking for more? Add a to do list item straight from your email inbox by forwarding do@any.do. Attach files from your computer, Dropbox, or Google Drive to your tasks. 
LIFE ORGANIZER & DAILY PLANNER
Any.do is a to do list, a calendar, an inbox, a notepad, a checklist, task list, a board for post its or sticky notes, a project management tool, a reminders app, a daily planner, a family organizer, and overall the simplest and most useful productivity tool you will ever have. 
SHARE LISTS & ASSIGN TASKS
To plan & organize projects has never been easier. Now you can share lists between family members, assign tasks to each other, chat and much more. Any.do will help you and the people around you stay in-sync and get reminders so that you can focus on what really matters, knowing you had a productive day and crossed off your to do list
GROCERY LIST & SHOPPING LIST
Any.do task list is also great for shopping at the grocery store. Right there on your to do list is a handy shopping list option that you can share with others. Forgot to buy post-it notes? Want reminders? Simply create a list on Any.do, share it with your loved ones and see them adding their shopping items in real-time. You won’t believe how you’ve done shopping or grocery lists before

bluejetty:00123627:ios.description:
The strength training & wellbeing app for women with structured programs to achieve results that will last - TRY OUR 7 DAY FREE TRIAL.
Designed for women who want structure to their training, nutrition support to achieve results that will last - we’ll take the guesswork out of your training and help you build confidence both in and outside the gym.
We believe that every woman should feel confident lifting weights. With the EvolveYou app we’ll help you:
- Choose a program based on your goals, experience and preferences (both at the gym or at home)
- Know exactly which workout to do each day
- Save time and create a schedule that works for you with our Weekly planner
- Learn from the best coaches with our form tips and coaching cues
- Track your progress using our in-app weight tracker to see your strength soar
- Earn exclusive rewards and badges to celebrate your wins
Choose from a range of styles and programs that match your goals, schedule, and preferences:
- STRENGTH; Build lean muscle and significant strength gains from hypertrophy, training using free weights and machines.
- PILATES; Get strong and balanced with a unique combination of pilates and strength training to become your strongest, most aligned self.
- YOGA; Breathe, stretch, and restore with flows that ground and energise
- FUNCTIONAL; High-intensity conditioning and functional cardio to improve strength, power and overall athleticism.
- HYBRID; Metabolic training to challenge your limits
- ON-DEMAND; follow-along with our trainers to get the most from your workouts
- PRE & POST NATAL; to support you throughout your pregnancy and beyond
We know a healthy lifestyle is necessary to keep progressing. This is why in the EvolveYou you will find:
- 1000s of nutritious recipes for every preference
- Macronutrient tracking and guided meal planning
- Shopping list generator and Apple Health sync
- Access expert tips, tutorials, and mindset tools
- Learn about cycle syncing, recovery, and wellness
- We help you understand your body and unlock your full potential—inside and out.
Join a powerful community of supportive women;
- Workout with our qualified trainers; Krissy Cela, Maddie De-Jesus Walker, Mia Green, Charlotte Lamb, Saman Munir, Krsna Garr, and Emily Mouu
- Connect with others in our in-app forum to share your wins, ask questions, and stay motivated
- Be part of challenges that unite and inspire
Whether you're finding your fitness rhythm or chasing new personal bests, EvolveYou meets you where you are—and helps you become who you want to be. This is more than just fitness. This is your evolution.
Start your FREE 7-DAY TRIAL with us today!

bluejetty:00029891:android.description:
AOF is a 5v5 MOBA competitive game based on a background of the battle between The Deities and Human Beings. There are legends from various mythologies and authentic history that you can act as, joining with your teamates in the ield of Vegrild during the twilight of the gods. Skillfully utilizing your abilities and tactics, strive for victory in this sacred battle.
Full eSports Experience：AOF is entirely eSports-oriented, featuring comprehensive competitive content. Participants, ranging from individuals to teams and clubs, engage in competitions at various levels —— Arena Battle, Cup Math, and Tournament.
Cross-Platform Linking：AOF offers cross-platform gameplay, allowing PC players to challenge opponents on mobile devices.
Global Unification：Unlike other games where players choose a server before playing, AOF features a global interconnected server system.
Full Blockchain eSports：The AOF's event system is entirely based on blockchain, ensuring the fairness and impartiality of the competitions.
High-Quality MOBA Experience：AOF sets a new standard in graphical quality and game stability within the MOBA genre. Keeping pace with the rapid advancements in mobile technology, AOF's project quality continues to evolve, rivaling traditional MOBA games.

bluejetty:00070250:ios.summary:

Bored with the same old dating stories and everyone just looking for a casual connection?
Winked is THE
bluejetty:00070250:ios.description:
Explore love and find your virtual crush in Winked – a dating simulator game!
Want all the relationship adventures without the drama?
Bored with the same old dating stories and everyone just looking for a casual connection?
Winked is THE dating chat game for you!
Choose amongst a diverse set of virtual love interests that include a successful entrepreneur, a charming social media influencer, a talented athlete, a mysterious business owner, a graceful dancer, an intriguing rebel, and many more! This variety of match profile choices guarantees you will find your ideal partner in at least one of the characters.
Your dream love life is at your fingertips – just start exploring!
Create your profile and start flirting!
Yes, in Winked – it’s all about love! And that includes appreciating yourself. Choose how you want your avatar to look and get ready for the perfect romance adventure. The right hairstyle and outfit can leave a lasting impression on your date, so make thoughtful choices!
Engage with characters that match your chemistry!
Meet fascinating virtual characters, exchange texts, and decide if you want the relationship to progress. Not feeling the connection? Choose someone else and start a new connection! In Winked's virtual world, everyone has an interesting story prewritten about them; you just need to find the right character to connect with and experience that perfect virtual love story.
Chat with attractive singles and find that special spark!
Each character has a rich and developed personality and storyline that is discovered through chat messages and dates. Find all the intriguing and surprising details about them called Aspirations: leave a memorable impression on your virtual partner and discover all their Secrets, Dreams, and Favorites, available to view at any time in the match profile Gallery! The more you get to know the characters, the more you will start to feel like they are a part of your life. Get ready to party with your new virtual crush!
Collect all the photos, videos, and audio files that your matches send.
Your matches will send you adorable selfies, thoughtful short videos, and heartfelt audio messages! Collect all of them and browse them from your match's profile! Your favorite photo is always just a tap away – gaze into their captivating eyes at any time!
Go on dates, progress your relationship and engage in fulfilling experiences.
Communication between you and your match may be a prewritten story, but that doesn’t mean you can't influence it in any way! The choices you make matter and have a direct consequence on your relationship status. If you feel a connection, express yourself genuinely and deepen your relationship. You will then be rewarded with an even more satisfying gaming experience, so don't hesitate to show your affection.
And this is only the beginning – we have many exciting features planned as well as new character profiles to be released. So, start playing Winked and get ready for the virtual chatting experience of your life!
Write the chapters of love with every choice and chat!
FOLLOW US:
Instagram: @winked_game
Facebook: facebook.com/winkedgame/

bluejetty:00119578:ios.description:
Shopify: build your online store, sell anywhere, run your business
Dream big and build fast with Shopify, the ultimate commerce platform for entrepreneurs. Start an ecommerce business, grow your brand, and manage every part of your store from your phone. Whether you're making your first sale or scaling your business, Shopify gives you the tools to move faster.
WHAT IS SHOPIFY?
Shopify is the ecommerce platform behind millions of businesses in 175+ countries. This app is your seller center: one mobile suite for your online store, marketplace and social channels, products, inventory, orders, and sales.
POWERED BY COMMERCE AI
Sidekick, your own commerce AI, helps you get more done, spot opportunities, sell more, and make smarter decisions.
BUILD YOUR ONLINE STORE FAST
Create an ecommerce store that's built to sell, no coding required.
- Add and edit products, from clothes to electronics, with photos, pricing, and variants
- Update your store's appearance and organize products into collections
- Manage domains, customer accounts, and the apps that power your business
HOW DO YOU SELL ON SHOPIFY?
Sell wherever your customers shop: online, in person, in AI chats, on social, and across marketplaces.
- Keep products, inventory, customers, and orders in sync across every sales channel
- Sell face to face with Shopify POS or Quicksale
- Reach shoppers where they already shop: AI chats, Shop, social, and marketplaces
- Manage multiple store locations and sell across borders
MARKETING, ADS, AND ANALYTICS
Find customers, bring them back, and understand what's working.
- Create marketing campaigns, promotions, and discounts
- Track sales, traffic, and store performance in real time
- Get instant notifications when new orders arrive
- Manage customer profiles and segments, and message customers directly
RUN YOUR BUSINESS
Shopify is used to run your online store from one business suite, so you're your own store manager, marketing manager, and inventory manager.
- Fulfill, refund, or return orders in a few taps
- Track shipments and deliveries
- Scan barcodes and adjust inventory on the go
- Manage staff, apps, and day-to-day operations
GET PAID
Make checkout easy for customers and keep a clear view of your money.
- Manage payments, payouts, transactions, and cash flow
- Give shoppers a fast, trusted checkout
CUSTOMIZE AND EXTEND
Make Shopify work your way. Connect thousands of ecommerce apps, from dropshipping to marketing, as your business grows.
HOW DO YOU DROPSHIP ON SHOPIFY?
Dropshipping on Shopify means your supplier ships each order for you.
1. Add a dropshipping app and import products
2. Set your prices and publish to your online store
3. Track every dropshipping order and payout here
No inventory to buy up front, so you can dropship clothes, accessories, or home goods.
HOW MUCH DOES SHOPIFY COST?
 3 days FREE then 3 months for just $1/month! Start with a free trial, then pick the monthly plan that fits, from your first sale to high-volume ecommerce. Cancel anytime.
FOR ANYONE FROM ENTREPRENEURS TO ENTERPRISE
Shopify is built for businesses of every size, from solo entrepreneurs launching tomorrow to global brands selling everywhere. Start fast, sell more in more places, and grow as big as you want, all from one platform.
Download Shopify and start selling today.
––– 
* Shopify has the best-converting checkout in the world. Study completed in partnership with a Big Three global management consulting company.

bluejetty:00161350:ios.summary:

• ELECTRIC BIKES - provide added boost with an electric motor to let you ride farther, faster,
bluejetty:00161350:ios.description:
Unlimited Biking Hotels allows you to rent electric bikes when staying at your favorite hotels. Explore the area by bike — with electric boost.
• ELECTRIC BIKES - provide added boost with an electric motor to let you ride farther, faster, and sweat free.
• BUILT IN LOCK - Stop at a store or restaurant and use the e-bike's built-in cable to lock to any bike rack or pole. Your bike will be waiting for your return trip.
• FLEXIBLE RENTALS - Pay by the minute for short trips, or rent all day.
How Unlimited Biking Hotels works:
1. Locate a Hub - Open the app and look for your nearest station location. See how many e-bikes are available at each location in real time.
2. Rent - Scan the QR code on any available e-bike to begin your rental, and it will automatically unlock from the station.
3. Ride - The bike’s electric drive system will make pedaling effortless as you take in the sights and feel the wind in your hair. If you want to make a stop, use the built-in cable lock to secure the bike to a rack or pole. It will remain rented until you’re ready to head back (or to your next destination).
4. Return - To end your rental, ride back to the station where the bike was rented, plug the station’s ChargeLock cable into the bike, and tap 'End Rental' in the app.

bluejetty:00165653:ios.summary:

HOW BIG IS BABY

bluejetty:00165653:ios.description:
The Bump’s free pregnancy app is the most loved baby and pregnancy tracker for expecting and new parents, providing features you won’t find on other baby apps:
** FEATURES **
HOW BIG IS BABY
The Bump is the original home of the cute fruit.
Prepare to smile and look forward to each week: The Bump compares baby’s growth in utero to beautifully illustrated produce (“Baby Is As Big As a Peach”) in a way that’s fun and easy to share with friends and family.
Discover comprehensive updates about the changes and developments happening to both baby and your body while you’re pregnant, and learn how best to plan ahead.
BABY NAMES
From name length and style to country of origin and meaning, you’ll find baby’s name in one of The Bump’s specially curated lists. 
INSIDE THE BUMP
See an exciting and exclusive 3D interactive visualization of baby's week-by-week growth. Interact and learn new facts about baby like never before with the next step in baby growth trackers.
DAILY ADVICE
Every day, the award-winning editorial staff of The Bump delivers fresh and relevant content for your specific week of pregnancy. The articles are timely and comprehensive: always know what’s safe and standard; find out how to ward off morning sickness; learn the best things to pack in your hospital bag; and discover the best prenatal workouts for you.
TOOLS
The Bump’s comprehensive suite of helpful tools makes it the versatile free baby app for you. Stay up to date on you and baby’s progress with invaluable tools like the pregnancy countdown tool, the journal, baby growth tracker, a due date calculator, a kick counter, a pregnancy weight gain tracker, and a contraction counter to determine when it’s time to enact your birth plan. And the Bump’s food safety tool provides nutritional guidance and helpful information throughout your pregnancy.
PLANNER+
A feature that equips every expecting mom with important information about their prenatal doctor visits. It suggests questions to ask your doctor and integrates appointments seamlessly with your mobile phone's calendar.
REGISTRY
The Bump is solving two of Baby Registry’s biggest challenges:
+ The Bump has collected the top registry products across Amazon, Target, Walmart and so much more, complete with reviews from parents who’ve been where you are. This registry has only grown over time, so you can be sure you’ll find everything you want and need.
+ The typical mom-to-be will register at two or more stores, because there are always some items that require a special, secondary registry. When it comes to managing multiple registries, the Bump has you covered. The Bump will automatically track your registries across each retailer, so you can keep tabs on what you’ve registered for, what’s been bought and what’s still waiting on your registry.
PREGNANCY AND BABY PHOTOS
Document your pregnancy by creating a weekly album of your happily growing belly. And once baby is born, the album expands to track their first amazing year in the world.
CUSTOMER SERVICE
The Bump team reads every email, answers each phone call and takes all of your reviews to heart.
Here's what our users are saying:
“My OBGYN recommended this app because it has the most accurate information regarding pregnancy.” c_nou
“I’ve loved this app throughout my pregnancy. It’s fun to keep track of development milestones by week, well written weekly summaries, and links to endless, timely additional articles and resources. My favorite feature is the 3D view of both baby and bump that points out fun facts about physical developments that week or relevant symptoms.” Allie_G
“Loved it during and post pregnancy” cwebs234
“Love the tips and progress tracking” Ki_Nap

bluejetty:00037383:ios.description:
Box Jam! - 3D Puzzle Game
Play a satisfying 3D sorting puzzle. Organize, stack, and match realistic objects into moving boxes. Perfect for fans of calming puzzle games and brain challenges.
Box Jam is a 3D puzzle game where you sort lifelike objects into matching boxes as they move across the screen.
Each level features realistic items like food, candy, toys, tools, and groceries that need to be matched with the correct box using your eyes and reflexes. It's a unique alternative to match-three games, focused on spatial recognition and satisfying gameplay mechanics.
Why players choose Box Jam over other puzzle games:
-Realistic 3D Sorting Gameplay: Drag and place detailed 3D objects into the correct boxes. The game builds pattern recognition, reflexes, and decision-making.
-Combo System with Visual Effects: Complete fast and accurate sorting streaks to unlock lightning combos that boost your score and clear the board. Combos increase the fun and the challenge.
-No Color Matching – Just Logical Sorting: Box Jam replaces color-matching or tile-swapping mechanics with fast-paced sorting logic and real object association.
-Smooth and Calming Gameplay Loop: Every animation is designed for comfort and rhythm. The game is great for moments when you want to relax and reset your mind.
-Offline Support for Any Situation: Box Jam works without Wi-Fi, making it a great choice for travel, flights, or downtime.
-Designed for All Ages and Skill Levels: The game has intuitive drag-and-drop controls, soft sounds, and a learning curve that’s suitable for everyone.
-Polished Design and Regular Updates: With high-quality 3D visuals and frequent new content drops, there’s always something new to sort.
Looking for a puzzle game that’s both calming and engaging?
Download Box Jam! - 3D Puzzle Game and experience the most rewarding 3D sorting challenge on the App Store.

bluejetty:00083787:ios.name: PSA: Card Tracking & Grading
bluejetty:00083787:ios.summary:
Identify, track, grade, organize, and sell your cards with PSA.
Scan cards to identify them and research pricing in seconds. Build a portfolio to see what your cards are worth and how its value changes over time. Add graded and ungraded ca
bluejetty:00083787:ios.description:
Identify, track, grade, organize, and sell your cards with PSA.
Scan cards to identify them and research pricing in seconds. Build a portfolio to see what your cards are worth and how its value changes over time. Add graded and ungraded cards, organize your collection, submit directly to PSA for grading, and sell through the PSA Vault and eBay.
Whether you collect sports cards, Pokémon, ONE PIECE, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, or other trading cards, PSA gives you the tools to manage more of your collection in one place.
TRACK & MANAGE YOUR CARDS
Scan & Price Cards
Scan sports and trading cards to quickly identify them and access pricing and market data.
Track Your Portfolio
See what your cards are worth and how your portfolio is performing over time. Change date ranges, follow trends, and identify your biggest movers to make more informed collecting and selling decisions.
Track Ungraded Cards
Add ungraded cards alongside your graded cards for a more complete view of what you own. Access price estimates, review sales history, and track value over time.
Organize & Share
Create custom folders and sort or filter your cards by grade, value, category, and more. Share public links to show off your collection or cards you have available for sale or trade.
Verify PSA Cards
Scan PSA labels to verify certification details and access card information and market insights.
Enhance Card Images
Use Slab Studio tools to create polished images of your graded and ungraded cards.
SUBMIT FOR GRADING
Build Your Submission
Create and manage PSA submissions for trading cards directly from the app.
Track Your Order
Follow your cards through the grading process and receive updates as your order progresses.
Reveal Your Grades
Experience your newly graded cards through PSA's interactive grade reveal experience.
SELL YOUR CARDS
Sell on eBay

bluejetty:00041920:ios.description:
Pet owners and verified sitters connect to swap loving pet care for a place to stay on their travels.
Sitters can find global pet sitting opportunities, providing in-home cat and dog sitting and get a place to stay on their travels in return.
Pet owners travel with peace of mind, knowing their furry friends are looked after in their own home. 
Trust is all that our house sitters and pet parents exchange - no money changes hands between members. So, it’s easy for pet parents to find cat and dog sitters who are here for the right reasons.
HOW IT WORKS FOR PET PARENTS…
CHOOSE A MEMBERSHIP PLAN:
Get a year of unlimited access to arrange in-home pet sitters.
CREATE YOUR LISTING:
Describe your home and pets, and add the dates you need pet care.
REVIEW APPLICATIONS:
See who’s applied and secure the perfect house sitter for your home and pets.
HOW IT WORKS FOR SITTERS…
CHOOSE A MEMBERSHIP PLAN:
Get a year of unlimited access to arrange worldwide house sits.
APPLY:
Complete your profile and apply to sits in places you’ll love - whether you’re open to dog sitting, cat sitting or alpaca sitting!
EXPLORE THE WORLD THROUGH HOUSE SITTING:
Take care of pets in their own home and enjoy a place to stay in return.
WHY DON’T PET SITTERS CHARGE?
Unlike many traditional pet care services, our trusted pet sitters don’t charge because they’re passionate about pets. 
By swapping pet care for a place to stay, our pet and house sitters get the chance to explore the world while enjoying the company of pets.
Owners enjoy peace of mind, while sitters explore the world and make a new, furry travel companion in every place they stay.
WHY PET PARENTS LOVE USING THE APP…
PETS ARE HAPPIER AT HOME
Vets agree pets are happiest at home with this house sitting app.
VERIFIED SITTERS
No matter whether they’re cat sitters, dog sitters or goldfish sitters, our sitter members are third-party verified for peace of mind. 
EXPERIENCED SITTERS
Whether you need an overnight dog sitter, rabbit or cat sitter, read sitter reviews and references to select someone who's right for your pet.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO PET CARE
Benefit from unlimited access to arrange pet sitters all year round - including people open to long-term house sitting.
24/7 VET ADVICE LINE*
Available for you and your sitter, anytime you need it.
HOME AND CONTENTS PLAN*
Get cover against damage, theft and accidents.
SIT CANCELLATION PLAN*
Claim compensation if sitters cancel last minute.
MONEY BACK PROMISE*
If you can’t find a sitter, we’ll refund you.
WHY SITTERS LOVE THE APP…
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO HOUSE SITS
Arrange as many pet sitting opportunities as you like and explore the world through pet sitting.
SAVE ON ACCOMMODATION
Exchange loving pet care for a place to stay on your travels - it’s simple with our pet sitting app.
ENJOY THE COMPANY OF PETS
Make worldwide pet friends during your house sitting experiences.
LIVE LIKE A LOCAL
Get to know new places with a furry friend by your side.
FREE ONLINE VET CONSULATIONS*
Get free calls, video and chat with veterinary experts while you’re pet sitting.
2 GLOBAL AIRPORT LOUNGE PASSES*
Claim two free passes in over 600 airports.
ACCIDENT AND THIRD PARTY LIABILITY PLAN*
You’re covered up to $1,000,000 per incident if a pet causes damage or injury to another person, their property or pets during a sit.
SIT CANCELLATION PLAN*
Get compensation in the unlikely event of a cancelled sit.
“I have come to depend on TrustedHousesitters for my lovely senior dog's care whenever I travel. She's calm and happy when I return, not having to transition to another place. And every sitter has been marvelous in communicating, sending me updates, and leaving my house in great shape.” - Teresa, pet and home owner
“We’ve met really interesting people, pets with great personalities and stayed in amazing places.” - Jill and Boggles, house and pet sitters
*Terms apply. Some features are only available on Standard and/or Premium plans.

bluejetty:00062230:ios.name: Fluently - Learn Punjabi
bluejetty:00062230:ios.summary:
Experience the Joy of Learning Punjabi 
Fluently isn’t just another language app – it’s your gateway to learning Punjabi, designed by expert tutors to help you learn quickly, effectively, and with real cultural depth. Whether reconnecting
bluejetty:00062230:ios.description:
Experience the Joy of Learning Punjabi 
Fluently isn’t just another language app – it’s your gateway to learning Punjabi, designed by expert tutors to help you learn quickly, effectively, and with real cultural depth. Whether reconnecting with your roots or starting out, Fluently’s immersive experience will have you speaking, writing, and understanding Punjabi like never before.
________________________________________
Why Fluently?
At Fluently, we believe that language and communication are key to breaking barriers. We’ve designed the app so that you can break these barriers, embrace the beauty of Punjabi language and culture and connect with your heritage. Here’s what you can expect with Fluently: 
• Interactive sentence builder: Practice writing your sentences while mastering grammar, gender, pronunciation, and formality - crucial skills for true fluency.
• Tailored learning paths: Whether you're focused on conversation, writing, or grammar, Fluently adapts to your goals, ensuring a personalised learning journey.
• Immersive video content and stories: Dive into real-life conversations and culturally rich stories that make language learning both educational and enjoyable.
• Track your progress with rewards: Level up, earn badges, track progress and celebrate every milestone in your journey.
• Customer support: We’re committed to ensuring you have the best possible customer experience and are here to help with any queries.
________________________________________
Free access and flexible subscriptions
Get started with Fluently’s first four courses, which are completely free – no credit card is needed to sign up. Immerse yourself in learning Punjabi with interactive tools, video content, and personalised exercises. Enjoy lifetime access to our glossary and dictionary to support your learning journey.
Want to unlock the whole experience? Our subscription plans provide access to advanced lessons, over 100 hours of exclusive content, and progress-tracking tools. With flexible options, you can choose a plan that suits your learning goals and pace. 
Your subscription is set to auto-renew. In the settings of your Apple Account, you can change your subscription plan or turn off auto-renewal up to 24 hours before the renewal date. When a subscription is cancelled, access to the app’s courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment period.
For full terms and conditions, please visit fluently. online/terms.
Contact us:
Questions or comments about learning with Fluently? Email us at fluently@sahara.technology.

bluejetty:00132789:android.description:
Will Imposter become the last warrior in the Galaxy? All answers are in Imposter in Galaxy: Survivor.
As the night falls, your stupid friend, Imposter, gets lost in the galaxy haunted by spirits of Choo Choo Charles and evil monsters. 
👾Tick-tock, tick-tock... the clock is ticking down. Choo Choo is haunting the Imposter. Let’s start the fight by finding an empty room, closing the door, and stepping on your cockpit to build a defense machine system and defeat monsters. Make use of your intelligence and tactics to collect as many coins as possible. Therefore, you can easily upgrade the door, equipment, and make Choo Choo and friends defeated. 
You will become a brave warrior and enjoy exciting and fun moments with your Imposter and friends in Imposter in Galaxy: Survivor!
🎮 How to play
⭐ The clock is ticking, quickly find an empty room, close the door, enter the cockpit to collect gold and upgrade your defense system.
⭐ Do not follow others into a room. If you enter a room and see someone in the cockpit, leave the room as soon as possible. If you do not leave the room, restart the game.
⭐ When the monster attacks the door, calmly press the repair button immediately. Continue to collect gold to upgrade doors and defense systems.
⭐ Never run out of the room no matter what happens, or stay in the cockpit and build and upgrade devices to help Imposter quickly escape Choo Choo's pursuit.
⭐ The more diligent Imposter, the stronger the defense system will be, and the monster will quickly retreat. 
👻Game features
⭐ Many Imposter characters and battle nights are waiting for you to unlock.
⭐ A series of crazy monsters and accomplices: Choo Choo Charles, Bambam, Jumbo Josh, Rainbow Blue, Cat Juan, Boxy Boo... are chasing you. Stay calm and careful.
⭐ A defense system with many features to help you protect the room and defeat monsters faster.
⭐ Stunning graphics full of color and music give you the best experience
Do you have enough intelligence and tactics to help Imposter survive and escape from this haunted Galaxy? Test your skills now with Imposter in Galaxy: Survivor!
