bluejetty:00142600:ios.description:
At ACKO, we offer Car, Bike, Travel, Health, Employee Health & Life insurance
Buy, manage and claim on any ACKO policy directly on the app: Zero commission, zero paperwork, and superfast claims.
*What you get with the ACKO app*
- Insurance for your ride: Two-wheeler or Car
- Health insurance for you and your family 
- Corporate health insurance
- Commission-free plans at incredibly low premiums
- Paperless insurance experience
- Manage your policy on the go
- Get instant one-tap renewal
- Experience smooth claims processing. Tap-upload-done!
- Get free insurance quotes
*With ACKO, you don’t get*
- The nostalgic smell of paper because we have paperless everything.
- The pleasure of connecting with strangers and talking for hours about where your claim is stuck because all our processes are simple & automated. 
*Why ACKO is trustworthy*
- 7.5 Cr+ happy smiles
- 4.7/5 Star Google rating
- 400 Cr+ claims settled
What is special about ACKO?
Our team is obsessed with making insurance super simple. We offer:
 Low-cost premiums
 We focus on selling insurance directly to our customers. This helps us save on commission and pass savings as discounts. 
 Claims service you’ll love
 Minor damage to the car? Get instant claim settlement. Major damage? Give us a call, and we’ll pick up your car, get it repaired, and bring it back to you within 3 days as per policy terms. You’ll also get step-by-step updates on your claims for Bike, Car, and Health Insurance, so you don’t have to sit and wonder what’s going on. 
Insurance made easy
Whether you want to buy insurance for your motorbike, renew car insurance, or purchase health insurance plans, this app will help you out.
Get free insurance quotes
Get Car, Bike and Health Insurance quotes on the app for free. For example, you can calculate your car insurance premium within 60 seconds to compare plans.
Purchase vehicle insurance quickly
Enter details. Get exclusive quotes. Make the payment. Receive your motor insurance policy instantly! Also, access your auto insurance policy document, edit details, and check the policy status.
Buy health insurance online easily
Check health insurance quotes, choose your preferred plan, and buy health insurance for you and your family. You can use the app to buy Arogya Sanjeevani Policy and ACKO Standard Health Insurance Policy.
Health insurance for employees
Avail all the insurance and health benefits of your Employee Group Health Insurance — get free doctor consultations, track your fitness & earn rewards, book lab tests, and order medicines from the app!
Healthkit integration
We integrate seamlessly with Apple Healthkit to sync your steps data and other health related information from the Health app via Apple Healthkit.
Access/edit/claim partner policies
If you have purchased insurance policies via our partners, you can access, edit, and raise a claim using the app. This is also applicable in the case of insurance policies for mobiles/electronics/appliances.
Check vehicle’s RTO info
Enter any vehicle registration number to see its corresponding RTO information, such as model, variant, registration date, and other vehicle details. 
Track traffic challans
Worried about pending traffic challans? Check any vehicle’s pending and paid traffic challans by simply entering the vehicle registration number. 
*Do more with ACKO*
- Know your car’s resale value
- Get daily fuel prices
- Search for nearby EV chargers
- Find PUC centres nearby
- Look for nearby mobile repair centres
*Got questions?*
For more details on insurance, please visit www.acko.com. If you have any questions, please write to us at hello@acko.com or call us on 1860 266 2256.

bluejetty:00013878:ios.description:
Book Keeper Accounting is a business accounting app for small and medium businesses. It supports taxation like GST, VAT etc. It’s simple user interface allows you to send invoices & estimates, track expenses & receipts, manage inventory, view & send various financial reports and much more. It's a complete accounting package which helps you maintain your company books and do all financial accounting.
*********** Fully GST compatible ***********
Book Keeper is GST ready for Indian businesses. Businesses can create GST invoices and see the appropriate taxes captured on each transaction. Generate GST reports (GSTR1, 2, 3B, 4) & file GST returns.
*********** 14 days FREE trial. No signup required!! ***********
Try the app FREE for 14 days, after which you can opt for yearly subscription (starting $60/year or INR 2500/year) or one time purchase plan (starting $200 or INR 8000)
• Unlimited features: Create unlimited accounts, inventory, companies, transactions. No limit!!
• Invoicing: Invoices for products and services; Customise invoice fields like quantity, rate, amount in words, shipping details; Add company logo to invoices; Sign your invoices; Email invoice PDF or take prints; Track paid & outstanding invoices
• Estimates: Create and send estimates to your customers, convert them to invoices later
• Expenses/Receipts: Enter business expenses; payments made; income earned; analyse profits earned
• Inventory Management: Manage your entire inventory in different warehouses
• Financial reports: In depth analysis of your business with 25 comprehensive reports
• No Internet connection required: Offline accounting app, manage accounts on the go
• Stand-alone app: Maintain financial accounting books, no dependency on other software, no sign up required
• No prior accounting know-how: Maintain accounting books with ease, no accounting/bookkeeping knowledge required
• Online Sync: Sync your company data across multiple devices via Dropbox. All data entered on one device gets reflected on other device at the same time!!
• Multiple Users: You can collaborate with your employees and accountants. Multiple users collaborate on the same company with user-level permissions.
It is based on professional accounting principles to ensure balanced books and accurate reports.
Just enter your daily vouchers and let Book Keeper does all the double-entry accounting.
Accounting
• Easy, real accounting
• Accountant approved
• Maintain individual ledgers/accounts
• Automatic computation of profit/loss
Transactions
• Create sales, purchase, receipts, payments, banking transactions (single-entry & double-entry mode)
• Generate invoices and mail them to customers
• Send estimates & convert them to invoices
• Enter tax vouchers, view tax computation
• Keep track of paid/unpaid invoice, outstanding receivable/payable with aging analysis
Order generation
• Generate sales order/estimates, issue purchase order
Inventory Management
• Create individual inventory items with your own units of measure.
• Manage warehouses
• Record purchase/sale/purchase return/sales return voucher entries of these items.
• Record manufacturing journals.
• Automatic valuation of closing inventory based on Average or FIFO method.
Reports
• View various financial accounting reports (Trial Balance, P&L A/C, Trading A/C, Balance Sheet etc.) which are automatically generated
• View detailed reports of each inventory item/service
• View summary of all inventory item
Receipt/Payment
• Get paid faster by providing bank details in invoice footer. 
Our vision is to reduce the manual work and automate the business accounting/bookkeeping as much as possible so that business owners can focus more on growing business and spend less and less time on maintaining daily business transactions.

bluejetty:00022347:ios.summary:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the
bluejetty:00022347:ios.description:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the most fertile and least fertile days of your cycle.
With Apple Health sync, your data stays automatically updated across all your Apple devices — so your fertility insights are always with you.
* Scientifically Backed Methods *
Our app includes two baby gender prediction methods:
 • Popular Method – a theoretical approach based on the well-known theory by Landrum Shettles, which suggests that the timing within the fertile window may influence the baby’s gender.
 • Scientific Method – a statistical, research-based approach developed by Rodrigo Guerrero, grounded in large-scale data from thousands of women.
You can switch between them anytime in Settings.
Please note: both methods provide probabilistic insights, not guaranteed results.
* Full Version Features *
Unlock deeper insights with the full version:
 • Daily pregnancy probability for any selected date.
 • Gender prediction probabilities for each fertile day.
 • Overall fertility chances during your current cycle.
 • Automatic Apple Health sync between devices.
* How It Works *
To create your personal fertility calendar, simply provide:
 • The first day of your last period.
 • Your average cycle length.
 • Your luteal phase length (default works for most users).
Ideal for women with regular cycles — but also reliable for estimating ovulation using your average cycle length.
* Empower Your Reproductive Journey *
Whether you’re trying to conceive or prefer natural birth control, this app provides clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind — backed by science and made even smarter with Apple Health integration.
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational and educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making decisions related to contraception, fertility, or pregnancy. Accuracy may vary depending on individual factors.

bluejetty:00063145:ios.description:
Turn your photos and videos into cartoons, comics, and caricatures — fun, high-quality art that makes everyone smile.
Clip2Comic transforms your images into playful cartoon and comic creations — right on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Turn family photos into comic book art, transform travel snapshots and cityscapes into illustrated scenes, or create coloring pages for kids. From portraits to landscapes, Clip2Comic delivers professional results that stand out. Your images stay 100% private. Everything is processed directly on your device for instant results and complete peace of mind. No internet required.
◆ Photos and Videos — Both Transformed
Create cartoon videos in stunning 4K resolution and 60 FPS — perfect for music videos, instructional content, or social posts that grab attention. For photos, export up to 64 megapixels — ideal for prints, posters, or sharing in crystal-clear detail.
◆ Comic, Cartoon & Sketch Styles
Choose from a curated collection of comic, poster, sketch, and classic cartoon effects — each crafted to deliver professional-quality results. From bold pop-art looks to detailed manga-style effects, find your perfect style. Personalize and save your own Custom Styles, synced across all your devices.
◆ Frames & Decorations
Complete the comic book look with professionally designed frames and dynamic decorations. Place your artwork in authentic comic panels — perfect for social media or storytelling. Add finishing touches with 30+ decorations, including comic dots, speed lines, and cartoon clouds.
◆ Precise Editing Tools
Fine-tune every detail to create exactly the effect you envision. Adjust outlines, detail levels, and colors. Use retouch tools with your finger or Apple Pencil — even create coloring pages for kids.
◆ Projects — Your Creative Work, Always Saved
Never lose a creative idea in progress. Save your edits as a project and return at any time — right where you left off. Explore variations, experiment, and share your projects with others.
◆ Caricature & Deformation Tools
Channel your inner street artist. Stretch, reshape, and bloat parts of your image — creating playful caricatures and exaggerated expressions with ease. Turn a portrait into a funny face, or add comic flair to any photo.
◆ Print & Share
Bring your cartoons into the real world:
• Postcards via MyPostcard — worldwide delivery
• Canvas prints and posters via CanvasPop
• Share instantly on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, and Facebook
Download Clip2Comic for free and start turning your world into a cartoon.
◆ Key Features
• Transform photos into cartoons, comics, and caricatures (up to 64 MP)*
• Cartoon videos with up to 4K/60 FPS*
• Curated comic, poster, sketch, and outline styles
• Comic panel frames*
• 30+ decorations — comic dots, speed lines, cartoon clouds*
• Color filters*
• Deformation tools for playful caricatures*
• Fully adjustable effects—fine tune every detail* 
• Pixel-precise retouch tools*
• Add your personal signature or logo*
• Custom Styles synced across devices
• Projects — save your work, explore variations and share with others
• Real-time, on-device processing — no uploads, no waiting, no internet needed. 100% privacy assured
• Integrated postcard and canvas printing services
• No ads
• Optimized for iOS 27 and the iPhone 18 family
* Subscribe to unlock all features.
◆ Clip2Comic Premium
To unlock Clip2Comic's full creative power, we offer weekly, monthly, and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions.
Payment is charged to your credit card through your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in Apple account settings or cancel your subscription at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.

bluejetty:00082217:ios.description:
7 WKBW News Buffalo gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.
Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.
LOCAL NEWS:
Get up-to-the-minute breaking news alerts and stories.
Tap 'Top News' to read the most important news of the day as curated by our local news teams.
Tap 'Most Recent' to read the news stories published most recently.
Get full support for Dark Mode and Light Mode based on your device preference.
LOCAL VIDEO:
Watch our 24/7 live streaming news channel.
Watch video on demand clips from recent newscasts.
You're in control over what you want to watch and when.
LOCAL WEATHER:
Get daily video weather updates from your trusted local weather team.
Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00076429:ios.summary:

《SLAM DUNK from TV Animation》is a Real-Time 3v3 Basketball game adapted from the Japanese Anime – “Slam Dunk”. The production is supervised by Toei Animation and dis
bluejetty:00076429:ios.description:
SLAM DUNK! Ardent Story Never Die! Fight for the National Championship!
《SLAM DUNK from TV Animation》is a Real-Time 3v3 Basketball game adapted from the Japanese Anime – “Slam Dunk”. The production is supervised by Toei Animation and distributed by DeNA. Meet the original characters, watch the orginal story and those classic scenes. You will be able to use those familiar skills like “Hua Hua Defense”, “Akagi Dunk” and “Lightning Fast”; experience the strength of each high-school basketball team. Let’s ignite your passion for basketball and feel those touching moment through the competitions. Enjoy creating and developing your very own playing technique!
．Official Licensed by Toei Animation! Completely Revive The Classic Story!
Enjoy watching more than 10 chapters of the original scenes through the Story Mode. Reminisce that youthful summer, and watch the development pathway of the Shohoku Basketball rookie – Hanamichi Sakuragi.
．Real-time Battle! Various Ways to Emerge Your Basketball Skill!
Apart from Half-Court 3v3, you may enjoy numerous styles of playing such as 1v1 Solo Match, 2v2 Duo Match, Full-Court 3v3, Full-Court 5v5. Don’t forget to form a team with your friends to double the fun!
．National Tournament Begins! Dominate National Champion! 
Form a team with your friends and start the road to champion! Participate the 3-minute match tournament. Demonstrate your very own basketball technique, and challenge nationwide players. Fight to become the new No.1!
．All characters Assemble! Original Japanese CV!
 Official Licensed by Toei Animation, meet the whole set of Slam Dunk characters here.
．Basketball Genius is born! Challenge The Whole Country to Become The Winner!
Those unique skills of Hanamichi Sakuragi, Kaede Rukawa, Akira Sendoh and Shinichi Maki are revived. Unbox your basketball ability, defeat the challengers from all over the country and become the champion.
．Cross-server Battle is Ready! 3 Minutes Fair Play!
Enlarge your group of friends; tab one button to receive all friend requests at once! Enjoy the matches with your friends anywhere and anytime. Don’t forget to select Honor Division, which represents your city before compete with the others to become the strongest basketball player in the country.

bluejetty:00164876:ios.description:
Genshin Guide - Your Ultimate Companion for Genshin Impact
Genshin Guide (formerly Genshin Notifier) is the ultimate fan-made helper app for Genshin Impact players. Receive free Primogem code notifications and get daily reminders for farming materials, talents, and events to help you level up faster and never miss an opportunity.
Key Features:
Real-Time Notifications for:
- Primogem Codes: Get notified the moment new codes are released.
- Daily Talent Book & Material Reminders: Personalized alerts for your selected characters and weapons.
- Abyss, Boss & Event Resets: Stay on top of Spiral Abyss, Weekly Bosses, and Paimon's Bargains shop resets.
- Custom Notifications: Set custom reminders for daily and weekly tasks (Pro feature - requires in-app purchase).
Tools & Timers:
- Resin Timer: Avoid resin overflow and maximize your gameplay.
- Parametric Transformer and Realm Currency Timers: Never miss essential in-game refreshes.
- Local Specialty Tracker: Optimize your farming for ascension materials like flowers and plants.
- Wish Simulator & Calculator: Plan and track your wishes with ease.
Detailed Progress Planner:
Track and manage progress for all weapons and characters, including popular favorites like Linnea, Varka, Zibai and Columbina. Keep tabs on ascension materials, talent upgrades, and total resource costs.
Exclusive Guides & Resources:
- Best Character Builds and Team Recommendations (Pro feature - requires in-app purchase).
- Spiral Abyss Analytics: Improve your strategies with detailed performance data.
- Primogem Calculation: Maximize your Primogem collection for future banners.
- Genshin Map & Wiki Access: Easily locate in-game items and uncover hidden resources.
- Character & Weapon Build Costs: Plan ahead with comprehensive cost breakdowns.
- Wish Pity System & Upcoming Banners: Stay informed about upcoming banner rates and probabilities.
Fun Quiz Games:
Test your Genshin Impact knowledge with exciting quiz games:
Free Games:
- Warrior's Eye, Guess Wish Art, Spot Fatui Harbingers, Guess Who?, Which Weapon?, Who said it?
Pro Games (requires in-app purchase):
- Name the Monster, Guess by Emoji, Vision Hunt Decree, Whose Constellation?, Whose Legs?, Namecard Detective, Random Shadows
Extra Features:
- Daily Web Check-in Rewards: Earn rewards with just a tap.
- Genshin Impact Video Playlists and Manga Access.
- Dark Mode for night-time playing.
- Web Event Alerts: Never miss out on limited-time events and extra rewards.
Pro Features (available via in-app purchase):
- Remove all ads
- Custom notification times for daily and weekly reminders
- Access to all quiz games
- Team recommendations and advanced build guides
- Cloud data backup - never lose your progress
- And more exclusive features!
Why Genshin Guide?
Genshin Guide is designed to streamline your Genshin Impact experience. Whether you're farming, building teams, or planning your next wish, Genshin Guide helps you stay organized and maximize your gameplay.
DISCLAIMER: This is an unofficial fan-made app for Genshin Impact and is not affiliated with or endorsed by miHoYo or HoYoverse.
If you have any feature requests or issues, please contact me at coder@genshinguide.app
Website: https://www.genshinguide.app/
Privacy policy: https://www.genshinguide.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.genshinguide.app/terms

bluejetty:00180115:ios.description:
●Description
This is the basic application for connecting and communicating with a Bluetooth(R) v4.0 enabled G-SHOCK.
Pairing the watch with your smartphone enables use of a variety of different Mobile Link functions that greatly enhance the smartphone experience.
The G-SHOCK MOVE app also simplifies certain watch operations by letting you perform them on your phone screen.
You can check smartphone notifications (incoming calls, incoming e-mails, etc) on your watch.
●Features of G-SHOCK MOVE app
The following functions are available if you paired the G-SHOCK MOVE app with a supported watch.
- Time adjustment and setting of the watch
- Create Training Plans
- Display and analyze life log data such as steps, heart rate*, etc., measured by the watch
- Display and analyze activity log data such as distance, time, heart rate*, training effect*, etc., measured by the watch
- Linkage (export) with external services such as Apple Health, Strava, etc
*Heart rate model only
Visit the website below for details.
http://world.g-shock.com/

bluejetty:00155925:ios.description:
Mossy Oak Go is the streaming television provider for all things outdoors. 
With original, 100% free outdoors video content suited for hunters, saltwater and freshwater anglers, land managers, conservation enthusiasts, shooting sports aficionados, campers, hikers, adventure seekers, culinary dabblers and varied outdoors pursuits, Mossy Oak Go offers a vast library of online videos for those who live the outdoors lifestyle. 
There is no cost for Mossy Oak Go, removing the hassle of free trials, monthly fees or restricted access. The app is supported across all smart devices without subscription, allowing you to watch the best in outdoors TV anytime, anyplace. Whether you pursue whitetails, turkeys, duck or elk, fish the waters of rivers or oceans, prepare the bounty from a day chasing game, or seek to learn more about tackling life outdoors, Mossy Oak Go provides entertainment, recipes and know-how for living and enjoying your best life outdoors. 
Access Mossy Oak Go from your computer, tablet, or iOS device. 
The best in outdoors programming is here: Mossy Oak Go. 
About Mossy Oak: Mossy Oak started with a fist full of dirt in 1986 in West Point, Mississippi, and the same hunting and outdoors lifestyle that began with its founder Toxey Haas over 30 years ago still exists with the ever-growing company today. Mossy Oak was founded as a camouflage brand with a focus on conservation and living the outdoors lifestyle. Mossy Oak has grown from its simple beginnings as a camouflage company to the embodiment of the outdoors lifestyle. 
Mossy Oak not only provides hunters, anglers and outdoors people with effective concealment but with a symbol of their love of the outdoors in their daily lives. From the dirt to the wildlife habitat management to the fostering of the outdoors lifestyle, Mossy Oak is in the business of being outdoors. 
Through the many branches of the Mossy Oak Brand and using technology to meet outdoors consumers right where they are, Mossy Oak strives to get people outdoors planting, hunting, fishing, learning and sharing it with others.
Terms of Service: https://go.mossyoak.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://go.mossyoak.com/privacy
